character_v1.name: Crono

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Cyclone Strike
abilities.description: Crono performs a rapid, spinning sword attack, dealing 80 + (1.0 * Atk) physical damage to enemies in a small radius around him. Each enemy hit grants 0.3 stack of Chrono Shift, up to the maximum of 3. If Crono has at least 1 stack of Chrono Shift, this ability's radius is increased by 25% and the damage is increased by 20%. This ability has a cooldown of 6 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Whirlwind of steel!

abilities.name: Lightning Slash
abilities.description: Crono channels light energy into his katana and unleashes a swift, linear slash that deals 100 + (0.7 * Atk) physical damage and 50 + (0.4 * Magic Atk) magical (light) damage to enemies in its path. If Crono has at least 1 stack of Chrono Shift, the slash also applies a 'Marked' debuff for 3 seconds. Marked enemies take 10% increased damage from all sources. This ability consumes all Chrono Shift stacks. Cooldown: 8 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the searing light!

abilities.name: Temporal Evasion
abilities.description: Crono briefly alters his personal timeline, granting himself increased evasion for 2 seconds. This ability grants 50% evasion and a 25% movement speed bonus. Successfully evading an attack while this ability is active grants 1 stack of Chrono Shift. If Crono already has 3 stacks of Chrono Shift, he instead gains a temporary shield equal to 15% of his maximum health. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A flicker in time!

abilities.name: Chrono Resonance
abilities.description: Crono passively generates 1 stack of Chrono Shift every 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 3. Additionally, the duration of buffs applied to Crono are increased by 10% per Chrono Shift stack. This passive encourages proactive ability usage to maintain and utilize Chrono Shift stacks for sustained combat effectiveness. Successfully landing a critical hit also grants one stack of Chrono Shift. When Crono reaches maximum Chrono Shift stacks, his next basic attack deals an additional 30 true damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time flows through me.

abilities.name: Luminaire Burst
abilities.description: Crono unleashes his ultimate light-based technique, gathering energy before releasing a devastating burst of light. After a 1.5 second charge, Crono deals 200 + (1.2 * Magic Atk) magical (light) damage to all enemies in a large area. The damage is increased by 25% for each stack of Chrono Shift consumed, and also stuns enemies for 0.5 seconds per stack consumed. After casting this ability, Crono gains all Chrono Shift stacks immediately. This ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the dawn!

character_v1.playstyle: Combo-centric, burst damage dealer who relies on chaining abilities to maximize damage output.

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Alley Cat Ambush
abilities.description: Butch dashes a short distance, dealing 80 (+60% Attack Damage) physical damage to enemies in his path and applying a stack of 'Cartoon Chaos'. If Butch dashes through terrain, the dash distance is increased by 50% and the next basic attack within 3 seconds gains +30% critical chance. Enemies hit are also slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds. This ability has a brief cooldown of 8 seconds, allowing for frequent use in skirmishes. Using Alley Cat Ambush cleverly can create spacing and opportunities for follow-up attacks, enhancing Butch's ability to engage or disengage from fights based on the situation. Successfully ambushing enemies awards an additional stack of 'Cartoon Chaos'.
abilities.flavorQuote: Heh, didn't see that coming, did ya?

abilities.name: Trash Can Toss
abilities.description: Butch hurls a trash can towards a target location within a medium range. The trash can lands after a short delay, dealing 90 (+70% Attack Damage) physical damage to enemies in the area and knocking them back a short distance. The area becomes littered with garbage, creating a small zone that slows enemies by 15% for 3 seconds. If Butch has at least 5 stacks of 'Cartoon Chaos', he can expend them to enhance the trash can, increasing the damage by 50% and the knockback distance by 100%. The cooldown for Trash Can Toss is 12 seconds, making it a strategic tool for controlling choke points and disrupting enemy formations.
abilities.flavorQuote: Take out the trash!

abilities.name: Nine Lives Resilience
abilities.description: Butch possesses a natural tenacity, granting him 20% crowd control reduction. Whenever Butch takes damage exceeding 15% of his maximum health in a single instance, he gains a temporary shield equal to 10% of his maximum health for 4 seconds. This shield can only trigger once every 15 seconds. Additionally, for every stack of 'Cartoon Chaos' he has, Butch gains 0.5% damage reduction, up to a maximum of 20% at 40 stacks. This passive synergizes with Butch's aggressive playstyle, allowing him to withstand bursts of damage and remain in the fight longer.
abilities.flavorQuote: You'll have to do better than that to keep me down!

abilities.name: Cunning Trap
abilities.description: Butch sets a trap at a target location within a small radius. If an enemy steps on the trap, they are rooted for 1.25 seconds and take 60 (+50% Magic Attack) magic damage. The trap remains invisible until triggered. If Butch has 20 or more stacks of Cartoon Chaos he may expend them to place a bigger and better trap. This bigger trap has a slightly larger detection radius, the root lasts 2 seconds and enemies caught in the trap will take 75 (+65% Magic Attack) magic damage. Only one trap can be active at a time. The cooldown for Cunning Trap is 15 seconds, requiring careful placement and timing to maximize its effectiveness. This ability is core to Butch's zone control, allowing him to control space and punish aggressive enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Right where I want 'em!

abilities.name: Cartoon Carnage
abilities.description: Butch unleashes a flurry of cartoon-inspired attacks for 6 seconds. During this time, his attack speed is increased by 50%, and his basic attacks deal an additional 30 (+20% Attack Damage) physical damage on hit. While active, Butch is immune to crowd control effects. For every stack of 'Cartoon Chaos' he possesses upon activation, the duration of Cartoon Carnage is extended by 0.1 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds total duration. Cartoon Carnage ends prematurely if Butch is stunned or silenced, making positioning and timing crucial. The cooldown is 90 seconds. This ability represents Butch at his most chaotic and dangerous, turning him into a whirlwind of destruction.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's get this party started!

character_v1.name: Nicole Watterson

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Electric.

abilities.name: Furious Flurry
abilities.description: Nicole unleashes a rapid series of punches and kicks in a designated direction. The initial strike deals 40 + (0.6 * ATK) physical damage and applies a stack of 'Focus'. Each subsequent hit within 2 seconds deals 20 + (0.3 * ATK) physical damage, stacking up to 5 times. Landing all hits on the same target significantly increases the Limit Break meter by 10%. If Limit Break is active, Furious Flurry's range extends by 20% and the final hit inflicts a short knockback. The cooldown is 8 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each stack of Focus already on the target, down to a minimum of 4 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't make me repeat myself!

abilities.name: Protective Dash
abilities.description: Nicole dashes a short distance, granting herself a shield that absorbs 100 + (0.8 * DEF) damage for 3 seconds. If she dashes towards an ally, the ally also receives a shield absorbing 50 + (0.4 * DEF) damage for the same duration. Successfully shielding an ally grants Nicole a 5% speed boost for 4 seconds. If Limit Break is active, the dash distance increases by 30% and the shield also reflects 30% of the damage it absorbs back to the attacker as magic damage. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get behind me!

abilities.name: Rainbow Factory Rage
abilities.description: Nicole channels her inner rage, increasing her attack damage by 20% and speed by 15% for 6 seconds. During this time, her attacks also inflict an additional 15 + (0.2 * Magic ATK) magic damage. Activating this ability grants a burst of Limit Break energy, filling the meter by 15%. If used during Limit Break, the duration is extended by 3 seconds, and enemies hit by her basic attacks are briefly stunned for 0.5 seconds. Cooldown: 18 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've had enough!

abilities.name: Limitless Potential
abilities.description: Nicole gains 'Limit Break' energy by dealing damage (5% of damage dealt) and receiving damage (10% of damage received). When the Limit Break meter is full, Nicole can activate it, transforming into a 'Limit Break' state for 10 seconds. In this state, her attack and speed are increased by 30%, and her abilities gain enhanced effects. After Limit Break ends, Nicole suffers from 'Exhaustion,' reducing her speed by 10% for 5 seconds. The Limit Break state has a visible visual effect: Nicole gains a fiery aura and glowing eyes.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to take this seriously!

abilities.name: Watterson Family Fury
abilities.description: Nicole unleashes her full power, creating a massive shockwave around her that deals 200 + (1.2 * ATK) physical damage and knocks back all enemies within a large radius. For the next 8 seconds, she enters an 'Overdrive' state, gaining 50% increased attack damage and applying a 'Fear' effect to enemies damaged by her basic attacks, causing them to flee for 1 second. Activating this ability instantly refills her Limit Break meter upon completion of Overdrive. This ability has a long cast time of 1.5 seconds and a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: You messed with the wrong family!

appearanceTags: White collared shirt with Rainbow Factory badge

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Accio Ally
abilities.description: Hermione casts Accio on a targeted ally, instantly pulling them towards her location, repositioning them strategically within the battlefield. This ability has a range of 8 units. Upon arrival, the ally receives a burst of magical energy, granting them a shield equal to 15% of Hermione's magic attack for 3 seconds. Furthermore, this ability grants 1 stack of Erudition to the targeted ally, increasing their tenacity by 5% per stack. If the targeted ally is already within a 3-unit radius of Hermione, this ability instead grants them 2 stacks of Erudition and the shield duration is increased to 5 seconds. This ability can be used to rescue allies from danger or to bring them closer to the front lines for aggressive plays.
abilities.flavorQuote: Need a bit of help getting into position?

abilities.name: Protego Maxima
abilities.description: Hermione channels her magical power to cast Protego Maxima, creating a wide-area defensive barrier that reduces incoming damage by 30% for all allies within a 5-unit radius for 4 seconds. This barrier also reflects 10% of the mitigated damage back to the attackers as magic damage. Each ally within the barrier receives 1 stack of Erudition, increasing their magic defense by 8% per stack. If an ally already has 3 or more stacks of Erudition, the damage reduction is increased to 45% for that ally only. This ability provides crucial protection against burst damage and can turn the tide of battle in team fights. The reflected damage is distributed evenly among all attacking enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: No harm shall befall us under my watch!

abilities.name: Expelliarmus Expertise
abilities.description: Hermione's mastery of the Expelliarmus spell enhances her team's offensive capabilities. Whenever an enemy is disarmed by any ally, all allies gain 1 stack of Erudition, increasing their attack damage by 6% and magic attack by 6% for 6 seconds. If Hermione disarms an enemy herself, the duration of the attack and magic attack buff is extended to 9 seconds, and allies also gain a 15% increase to their critical hit chance. This passive emphasizes teamwork and rewards strategic disarming maneuvers. The damage buffs do not stack with themselves, but instead refresh the duration.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's turn their weapons against them!

abilities.name: Confundo Cascade
abilities.description: Hermione unleashes a surge of confusing magic, casting Confundo on up to three enemies within a 6-unit range. Each affected enemy is inflicted with the Confused status for 3 seconds, causing their attacks to have a 40% chance to target a random enemy or even themselves. Additionally, each successful confuse grants 1 stack of Erudition to a random ally, increasing their speed by 10% per stack. If there are fewer than three enemies in range, the chance to target themselves increases proportionally to the remaining number, up to a maximum of 80%. This ability excels at disrupting enemy formations and turning the tide of battle through chaos and misdirection.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little confusion can go a long way.

abilities.name: Time-Turner's Wisdom
abilities.description: Hermione taps into the power of the Time-Turner, briefly glimpsing alternate timelines to provide a significant advantage to her allies. For 8 seconds, all allies gain the 'Insight' buff, granting them a 25% increase to all damage dealt and a 25% reduction to all damage received. At the end of the duration, Hermione grants a final 'Erudition' stack, the type corresponding to whatever spell was most cast (offensive, defensive, or utility) during the 'Insight' buff’s active duration, to all allies. If two or more spell types are tied, the 'Erudition' granted will be a random one amongst them. This ability offers unparalleled support and empowers her team to dominate crucial moments.
abilities.flavorQuote: The threads of time are on our side!

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Expelliarmus
abilities.description: Harry Potter casts Expelliarmus, launching a jet of white light at the target enemy. This deals X magic atk as damage and disarms the target, preventing them from using abilities for 2 seconds. For each stack of Sacrificial Aegis, the duration of the disarm is increased by 0.25 seconds. If the target is already disarmed, Expelliarmus deals an additional X magic atk as true damage. This ability has a 8-second cooldown. Expelliarmus is a core spell in Harry's arsenal, representing his instinctive reaction to disarm his opponents.
abilities.flavorQuote: Not Slytherin, eh? Are you sure? You could be great, you know, it's all here in your head, and Slytherin will help you on the way to greatness, no doubt about that!

abilities.name: Protego
abilities.description: Harry Potter casts Protego, creating a magical shield that absorbs X damage for 3 seconds. While the shield is active, Harry gains 20% increased tenacity. If the shield breaks before the duration ends, Harry gains a stack of Sacrificial Aegis. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. Protego provides Harry Potter with necessary protection, allowing him to strategically mitigate incoming damage and build up his power through the Sacrificial Aegis mechanic.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can teach you how to bottle fame, brew glory, even stopper death - if you aren't as big a dunderhead as I expect you to be.

abilities.name: Expecto Patronum
abilities.description: Harry Potter conjures a powerful Patronus in the form of a Stag, unleashing a wave of light that deals X magic atk as damage to all enemies in a cone in front of him and cleanses himself of all debuffs. Additionally, each enemy hit applies X damage to himself.For each stack of Sacrificial Aegis, the Patronus heals Harry for 5% of his missing health. This ability has a 15-second cooldown. Expecto Patronum embodies Harry's resilience and ability to overcome darkness, providing both offensive and defensive utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: Happiness can be found, even in the darkest of times, if one only remembers to turn on the light.

abilities.name: Chosen One (Signature Passive)
abilities.description: Harry Potter gains a stack of Sacrificial Aegis each time he loses 10% of his maximum health, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. Each stack of Sacrificial Aegis grants 5% increased magic atk and atk. When Harry reaches 10 stacks, his next basic attack or ability applies a 2-second fear effect to the target. Sacrificial Aegis represents Harry's increasing power and resolve as he faces adversity.
abilities.flavorQuote: I solemnly swear that I am up to no good.

abilities.name: Avada Kedavra (Ultimate)
abilities.description: Harry Potter channels his inner darkness, hesitatingly unleashing the Killing Curse on a single target enemy, dealing X magic atk as true damage and applying the 'Marked for Death' debuff for 5 seconds. For each stack of Sacrificial Aegis, the damage of Avada Kedavra is increased by 10%. Marked for Death causes the target to take 25% increased damage from all sources. If Harry Potter kills an enemy with this ability, the cooldown is reduced by 50%. This ability has a 60-second cooldown. Avada Kedavra represents Harry's ultimate willingness to cross boundaries, even if it costs him part of his soul.
abilities.flavorQuote: I open at the close.

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Dark.

abilities.name: Avada Kedavra
abilities.description: Voldemort unleashes the Killing Curse in a narrow line, dealing very high magic damage to the first enemy hit. This ability costs 15% of Voldemort's current HP. If Voldemort has at least 3 Horcrux Shards, he may consume them to ignore the HP cost and increase the damage by 30%. If the target is below 20% Max HP, consuming the shards will guarantee a critical hit and deal additional true damage equal to 10% of the target's missing health. This spell has a 8 second cooldown. When used, Voldemort will briefly disappear and reappear behind the target.
abilities.flavorQuote: "There is no good and evil, there is only power, and those too weak to seek it."

abilities.name: Crucio
abilities.description: Voldemort casts the Cruciatus Curse, inflicting agonizing pain on a target enemy. Deals initial magic damage, then applies a Damage-over-Time effect dealing 5% of the target's Max HP as magic damage every second for 5 seconds. Additionally, the target's speed is reduced by 20% for the duration. This ability costs 10% of Voldemort's current HP. Voldemort can consume up to 2 Horcrux Shards to increase the slow effect by 10% per shard consumed. If the target moves outside a 400 unit range from Voldemort while under the effects of Crucio, Voldemort takes an additional 5% of their current HP as magic damage, and gains a Horcrux Shard. Cooldown: 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'll show you how it is done!"

abilities.name: Imperio
abilities.description: Voldemort uses the Imperius Curse to briefly control an enemy target, forcing them to attack their allies. For 3 seconds, the target enemy is Charmed, attacking nearby enemies. Controlled enemy deals 50% less damage. This ability costs 8% of Voldemort's current HP. If Voldemort has at least 1 Horcrux Shard, he can consume it to increase the duration of the Charm by 0.5 seconds. If at least 4 Horcrux Shards are consumed, the controlled enemy will take 20% increased damage, and the Charm will additionally grant a stacking buff, increasing the charmed enemy’s Atk by 5% every auto attack. Max of 5 stacks. This spell has a 15 second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Give me Harry Potter, and none shall be harmed."

abilities.name: Serpent's Renewal
abilities.description: Voldemort's connection to his Horcruxes grants him sustain. Whenever Voldemort drops below 40% HP, he automatically consumes up to 3 Horcrux Shards. Each shard consumed restores 8% of his missing health. If Voldemort has fewer than 3 Horcrux Shards, he will restore as much health as possible based on the available shards. Furthermore, whenever an ally dies nearby, Voldemort gains one Horcrux Shard. Voldemort cannot gain Horcrux Shards from Serpent’s Renewal if he is above 40% hp.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I was ripped from my body, I was less than spirit, less than the meanest ghost...but still, I was alive."

abilities.name: Lord Voldemort
abilities.description: Voldemort embraces his Dark Lord persona, becoming temporarily invulnerable and amplifying his power. For 8 seconds, Voldemort gains complete immunity to all damage and crowd control effects and his movement speed is increased by 20%. During this time, all of Voldemort's damaging abilities cost no HP and consume no Horcrux Shards; instead, they automatically trigger their maximum shard-enhanced effects. When the invulnerability ends, Voldemort is stunned for 1.5 seconds as the magical energies stabilize. This effect has a 120 second cooldown. If Voldemort activates the ultimate with 7 Horcrux Shards, the Stun will not occur.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I have experimented; I have pushed the boundaries of magic further, perhaps, than they have ever been pushed."

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Wingardium Leviosa (Troll Club)
abilities.description: Ron attempts the Levitation Charm, targeting a single enemy. If Serendipity triggers (30% chance), the enemy is lifted higher, becoming stunned for 2 seconds. Otherwise, the target is only slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. This reflects his pivotal moment in first year, knocking out the troll. Regardless of Serendipity, Ron has a 15% chance to fumble the spell entirely (miss), representing his magical inconsistencies. If the target is already airborne, the successful Serendipity stun duration is increased to 3 seconds, but the chance to miss is increased to 30%. Success or failure, this ability always reduces Ron's Tenacity by 10% for 3 seconds, reflecting his resulting nervousness.
abilities.flavorQuote: "It's Leviosa, not Leviosar!"

abilities.name: Accio (The Deluminator)
abilities.description: Ron uses the Deluminator to manipulate light, targeting an ally. This ability removes all Stealth effects from that ally, providing True Sight within a radius of 400 around the target for 4 seconds. This reflects his crucial use of the Deluminator during the Horcrux hunt. If Serendipity triggers (40% chance), Ron also grants the ally a 20% Evasion buff for the same duration. Otherwise, only True Sight is granted. Activating Accio grants Ron a shield absorbing up to X damage, reflecting Ron drawing enemy attention. This shield lasts for 3 seconds or until broken.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Dumbledore knew I'd come back!"

abilities.name: Weasley Is Our King
abilities.description: Ron channels the 'Weasley Is Our King' energy, taunting all enemies within a 500 radius for 1.5 seconds. This is a shoutout to the Quidditch matches. For each enemy taunted, Ron's magic def is reduced by 5% for 4 seconds. If Serendipity triggers (20% chance), one random taunted enemy is also afflicted with 'Sluggish' for 2 seconds, reducing their speed by 40%. Also if Serendipity triggers, Ron recovers X hp over 3 seconds and receives X armor for 4 seconds (15% chance), reflecting his moments of unexpected brilliance. If Serendipity fails however, Ron takes X True Damage reflecting his insecurities. The minimum # of targets required to successfully use Weasley is 2 and it has to target units within a radius of 500.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm going to be absolutely brilliant!"

abilities.name: Wizard's Chess
abilities.description: Ron's strategic thinking grants him enhanced awareness on the battlefield. Every 15 seconds, Ron gains a 'Chess Piece' token. He can store up to 3 tokens. Activating an ability consumes one Chess Piece token, granting one of the following random bonus effects: 20% increased atk speed for 3 seconds, 20% increased Def for 3 seconds, or a 15% chance to cleanse a debuff on a nearby ally. If Serendipity triggers upon gaining a Chess Piece token (35% chance), the effectiveness of the next token-activated bonus is doubled.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Knight to E5! Checkmate!"

abilities.name: Destroying the Locket
abilities.description: Ron channels Godric Gryffindor's Sword to destroy the locket. Ron deals X magic damage in a cone in front of him. All enemies hit by this cone are also silenced for 2 seconds. All allies within the cone gain 35% Lifesteal for 4 seconds. As he destroys the locket, Ron remembers every terrible thought the locket inflicted on him. During channel, Ron’s atk and speed is reduced by 20%. After channel, there is a 40% chance Ron is ‘Inspired’ for 5 seconds. While ‘Inspired’ his magic atk is increased by 40%. There is a 60% chance Ron is instead 'Haunted', which triggers a fear effect that lasts for 1 second. This ability has a long cooldown (90 seconds).
abilities.flavorQuote: "It was about what he valued, and what he was willing to risk!"

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Niffler's Greed
abilities.description: Newt sends out a Niffler to target the enemy with the highest attack. The Niffler scurries across the battlefield, latching onto the target and inflicting 'Magical Thief'. For the next 3 turns, the afflicted enemy's attack is reduced by 25%, and Newt gains 15% of the stolen attack as magic attack. If the Niffler reaches the target it will also steal a random buff from them, prioritizing buffs that increase attack or speed, granting it to the allied unit with the lowest HP, lasting 2 turns. After its thieving spree, the Niffler returns to Newt, ready to be deployed again.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little mischief never hurt anyone...except maybe the target.

abilities.name: Bowtruckle's Guard
abilities.description: Newt calls upon a Bowtruckle to safeguard an ally. He throws a piece of bark, creating a shield effect on the target. The targeted ally gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of Newt's max HP plus 50% of his magic defense, lasting 2 turns. Additionally, if an enemy attacks the shielded ally, the Bowtruckle retaliates by inflicting 'Rooted' on the attacker for 1 turn, reducing their speed by 40%. This rooted effect does not stack. The Bowtruckle will then return to Newt, waiting for his next command. This is a strategic move that requires careful timing to maximize protection and control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: Loyal and protective, just like Pickett.

abilities.name: Erumpent Charge
abilities.description: Newt commands an Erumpent to charge through the enemy lines. The Erumpent stampedes forward, dealing damage to all enemies in a straight line equal to 60% of Newt's magic attack plus 10% of the targets' max HP as true damage. Enemies hit are also knocked back a short distance. If the Erumpent collides with a wall or another solid obstacle during its charge, it explodes, dealing an additional 20% of its initial damage as fire damage to all nearby enemies and inflicting 'Burning' for 2 turns, dealing 5% of max hp fire damage each turn. Newt must carefully consider the positioning of enemies and the battlefield layout to maximize the effectiveness of this destructive ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Stand back, it's going to blow!

abilities.name: Magizoologist's Insight
abilities.description: Newt's extensive knowledge of magical creatures grants him unique advantages in battle. 'Beast Release' cooldowns are reduced by 1 turn. Additionally, when Newt deploys a beast, he gains a stacking buff called 'Animal Affinity', increasing his magic defense by 5% for each unique beast currently deployed on the field, up to a maximum of 15%. This effect lasts as long as the respective beast remains active. This passive encourages strategic beast management and positioning, allowing Newt to adapt to different combat situations and maximize his effectiveness as a Magizoologist.
abilities.flavorQuote: There's more to these creatures than meets the eye.

abilities.name: Beast Release: Obscurus Containment
abilities.description: Newt opens his suitcase to unleash the power of a contained Obscurus. The Obscurus, initially contained within a magical bubble, is released targeting the enemy team. Upon release the magic bubble explodes dealing X damage, it unleashes a wave of uncontrolled magical energy that silences all enemies for 2 turns, preventing them from casting abilities. After the initial burst, the Obscurus disperses and applies 'Weakened Soul' to all enemies for 3 turns, reducing their attack, magic attack, and speed by 20%. Newt regains 1 use of random basic ability. Following this devastating effect, the Obscurus returns to Newt's suitcase. (Cooldown: 4 turns).
abilities.flavorQuote: I know what it's like to be different.

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Earth.

abilities.name: Accio Knowledge
abilities.description: Hermione casts Accio, summoning forgotten knowledge to her aid. Target ally gains 3 stacks of 'Insight'. Each stack of Insight increases the target's magic atk by 10%. Upon using 3 stacks of Insight, the ally gains 'Clarity' for 4 seconds, increasing the potency of their next heal or shield by 50%. Using this ability grants Hermione one stack of 'Prepared Mind' (max 3). Ally must be within a medium range. This ability goes on cooldown for 8 seconds. This ability provides no effect to Hermione herself, she can only use the 'accio' spell to summon benefits for her allies. The spell appears as a shimmering blue light that moves towards the target.
abilities.flavorQuote: Books and cleverness! There are more important things, but sometimes, knowledge is power.

abilities.name: Protego Maxima
abilities.description: Hermione casts a powerful protection spell, creating a magical barrier that shields allies. A targeted area within a large range receives a shield that absorbs X damage, scaling with Hermione’s magic atk. While the shield is active, allies within the area gain 10% Def. The shield lasts for 5 seconds. If Hermione has 3 stacks of 'Prepared Mind', casting this ability consumes all stacks to extend the duration of the shield to 8 seconds and increases the Def bonus to 20%. Cooldown of 12 seconds. The protective field shimmers with a golden hue, providing a visual indication of its defensive capabilities, and allies will visually receive a faint glow.
abilities.flavorQuote: Protego Maxima! The power of knowledge protects us all!

abilities.name: Time-Turner's Gambit
abilities.description: Hermione manipulates time to drastically alter the battlefield, providing either offense or defense. This ability has two distinct modes, chosen before the match. Offensive Mode: Target enemy takes 20% increased damage from all sources for 6 seconds. Defensive Mode: All allies gain 20% increased healing from all sources for 6 seconds. However, after using Time-Turner's Gambit, Hermione is inflicted with 'Temporal Exhaustion' for 8 seconds, reducing her speed by 30% and silencing her. Time-Turner's Gambit has a 20 second cooldown. Using this ability correctly is critical, as the 'Temporal Exhaustion' can leave Hermione vulnerable. This ability appears as a brief distortion in time around the affected target.
abilities.flavorQuote: A calculated risk, but sometimes, time is on our side… or against them.

abilities.name: Arithmancy Augmentation
abilities.description: Hermione's understanding of Arithmancy allows her to passively enhance her team’s abilities. Every 15 seconds, Hermione grants a random ally one of the following buffs for 5 seconds: 20% increased atk, 20% increased magic atk, or 15% increased speed. Additionally, Hermione gains one stack of 'Prepared Mind' whenever a buff is successfully applied. These buffs rotate randomly and cannot apply to the same ally twice in a row. The ability's effect has a subtle visual cue, such as a brief numerical display around the targeted ally, indicating the mathematical enhancement being applied.
abilities.flavorQuote: Numbers hold the key to unlocking true potential.

abilities.name: Philosopher's Stone Resonance
abilities.description: Hermione channels the protective power of the Philosopher's Stone, creating a powerful, resonant buff. For 10 seconds, allies within a large radius gain 30% damage reduction and heal for 5% of their max HP every second. In addition, if Hermione has three stacks of 'Prepared Mind', this ability consumes them to grant allies immunity to crowd control effects for the duration. This ability has a 90-second cooldown. Ultimate appears as golden light erupting from Hermione before enveloping allies in a protective aura.
abilities.flavorQuote: The greatest defense lies in the unyielding power of knowledge and friendship.

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Omnitrix Surge
abilities.description: The Omnitrix cycles through a predetermined sequence of alien transformations: Heatblast, Four Arms, XLR8, Diamondhead and Wildmutt. Each transformation lasts for 8 seconds, granting unique abilities and stat modifications reflecting the current alien. The sequence repeats continuously. After each full cycle of aliens, Ben 10 gains 10% bonus damage for 4 seconds, stacking up to 3 times, incentivizing players to strategically manage his transformations and maximize damage output by timing attacks during the bonus damage windows. While transformed, Ben's basic attacks change to reflect the current alien's capabilities, adapting his combat style on the fly.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's hero time!

abilities.name: Heatblast: Fireball Barrage
abilities.description: While transformed into Heatblast, Ben 10 launches a barrage of five fireballs in quick succession towards the targeted enemy. Each fireball deals 40 (+20% magic atk) fire damage. If all five fireballs hit the same target, the final fireball inflicts burn, dealing 10 (+5% magic atk) fire damage per second for 3 seconds. This ability synergizes with "Omnitrix Surge" by capitalizing on Heatblast's damage potential during his short transformation window, encouraging players to time their attacks and manage their transformations effectively to maximize damage output and apply the burn effect.
abilities.flavorQuote: Going supernova!

abilities.name: Four Arms: Ground Slam
abilities.description: When transformed into Four Arms, Ben 10 slams his fists into the ground, dealing 120 (+50% atk) physical damage to nearby enemies in a cone and stunning them for 1 second. This ability is highly effective for disrupting enemy formations and creating openings for teammates. Moreover, Four Arms gains a temporary shield equal to 15% of his max hp for 3 seconds after using Ground Slam, providing increased survivability during the transformation. This ensures that the tanking role of Four Arms is emphasized while actively contributing to the team's survivability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see you handle this!

abilities.name: XLR8: Speed Burst
abilities.description: As XLR8, Ben 10 activates his enhanced speed, gaining a 50% movement speed increase and 30% attack speed increase for 5 seconds. During this time, his next basic attack deals an additional 60 (+30% atk) true damage. This burst of speed allows Ben 10 to quickly reposition himself, chase down enemies, or escape dangerous situations. The true damage on the next attack ensures that he can quickly dispatch vulnerable targets or deal significant damage to more resilient enemies. The skill enhances XLR8's role as a mobile damage dealer.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta go fast!

abilities.name: Diamondhead: Crystal Shards
abilities.description: Upon activating his Ultimate, Diamondhead summons a barrage of crystal shards, launching them in a wide area. Each shard deals 60 (+30% magic atk) magic damage and applies a stacking slow effect, reducing movement speed by 10% per shard, up to a maximum of 50% slow. If a target is hit by 5 or more shards, they are encased in crystal for 1.5 seconds. The number of shards fired depends on the Omnitrix charge; the ultimate will fire 12 shards initially, increasing by 2 shards for every successful full cycle of transformations from Omnitrix Surge, up to a maximum of 20 shards. This skill emphasizes area control and crowd control while scaling with Ben's performance.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to get crystallized!

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Kamehameha Charge
abilities.description: Goku channels energy, charging a Kamehameha. For every second channeled (up to 3 seconds), the Kamehameha's damage increases by 50% of his attack damage and its range increases by 20%. If Goku has at least 50 Saiyan Power, he can consume it to instantly charge the Kamehameha to maximum power, also granting it True Damage equal to 10% of the target's current HP, but it will consume all available Saiyan Power above 50. A fully charged Kamehameha also applies a debuff, reducing the target's speed by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability is interrupted if Goku is stunned or knocked down.
abilities.flavorQuote: It's not over yet!

abilities.name: Saiyan Spirit (Signature Passive)
abilities.description: Goku gains 5 Saiyan Power every second. Additionally, taking damage grants him bonus Saiyan Power equal to 10% of the damage taken, but no more than 30 Saiyan Power per instance of damage. When Goku reaches 100 Saiyan Power, he can transform into Super Saiyan 1, consuming all Saiyan Power. In Super Saiyan 1 form, Goku's attack and speed are increased by 30% but his defense is reduced by 15%. This transformation lasts for 15 seconds, after which Goku reverts to his base form and suffers a 5-second period where he cannot gain Saiyan Power.
abilities.flavorQuote: I won't let you destroy my world!

abilities.name: Instant Transmission Strike
abilities.description: Goku instantly teleports to a target enemy within a medium range, dealing damage equal to 80% of his attack damage. If Goku has at least 30 Saiyan Power, he can consume it to empower the strike, dealing an additional 40% of his attack damage as True Damage. Furthermore, the empowered strike stuns the target for 0.75 seconds. If used while in Super Saiyan 1 form, the range of this ability is increased by 50% and it applies a 2-second burn effect, dealing 10% of the target's maximum health as damage over time.
abilities.flavorQuote: Too slow!

abilities.name: Saiyan Resilience
abilities.description: Whenever Goku's HP drops below 30%, he gains a shield equal to 20% of his maximum HP for 5 seconds. This effect can only occur once every 30 seconds. While in Super Saiyan 1 form, this shield also reflects 30% of the damage taken back to the attacker. Additionally, if Goku has full Saiyan Power (100) when his health drops below 30%, he automatically transforms into Super Saiyan 1, consuming all Saiyan Power, and the shield duration is extended to 8 seconds. This automatic transformation still has a 30-second cooldown after the Super Saiyan 1 form ends.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can still fight!

abilities.name: Spirit Bomb (Ultimate)
abilities.description: Goku gathers energy from all living beings, creating a massive Spirit Bomb. After a 2-second channel, Goku launches the Spirit Bomb at a targeted area, dealing damage equal to 200% of his attack damage plus 50% of the target's maximum HP as True Damage to all enemies within the area. This damage is split evenly between all targets hit. While channeling, Goku is immobile but gains a shield equal to 50% of his maximum HP. If Goku is in Super Saiyan 1 form during the channel, the Spirit Bomb's damage is increased by 50%, and the shield's strength is doubled. After casting Spirit Bomb, Goku's Saiyan Power gain is reduced by 50% for 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everyone, lend me your energy!

character_v1.name: Luz

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Glyph of Illumination
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Luz draws a Light Glyph, creating a radiant beacon at the target location. This beacon illuminates the area, granting vision and revealing stealthed enemies within a radius of 500 units. The beacon persists for 8 seconds. Enemies entering the illuminated area are marked with 'Revealed', reducing their evasion by 15%. If 'Glyph Harmony' is active (Ice + Light), the beacon also slows enemies by 20% for 2 seconds when they first enter the area. This spell has a cast range of 700 units and a cooldown of 10 seconds. Successfully illuminating enemies provides Luz with a stacking buff, granting 3% increased magic attack for every revealed enemy, up to a maximum of 15%. The magic attack buff lasts for 5 seconds, refreshing with each new reveal. This is a key opening ability for detecting ambushes and supporting frontline allies with vision.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's shed some light on this situation!

abilities.name: Palisman Bulwark
upgrades: (Balance Patch) The shield's defensive values were adjusted slightly. Maximum protection potential reduced by approximately 17% to reduce shielding power in longer fights.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: With a flourish, Luz calls upon Stringbean's adaptable nature, transforming her palisman into a shimmering shield of light and wood that envelops a chosen ally. This protective bulwark absorbs up to X damage, equivalent to 150 plus 20% of Luz's Magic Attack, mitigating incoming harm for a duration of 4 seconds. The ward grants the shielded ally increased tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects by 10%. If Luz currently has the 'Glyph Harmony' buff active, achieved by combining Plant and Light glyphs, Stringbean's form enhances the shield by mending her ally, administering healing in the amount of X every second, equivalent to 50 plus 10% of Luz's Magic Attack. This healing effect persists even after the shield is fully depleted, continuing its restorative embrace for an additional 3 seconds, ensuring the ally's sustained well-being. The magnitude of the shield's health is dynamically tied to Luz's magical prowess, granting more robust protection as her capabilities grow. Upon casting, Luz is unable to re-summon Stringbean to her side, or order her to cast another ability, until the shield is either fully depleted, expires after 4 seconds, or is destroyed by enemy fire; requiring careful foresight and timing when deciding to imbue allies with Stringbean's light.

abilities.name: Firestorm Glyph
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Luz etches a Fire Glyph into the ground, creating a fiery vortex that deals X (80 + 30% of Luz's Magic Attack) magic damage per second to enemies within a 400 unit radius for 5 seconds. Enemies caught in the vortex are also afflicted with 'Burn,' taking an additional 5% of their maximum health as true damage over the duration. If 'Glyph Harmony' is active (Fire + Plant), the vortex also applies 'Entangled', slowing enemies' movement speed by 30%. The damage of this glyph increases with Luz's magic attack stat, making it a potent tool for area control and sustained damage output. Smart placement of the vortex can disrupt enemy formations and provide strategic advantages during team fights.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to turn up the heat!

abilities.name: Glyph Harmony: Empowered Casting
abilities.description: After successfully casting two different Glyph spells (Light, Ice, Plant, Fire) within 5 seconds of each other, Luz activates 'Glyph Harmony', enhancing her next ability within 8 seconds. This enhancement provides additional effects depending on the combination of glyphs used. (Fire+Ice): The next spell casts applies a root for 1 second to the main target.(Plant+ Ice): The next heal is 20% stronger.(Light+Ice): The next spell cast applies a slow for 1.5 seconds in a 250 unit radius around the main target.(Light+Fire) The next spell applies a damage over time dealing 20% of its damage over 4 seconds. This requires strategic planning and skilled execution to optimize the benefits, turning Luz into a versatile asset capable of adapting to various combat scenarios. If no ability is cast while Glyph Harmony is active, lose the effect.
abilities.flavorQuote: The right combination can change everything!

abilities.name: Glyph Lockdown
upgrades: (Empowered Snare) Increases the initial stun duration of 'Glyph Lockdown' by 0.5 seconds.
(Lingering Field) Increases the duration of 'Glyph Lockdown' by 1 second.
(Sustained Defense) Increases damage reduction from Stringbean by 10%.
(Glyph Stability) Initial stun of 1.5 seconds can not be reduced through tenacity or resilience.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Luz, drawing upon her unique understanding of glyphs, unleashes a powerful surge of energy in a designated area, a 600-radius circle, creating a field of interwoven glyphs. Stringbean, sensing the surge, transforms into a resilient shield, positioned at the heart of the glyph matrix to absorb incoming damage, granting Luz 20% damage reduction for the duration. Within this zone, enemies find their movements and attacks hampered, ensnared by the arcane energies. Each enemy caught within the Glyph Lockdown initially suffers a 1.5-second stun, immediately setting the stage for control. Following the stun, enemies are then afflicted with a stacking slow that begins at 20% and increases by 5% every half second up to a maximum slow of 60%, limiting their escape and making them vulnerable. Enemies standing in the glyph lockdown take X (15 + 5% of Luz's Max Health) magic damage per second, which also heals her for 40% of the damage dealt. For the next 4 seconds, the glyph matrix persists, continuously hindering and damaging foes. This Ultimate is designed to protect allies, control the battlefield, and open up opportunities for coordinated attacks, providing both a strong defensive and offensive edge.

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Glyph Combinations, Versatile Palisman Control

abilities.name: Celestial Soiree
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~16%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes healer-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: The Collector conjures a 'Celestial Soiree', a vibrant, shifting zone of starlight and lunar energies that persists for 5 seconds. As the Soiree begins, allies who choose to partake find themselves invigorated; their movement speed is heightened by 15%, allowing them to navigate the battlefield with newfound grace, while their attack speed increases by 10%, quickening their offensive capabilities. Simultaneously, opponents caught within the Collector's playful domain experience a momentary lapse in their awareness, their vision radius constricting by 20%, making it harder to track distant threats. Further amplifying the chaos, whenever an enemy attempts to channel a spell within the Soiree, there is a 5% probability that the Collector's whimsical influence will briefly 'distract' them, inflicting a 0.5 second silence. This interruption prevents them from completing their spell, a testament to the Collector's capricious control over the arcane energies within the zone. The casting of this festive illusion consumes 60 mana, a necessary sacrifice to maintain the Soiree’s intricate balance. However, the Collector must wait 12 seconds before orchestrating another Celestial Soiree, allowing the magical energies to replenish.

abilities.name: Puppet Strings
abilities.description: The Collector targets an enemy champion, transforming them into a wooden puppet for 2 seconds. While transformed, the target is silenced and their movement speed is reduced by 30%. The puppet form has significantly reduced defense (defense stat is halved), making them vulnerable to damage, reflecting the Collector's tendency to 'play' with his subjects. If 'Cosmic Dust-Up' is active in the area when Puppet Strings is cast, the duration of the puppet transformation is increased to 3 seconds, representing an enhanced game. This ability consumes 80 mana and has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now you're just a toy!

abilities.name: Starry Shield
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: The Collector summons a shield of starlight around a target ally, granting them a shield that absorbs up to 200 (+30% of The Collector's magic attack) damage for 4 seconds. The shield visually manifests as a rotating array of stars circling the protected ally. If the shielded ally is within a 'Cosmic Playground' zone, the shield's absorption is increased by 50%, demonstrating the Collector’s focus being amplified. Additionally, if the shield breaks or expires within the 'Cosmic Playground', it releases a burst of light, healing the ally for 50 (+10% of The Collector’s magic attack). This ability consumes 70 mana and has a cooldown of 10 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Here, have some stars to keep you safe!

abilities.name: Eternal Game (Ultimate)
abilities.description: The Collector traps all enemy champions within a large target area in a personal nightmare for 4 seconds. Each enemy experiences a different nightmare scenario tailored to their fears. During the nightmare, enemies are unable to move or attack and take 50 magic damage per second. At the end of the nightmare, enemies are released, but their stats (attack, defense, magic attack, magic defense) are reduced by 10% for 5 seconds, representing the lingering psychological impact. Casting this ability consumes 120 mana and has a cooldown of 90 seconds. The area is visually distorted with dreamlike imagery during the nightmare.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's play... forever!

abilities.name: Cosmic Empathy (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: The Collector's powers resonate with the emotional state of his closest ally (ally with highest 'Friendship' score, calculated by proximity and assist frequency). If the closest ally is below 40% HP, the Collector’s healing and shielding effects are increased by 20%, reflecting his protective instincts. If the closest ally has recently crowd-controlled an enemy (stun, snare, silence, etc.), the Collector gains 10% bonus movement speed for 3 seconds, showing his excitement at teamwork. If the closest ally deals a killing blow to an enemy champion, the Collector gains 10 bonus magic attack for 5 seconds, inspired by the thrill of the 'game'.
abilities.flavorQuote: We're friends, right?

abilities.name: Glyph Bolt
upgrades: Lv10: +10% damage scaling.
Lv50: Glyph Vulnerability increased to 8% and chance to critically hit.
Lv100: Base damage increased; Glyph duration increases to 3 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Amity channels raw magical energy, shaping it into a concentrated Glyph Bolt. She hurls a focused blast of light magic at a single target within her range, dealing physical damage equivalent to 40% of her Attack stat. The bolt crackles with residual energy, leaving the targeted enemy vulnerable for 2 seconds, increasing the damage they take from Amity's subsequent attacks by 5%. This amplified damage synergizes with other effects, enabling potential critical strikes, and can be extended by additional damage-boosting effects active on Amity, like those from teammates. This initial glyph application ensures that Amity's focused assaults consistently weaken her adversaries, preparing them for decisive blows. As Amity's mastery grows, the base damage increases and the efficacy of Glyph application improves, synergistically enhancing her overall fighting strategy.

abilities.name: Abomination Barrage
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Amity summons a series of three small, rapidly firing Abomination projectiles towards a targeted area. Each projectile deals 40 (+30% Magic ATK) magic damage upon impact. This ability generates 10 Abomination Reservoir per projectile that hits an enemy. If Amity has at least 50 Abomination Reservoir, she can expend it to empower this ability, causing the projectiles to explode on impact, dealing an additional 20 (+15% Magic ATK) magic damage in a small area around the initial target. The explosion also applies a 15% slow for 1.5 seconds. This enhanced effect can only occur once per cast, even if it hits multiple enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Precise strikes are often more effective than brute force. Observe, analyze, strike.

abilities.name: Amity's Bastion
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes utility-style interactions.
abilities.description: Amity shapes Abomination goo into a temporary bulwark at the target location, providing essential protection for her allies. This wall possesses 500 health, steadfastly absorbing all incoming damage until it is completely shattered. Any ally positioned directly behind this Abomination barrier benefits from a defensive boost, gaining 10 points of Magic Defense, further enhanced by an additional 10% of Amity’s own Magic Defense stat. In the process of conjuring this defensive structure, Amity generates 25 units of Abomination Reservoir. By expending 75 Abomination Reservoir, Amity can reinforce the bulwark. The reinforced wall's health is elevated to 1000, significantly increasing its durability, while it also gains the ability to retaliate against aggressors. Each time the fortified wall sustains damage, it lashes out, inflicting 20 magic damage, scaled by 10% of Amity's Magic Attack, upon the attacker. This counter-attack has a short cooldown of 1 second. Furthermore, allies who seek shelter behind this amplified barrier also gain 10% tenacity, reducing the duration of crowd control effects that might otherwise hinder their movements and abilities, allowing them to maintain combat effectiveness.

abilities.name: Abomination Reservoir
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~14% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Amity generates Abomination Reservoir by casting spells, which she can expend to empower her other abilities or create Abomination constructs for protection. Each ability description details how much Abomination Reservoir it generates, and how much is required/consumed to empower it.
abilities.flavorQuote: The essence of abomination magic lies not just in creation, but in the artful conservation and application of power.

abilities.name: Enhanced Transmutation
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Amity targets an ally, enhancing their next basic attack within 5 seconds. The enhanced attack deals an additional 30 (+20% Magic ATK) magic damage and applies a debuff that increases the target's damage dealt by 10% for 3 seconds. If the target is already affected by a similar damage buff, this ability instead extends the duration of the existing buff by 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 5 seconds total duration. This ability generates 15 Abomination Reservoir. For 60 Abomination Reservoir, Amity can also grant the target a small shield for 100 health lasting 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little arcane assistance can go a long way. Maximize our advantages at every turn.

abilities.name: Abomination Barrage
upgrades: Buff: Ability scale improved. Gains extra potency at late levels.
Nerf: Reduced peak potency by ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
Role realignment: Emphasizes controller-style interactions.
abilities.description: Amity, gathering her focus for 1.5 seconds, unleashes a coordinated Abomination assault. First, a hulking Abomination construct surges forth in a line, smashing through enemies and inflicting 120 (+60% Magic ATK) magic damage, tossing them skyward with a 1-second knockup. As the construct reaches the end of its charge, it detonates in a powerful explosion, dealing an additional 80 (+40% Magic ATK) magic damage to all caught within its radius. This ability also grants Amity 50 Abomination Reservoir. Should Amity's Abomination Reservoir be brimming at its maximum capacity of 200, the explosion leaves a viscous, lingering pool of Abomination goo that persists for 5 seconds. Enemies trudging through this goo find their movement speed reduced by 30% and their magic defense diminished by 20 (+10% Magic ATK).

abilities.description: Eda throws a concoction brewed with Owl Beast magic toward the target location. Upon impact, the brew explodes in a burst of wild magic, dealing 80 (+60% of Magical Attack) magic damage to enemies caught within the blast radius. However, the capricious nature of Eda's curse introduces an element of unpredictability: There is a 30% chance the 'Cursed Magic' triggers. When triggered, the Owl Beast magic either heals allies for 50 (+40% of Magical Attack) within the same radius instead or manifests as a sticky, dark sludge that slows enemies in the area by 30% for 3 seconds. The area affected by the explosion is significant, granting Eda considerable zoning potential. Enemies struck also gain a stacking debuff from her unpredictable magic called 'Cursed Touch' that increases damage taken from Eda's subsequent abilities by 5% for 5 seconds, stacking up to a maximum of 20%, making them more vulnerable to her further attacks. This ability has a moderate cooldown of 8 seconds, allowing Eda to consistently apply pressure and control key areas on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Owlbert's Diversion
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

abilities.description: Eda sends Owlbert to a target location, where he hovers, creating a small zone of control. Enemies entering the zone are taunted, prioritizing attacks against Owlbert. Owlbert has X HP and Y armor. If 'Cursed Magic' is triggered (40% chance), Owlbert instead becomes a decoy, appearing as Eda herself, mimicking her actions but dealing no damage. This decoy explodes after 5 seconds, dealing X magic damage in a small area. If the decoy is destroyed before the 5 seconds, it explodes immediately. Eda can recast this ability to reposition Owlbert or detonate the decoy early, but at half the damage. Enemies will target the decoy over the real Eda, giving her the opportunity to reposition or set up other abilities. The taunt effect lasts for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Go get 'em, buddy... or not. Surprise!

abilities.name: Detachable Decoy
abilities.description: Eda detaches one of her limbs (usually an arm) and throws it forward, creating a slow-moving projectile. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching the maximum range, the limb explodes, dealing X magic damage and stunning enemies for 1.5 seconds. There is a 20% chance for 'Cursed Magic' to trigger: instead of stunning, the limb attaches to the first enemy hit, slowing them by 50% for 3 seconds and dealing X damage per second. Eda can have a maximum of two Detached Limbs active at one time. If she reaches her limit, the first Limb detonates automatically. Eda regenerates a limb every 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Eh, I wasn't using that anyway!

abilities.name: Embrace the Curse
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Eda succumbs to the Owl Beast's influence, transforming for 15 seconds. While transformed, Eda gains 30% increased attack damage and 20% increased movement speed, becoming immune to all crowd control effects. During this period, Exploding Apple Blood is replaced with a powerful Wing Barrage, unleashing a cone-shaped blast of feathers that deals 150 + (50% Magic Power) damage to enemies within its range. Owlbert's Diversion morphs into a piercing Owl Beast Shriek, a wave of sonic energy that deals 100 + (40% Magic Power) damage and fears enemies for 1.5 seconds. Detachable Decoy evolves into a ferocious Claw Swipe, a melee attack that deals 200 + (60% Magic Power) damage in a small area around Eda. However, Eda's connection to the curse is volatile; there's a 10% chance for 'Cursed Surge' to trigger upon activation. If triggered, the transformation extends by 5 seconds, but during this extended period, Eda uncontrollably attacks allies as well as enemies with the full force of her transformed abilities. The Owl Beast also gains power over time, accumulating a stacking buff that grants 2% additional damage per second while active. After the transformation concludes, the strain leaves Eda stunned for 2 seconds as she returns to her human form.

abilities.name: Wild Magic Affinity
abilities.description: Eda gains 10% increased magic damage. Additionally, every time Eda triggers 'Cursed Magic', she gains a stack of 'Unstable Power', increasing her magic attack by X per stack. Stacks are capped at 5, and decay one stack at a time every 5 seconds. When Eda reaches 5 stacks, her next ability will not trigger 'Cursed Magic', but will be greatly enhanced, increasing its damage/duration/size by 50%. This effect cleanses all stacks of Unstable Power. This passive promotes skillful play, rewarding players who strategically manage their 'Cursed Magic' procs and build stacks of 'Unstable Power' for devastating combos. This encourages diverse and adaptable playstyles centered around managing the chaos of Eda's wild magic.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little chaos never hurt anyone... much.

abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Dominion's Aura
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~42%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: King's presence inspires his allies and intimidates his foes. Allied champions within 700 units of King gain 5% increased Ability Haste and 3% increased movement speed. Enemy champions within the same range have their attack damage reduced by 4% and receive 1 stack of 'Subjugation' every 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. King generates 1 Titan Echo every time an enemy champion gains a stack of Subjugation. This effect encourages King to stay close to his team while subtly weakening the opposing team's damage output, creating opportunities for coordinated engagements. Remember: Even small advantages can be decisive on the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bow before your King! Or at least, try to keep up.

abilities.name: Sonic Edict
abilities.description: King unleashes a targeted sonic shout in a cone-shaped area (600 units range, 60-degree angle). Enemies caught in the blast take 70 (+30% of Magic Attack) magic damage and are slowed by 20% for 1.5 seconds. If King has at least 3 Titan Echoes, he can expend them to enhance the shout: the cone's width increases to 90 degrees, the slow effect is amplified to 40%, and the duration is extended to 2.5 seconds. This amplified effect allows King to peel more effectively for his carries or set up extended crowd control chains for his team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear my decree! And try not to get deafened.

abilities.name: Titan's Echo Location
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: King emits a pulse, briefly revealing the location of all enemies within a 900-unit radius for 3 seconds. Revealed enemies also take 40 (+20% of Magic Attack) magic damage. If King possesses at least 5 Titan Echoes, he can spend them to apply 'Marked' to all revealed enemies for 4 seconds. 'Marked' enemies take 10% increased damage from all sources. This ability provides valuable scouting information and enables coordinated burst damage on priority targets. Knowing the enemy's position is half the battle, use this to control objectives.
abilities.flavorQuote: I know where you're hiding, you can't escape my royal senses!

abilities.name: Glyphic Mandate
abilities.description: King carves a glyph onto the ground, creating a zone that lasts for 5 seconds. Allies who enter the zone gain a shield absorbing 80 (+25% of Magic Attack) damage for 3 seconds. Enemies who enter the zone take 60 (+20% of Magic Attack) magic damage per second and are silenced for 0.75 seconds. If King has at least 4 Titan Echoes, he can spend them to enlarge the glyph zone by 50% and increase the shield and damage values by 30%. This ability is crucial for controlling chokepoints, protecting allies during engages, and zoning out enemy carries. A well-placed glyph can completely change the course of a fight.
abilities.flavorQuote: By the power vested in me, you shall be shielded... or silenced!

abilities.name: Titan's Roar
abilities.description: King channels for 1.5 seconds, then unleashes a devastating roar in a massive area (1200 unit radius). Enemies in the area take 150 (+50% of Magic Attack) magic damage and are knocked back 400 units. For every enemy champion hit, King generates 2 Titan Echoes. If King has at least 7 Titan Echoes upon casting, he can expend them to apply 'Terrified' to all enemies hit for 2 seconds. 'Terrified' enemies flee uncontrollably away from King at 300 movement speed. This ultimate ability can initiate fights, peel for allies, or disrupt enemy formations on a grand scale. A perfectly timed roar can turn a losing battle into a victory.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hear my call! Tremble before the power of a Titan!

abilities.name: Fireball
upgrades: Lv10: Increases Burn duration by 1 second.
Lv50: Applies a small knockback effect on hit.
Lv100: Fireball chains to a nearby enemy dealing 25% less damage.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Mario hurls a blazing sphere of fire, incinerating his foes with a ranged attack. This fiery projectile targets a single enemy, dealing initial physical damage equal to 50% of Mario's ATK plus a base fire damage. The Fireball then applies a 'Burn' status effect for 3 seconds, inflicting additional fire damage equal to 10% of Mario's ATK per second. The 'Burn' effect stacks up to 3 times, increasing the damage per second accordingly. Subsequent Fireballs refresh the duration of the 'Burn' effect. This ability has a short cast time, leaving Mario briefly vulnerable. The range of the Fireball is medium, allowing Mario to strike from a safe distance. Enemies afflicted with a second stack of 'Burn' are also stunned for 0.5 seconds, interrupting their actions. With three stacks, 'Burn' becomes 'Inferno', increasing fire damage to 20% of Mario's ATK per second and stunning them for 1 full second.

abilities.name: Super Slide
abilities.description: Mario performs a powerful slide tackle in a designated direction. This slide covers a substantial distance, dealing X damage to enemies in its path and knocking them up slightly. If the slide connects with an enemy, Mario gains the 'Momentum Plunge' buff for 3 seconds, increasing his movement speed by 20% and his next basic attack damage by 30%. This ability has a short cooldown, allowing for frequent use and aggressive plays. Successfully hitting an enemy with Super Slide also reduces the cooldown of 'Ground Pound' by 1 second, encouraging combo play. The slide tackle animation is quick and responsive, allowing for skillful maneuvering and evasion.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Here I come!"

abilities.name: Ground Pound
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).
abilities.description: Mario leaps into the air and slams down onto the ground with a mighty Ground Pound. Upon impact, enemies within a small radius take X magic damage and are briefly stunned for 0.75 seconds. This ability can be used to interrupt enemy abilities or set up combos. If Mario has the 'Momentum Plunge' buff, the Ground Pound's radius is increased by 25% and applies a brief slow (20% for 1.5 seconds) in addition to the stun. The cooldown of Ground Pound is moderately long, but can be reduced by successfully hitting enemies with 'Super Slide', promoting aggressive slide tackle play.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Wahoo!"

abilities.name: Red Comet
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes assassin-style interactions.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Mario channels his inner Super Star, becoming a blur of red-hot speed for 5 seconds. During this time, Mario's movement speed is amplified, allowing him to swiftly traverse the battlefield. As he dashes, he leaves behind a burning trail of star fragments for 3 seconds. Enemies caught in this fiery wake suffer 20 true damage per second for 2 seconds, marking them as vulnerable. At the end of Red Comet, Mario's next basic attack within 4 seconds gains 'Star Power', dealing an additional burst of true damage equivalent to 125% of the total damage dealt by the star fragments to all marked enemies hit by the attack. Using Super Slide during Red Comet further enhances his speed, increasing the movement speed boost of 'Momentum Plunge' to 50% and boosting basic attack damage by 75%. This ability turns Mario into a high-risk, high-reward assassin, focusing on swift strikes and exploiting enemy weaknesses.

abilities.name: Plumber's Grit
abilities.description: Mario's innate resilience as a seasoned plumber grants him increased tenacity. He gains a flat 15% reduction to the duration of stuns, slows, and other crowd control effects. Furthermore, each successful Super Slide hit grants a stacking 5% tenacity bonus for 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 25%. This encourages aggressive play and makes Mario more resistant to crowd control when chaining slide tackles. This passive synergizes directly with Mario's core kit, allowing him to maintain momentum and disrupt enemies more effectively even when targeted with disabling effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Let's-a go! Nothing can stop me!"

abilities.name: Superstar Rally
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Mario summons a gigantic Super Star, becoming invulnerable and unstoppable for 7 seconds. During this time, his movement speed is drastically increased, and his Super Slide ability's range and damage are doubled. Each successful slide tackle during Superstar Rally instantly defeats non-boss enemies and deals massive damage to boss-type enemies. After the Super Star effect ends, Mario releases a final Ground Pound that deals X true damage in a massive area around him. This ultimate ability is designed to be a game-changing burst of power, allowing Mario to single-handedly turn the tide of a fight.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm-a invincible!"

Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Royal Blessing
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Peach bestows a royal blessing upon a chosen ally, mending their wounds and bolstering their defenses. The targeted ally is healed for X HP and gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 20% of their maximum health for 3 seconds. If Peach has accumulated any stacks of 'Royal Grace', consuming one stack will increase the healing amount by 25% and the shield strength by an additional 10% of the ally's maximum health. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each subsequent application of Royal Blessing within 5 seconds, down to a minimum of 4 seconds. Peach delicately waves her hand, and a soft pink aura envelops the ally, providing immediate relief and temporary resilience.
abilities.flavorQuote: May this blessing keep you safe from harm!

abilities.name: Parasol Defense
abilities.description: Peach elegantly deploys her parasol, creating a protective zone that mitigates incoming damage for herself and nearby allies. For 4 seconds, all allies within a 3-unit radius of Peach receive a 30% damage reduction from all sources. Additionally, if an enemy attempts to pass through the parasol's zone, they are briefly slowed by 40% for 1.5 seconds. While Parasol Defense is active, Peach's movement speed is reduced by 20%. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. The parasol shimmers with a soft, ethereal light, deflecting projectiles and providing a comforting sense of security to those sheltered beneath it.
abilities.flavorQuote: Under my parasol, you're safe from the storm!

abilities.name: Royal Interruption
upgrades: Increases the stun duration of Royal Interruption by 0.25 seconds.
Decreases the cooldown of Royal Interruption by 1 second.
Increases the damage dealt by Royal Interruption by 20%.
Royal Flourish stacks now last 6 seconds instead of 4.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: With a mischievous glint in her eye, Princess Peach momentarily adopts a poised, defensive stance for 1.5 seconds, poised to transform an opponent's aggression into their own undoing. If an enemy hero attempts to strike Peach with a basic attack during this brief window, she gracefully sidesteps the blow and retaliates with a dazzling display of royal power. A shimmering fan of iridescent energy unfurls in a 90-degree cone directly in front of her, inflicting 75 (+45% of Magic Power) magic damage to any foe caught within its radiant embrace. Not only does this sudden burst of energy deal significant harm, but it also leaves her opponents temporarily bewildered, stunning them for a precious 0.75 seconds, enough time for Peach to reposition or for her allies to capitalize on their vulnerability. However, should no enemy attack trigger the counter within the allotted 1.5 seconds, Peach instead gains one stack of 'Royal Flourish,' increasing her magic damage by 10% for 4 seconds to a maximum of 3 stacks, rewarding careful timing and strategic anticipation. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds, requiring careful consideration of when to deploy its deceptive power.

abilities.name: Royal Grace (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Whenever Peach directly assists an ally (healing, shielding, or buffing), she gains one stack of 'Royal Grace', up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Royal Grace increases Peach's magic defense by 5 and her healing and shield potency by 3%. Upon reaching 5 stacks, Peach's next use of 'Royal Treatment' gains a bonus effect, granting allies a 15% speed boost for 4 seconds. Royal Grace stacks decay one stack every 10 seconds if no further assists are provided, encouraging continuous support to maintain maximum effectiveness. The more Peach helps, the stronger she becomes, embodying her unwavering dedication to her friends and kingdom.
abilities.flavorQuote: My grace flows strongest when I help others.

abilities.name: Royal Treatment
abilities.description: Peach unleashes a wave of pure, benevolent energy, providing extensive aid to her entire team. All allies within a large radius are instantly healed for X HP and receive a temporary buff that increases their attack damage by 20% and their defense by 15% for 6 seconds. For each stack of 'Royal Grace' Peach possesses at the time of casting, the healing amount is increased by 10%, and the duration of the attack and defense buff is extended by 1 second, up to a maximum of 10 seconds. This ability has a 120-second cooldown. A radiant aura emanates from Peach, washing over her allies and filling them with renewed vigor and determination, showcasing the boundless power of her compassion.
abilities.flavorQuote: I bestow upon you the strength to persevere!
