abilities.description: Agent Jones fractures reality at a target location, creating a Reality Rift. Upon activation, the rift summons a random weapon from the Chapter 1 Season 1 loot pool: Assault Rifle, Burst Assault Rifle, Scoped Assault Rifle, Pump Shotgun, Tactical Shotgun, Submachine Gun, Tactical Submachine Gun, Suppressed Submachine Gun, Pistol, Revolver, Bolt-Action Sniper Rifle, or Semi-Auto Sniper Rifle. The summoned weapon is instantly equipped, replacing Jones's current weapon. The weapon has limited ammo (50% of max capacity), which cannot be replenished normally, and disappears after expending all ammo. The Reality Rift persists for 5 seconds after the weapon is claimed, granting vision in a small radius. Cooldown: 14 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see what surprises the past holds.

abilities.name: Temporal Trap
abilities.description: Agent Jones lays down a Temporal Trap at a target location within a short range. The trap remains invisible until triggered by an enemy. When triggered, the trap activates, summoning either a Damage Trap, Ceiling Zapper, or Wall Dynamo from Chapter 1 Season 1. These traps function identically to their original versions, dealing damage to enemies who trigger them and then disappearing. The type of trap summoned is random. The placement range is short, requiring careful positioning. Each trap deals 275 damage and can trigger once. Cooldown: 17 seconds. Maximum of 2 traps can be active at a time. If a third trap is placed, the oldest one disappears.
abilities.flavorQuote: They won't see this coming...from any timeline.

abilities.name: Fractured Flicker
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Agent Jones briefly phases out of reality, becoming invulnerable and untargetable for 1 second. During this time, his movement speed is increased by 20%. After the phase ends, he reappears at his original location. This ability can be used defensively to avoid incoming attacks or offensively to reposition. Using Fractured Flicker incurs a brief moment of vulnerability upon reappearing, demanding precise timing. This ability no longer cleanses crowd control. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to disappear...just for a moment.

abilities.name: Chronal Anomaly (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Each time Agent Jones uses 'Reality Fracture' or 'Temporal Trap', he gains a stack of 'Chronal Instability.' Each stack increases his damage output by 2% and his trap damage by 4%. Stacks last for 7 seconds. Upon reaching 5 stacks of Chronal Instability, Jones triggers a 'Chronal Overload,' consuming all stacks and opening a Reality Rift at his location, dropping a random consumable/healing item from Chapter 1 Season 1: Bandages, Med Kit, Shield Potion, Slurp Juice, Bush, or Smoke Grenade. The Overload also grants Jones a 10% speed boost for 3 seconds. Cooldown on Chronal Overload: 25 seconds after activation.
abilities.flavorQuote: The timelines are converging...and I'm just getting started.

abilities.name: Loot Arsenal: Stance Shift
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader cycles through her 'Loot Arsenal,' switching between three weapon stances: Assault Rifle, Shotgun, and Sniper. Each stance grants unique combat benefits. Assault Rifle stance grants +15% attack speed and +10% movement speed, allowing for sustained DPS and enhanced mobility. Shotgun stance grants +20% damage to the next basic attack and applies 'Vulnerability' for 3 seconds, increasing damage taken by the target by 10%. Sniper stance grants +50% critical hit damage and +2 range to basic attacks, enabling long-range burst damage. Each stance lasts for 6 seconds, followed by a 1-second cooldown before another stance can be selected. Utilizing an ability during a stance will extend the duration of the current stance by 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Pick your poison; I've got a full armory.

abilities.name: Boogie Bomb Blast
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader tosses a Boogie Bomb towards a targeted area. Enemies caught within the bomb's blast radius (3 unit radius) are forced to dance for 2.5 seconds, rendering them unable to attack or use abilities. This effect is broken upon taking damage exceeding 15% of their max health. Additionally, affected enemies suffer a 10% reduction in movement speed for 4 seconds after the dance concludes. The Boogie Bomb has a cooldown of 12 seconds. If Raven Team Leader is in the Shotgun Stance when casting Boogie Bomb Blast, the slow effect increases to 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everybody dance now!

abilities.name: Nightmare Snare
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader carefully lays down a Nightmare Snare at a designated location, cloaked in shadow and waiting for an unsuspecting victim. The Snare remains hidden until an enemy wanders within a 1.5 unit radius, at which point the ethereal trap springs to life, unleashing a burst of shadowy energy. This blast inflicts 150 points of physical damage, augmented by 30% of Raven Team Leader's total attack power, upon all enemies caught within its grasp. The dark energy lingers, causing additional damage over a duration of 3 seconds, dealing 40 physical damage per second, scaling with 10% of Raven Team Leader's attack power per second. After this agonizing encounter, the Nightmare Snare dissipates, its dark magic spent. Raven Team Leader is capable of holding a maximum of 2 Nightmare Snares at any given moment, with a new Snare being conjured into existence every 15 seconds, replenishing the stockpile up to the maximum capacity. Furthermore, should Raven Team Leader be channeling the focused energy of the Sniper Stance when deploying a Nightmare Snare, the trap's detection radius is significantly enhanced to 2.5 units, making it even more challenging for enemies to detect and evade the sinister surprise.

abilities.name: Dark Embrace (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Damage re-calibration: Minor adjustment to damage multipliers for better balance.
(Patch) Role Emphasis: Enhanced damage output to better align with damage-focused playstyle.
abilities.description: Raven Team Leader fully embraces the power of the storm within, becoming a conduit for destruction. For 8 seconds, she enters a state of Dark Embrace, gaining the benefits of all her combat stances simultaneously, weaving between offensive styles with seamless fluidity. In this augmented state, her Assault Rifle's rapid-fire capabilities are amplified with increased attack and movement speed, allowing her to dart around the battlefield while maintaining a relentless barrage. Her Shotgun unleashes devastating empowered basic attacks that inflict Vulnerability for 3 seconds, causing enemies to take 20% increased damage from all sources. Furthermore, the precision of her Sniper Rifle is enhanced, significantly boosting critical hit damage by 60% and extending her effective range. During Dark Embrace, the cooldowns of Boogie Bomb Blast and Damage Trap Deployment are reduced by 50%, enabling a constant stream of disruptive crowd control and area denial. To weather the storm of incoming attacks, Raven Team Leader gains a shield that absorbs damage equal to 20% of her maximum health for the duration. The activation of Dark Embrace also grants immunity to all crowd control effects for 1.5 seconds, ensuring that she remains unyielding in her assault.

abilities.name: Grove Street Tactics
abilities.description: CJ gains 1 stack of 'Turf Control' whenever he damages an enemy champion with an ability (max 3 stacks). Each stack of 'Turf Control' grants CJ 3% increased movement speed and 2% bonus damage to his next basic attack. If CJ uses 'Get Strapped' or 'Drive-By', all stacks of 'Turf Control' are consumed, enhancing that ability's effect. Stacks last for 5 seconds, refreshing upon gaining a new stack. This passive encourages aggressive ability usage and rewards CJ for successfully harassing his opponents while staying mobile.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Grove Street. Home. At least it was before I ****ed everything up."

abilities.name: Represent
abilities.description: CJ flashes his Grove Street colors, buffing a target ally. The target ally gains 15% increased attack speed and 10% increased movement speed for 4 seconds. If CJ has any stacks of 'Turf Control', consuming all stacks increases the duration of the buff by 1 second per stack. This ability serves as CJ's primary supportive tool, allowing him to enhance the offensive capabilities of his allies. Represent can turn the tide of a skirmish or help an ally secure a kill. The relatively short duration makes strategic timing crucial. Prioritize allies who can best utilize the attack and movement speed boost.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Green Sabre!"

abilities.name: Drive-By
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: CJ performs a quick drive-by, unleashing a barrage of bullets in a targeted direction. CJ dashes a short distance in the target direction firing bullets dealing 80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 (+50% of his attack damage) physical damage to enemies in a cone. If CJ has stacks of 'Turf Control', consuming all stacks, the ability's range is increased by 10% per stack and applies a 20% slow for 2 seconds. 'Drive-By' is a potent damage tool. It provides both burst damage and zone control. Position yourself to maximize the number of enemies hit by the cone, especially when enhanced with 'Turf Control' stacks for added range and utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: "All we had to do, was follow the damn train, CJ!"

abilities.name: Get Strapped
abilities.description: CJ prepares for a fight, gaining a shield that absorbs 50 / 75 / 100 / 125 / 150 (+30% of his attack damage) damage for 3 seconds. Upon activation, CJ also throws a molotov cocktail at a target location, creating a burning area that deals 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 (+15% of his magic attack) magic damage per second to enemies within. If CJ has stacks of 'Turf Control', consuming all stacks, the shield is increased by 20% per stack, and the duration of the burning area is increased by 0.5 seconds per stack. This ability is excellent for initiating fights and securing objectives. The shield provides crucial survivability.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'll have two number 9s, a number 9 large, a number 6 with extra dip..."

abilities.name: Taking Back the Streets
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~35%).
abilities.description: CJ rallies his allies, granting all nearby allied champions 20 / 30 / 40% increased damage and 15 / 20 / 25 tenacity for 8 seconds. Enemies caught in the area when the ability is cast are feared for 1 second. CJ shouts "Taking back the streets!", inspiring his team and demoralizing his enemies. This ultimate is a game-changer in team fights, providing a significant boost to allied damage output and survivability while briefly incapacitating enemies. Position yourself strategically to affect as many allies and enemies as possible with the initial fear and subsequent buffs. The combination of damage amplification and tenacity can easily swing a team fight in your favor.
abilities.flavorQuote: "This is for my homies in Grove Street!"

abilities.description: Lisa channels her intellectual prowess to generate a protective barrier around herself or an allied champion. Upon activation, the target ally gains a shield absorbing up to X damage (scales with Lisa's magic atk) for 5 seconds. This shield also reflects 20% of incoming damage back to the attacker as magic damage. If cast on Lisa, the reflected damage is increased to 30% and she gains +15% tenacity for the duration. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds and costs 60 mana. Successfully casting this ability contributes to the 'Saxophone Solo' sequence: First Note.
abilities.flavorQuote: Knowledge is the ultimate defense.

abilities.name: Eco-Friendly Taunt
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Lisa leverages her environmental activism to draw enemy attention. Upon activation, Lisa releases a sonic wave shaped like recycling symbol, taunting all nearby enemies within a radius for 2.5 seconds. Taunted enemies are forced to attack Lisa, while also suffering a 10% reduction in their attack damage. Following the taunt, Lisa gains a stacking buff that increases her defense by 10 for each taunted enemy, lasting 4 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds and consumes 70 mana. Completing the sequence for 'Saxophone Solo', casting Eco-Friendly Taunt empowers Lisa.
abilities.flavorQuote: Think globally, act locally, taunt universally!

abilities.name: Vegetarian Vitality
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Lisa's commitment to vegetarianism enhances her and her allies resilience. Lisa regenerates 2% of her maximum HP every 5 seconds. Additionally, nearby allied champions (within a radius) receive 1% HP regeneration every 5 seconds. When Lisa successfully completes a 'Saxophone Solo' sequence, this passive regeneration is doubled for both Lisa and her allies for 8 seconds. When Lisa falls below 25% HP, she automatically consumes a 'Tofu Turkey', instantly healing her for 15% of her maximum health. This effect has a 60-second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Goodness grows from the ground up.

abilities.name: Bleeding Gums Rhapsody
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Peak performance reduced: Attack Damage boost reduced by ~16%.
(Role Realignment) Utility Emphasis: Now offers extended mobility instead of raw damage.
abilities.description: Lisa pours her heart into a soulful saxophone solo, channeling the spirit of Bleeding Gums Murphy to inspire her allies and confound her enemies. For the first 4 seconds, Lisa becomes immune to any movement-impairing crowd control, serenading the battlefield with notes of pure jazz. During this prelude, allies within a generous radius of 600 units become invigorated, gaining a 20% boost to their movement speed and a 15% increase to their attack damage, allowing them to reposition and strike with renewed vigor. Simultaneously, enemies caught within a smaller, more concentrated radius of 400 units find themselves hampered by Lisa's bluesy wail, suffering a 20% reduction to their movement speed and enduring magic damage equal to 15% of Lisa's Magic Attack every second. As the final notes of the solo fade, Lisa unleashes a wave of restorative harmony, instantly healing all allies within the 600-unit radius for 15% of their missing health, patching them up for the coming battle. This inspiring ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds, and costs 150 Mana.

abilities.name: Jazz Intervention
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability Power scaling increased, amplifying shield strength.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Crowd control immunity duration extended, enhancing self-preservation.
(Patch) Role Realignment: Ability interactions now emphasize jack-of-all-trades potential.
abilities.description: Lisa's innate understanding of harmony and discord allows her to strategically improvise based on battlefield conditions, supporting her team through carefully timed 'Saxophone Solos'. When Lisa casts Brainiac Barrier followed by Tree Hugger's Rebuke within 8 seconds, she orchestrates a 'Progressive Harmony Solo'. This resonates with up to three nearby allies, granting each a shield that absorbs 40 + (10% of Lisa's Ability Power) magic damage for 4 seconds, layering a defensive melody. Alternatively, casting Tree Hugger's Rebuke followed by Brainiac Barrier within 8 seconds triggers 'Dizzying Bebop Riff', creating a disruptive fanfare. This cleanses all debuffs from Lisa and grants her temporary immunity to crowd control effects for 2.5 seconds, as the complex rhythm disorients her foes' attempts to control her. However, to prevent over-reliance on these instantaneous compositions, both 'Progressive Harmony Solo' and 'Dizzying Bebop Riff' can only be activated once every 15 seconds, requiring calculated sequences to maximize their impact.

upgrades: Lv10: Enhances lightning potency and slightly reduces cooldown.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect: on critical hit, apply a minor Shock debuff.

(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Lightning Legs Barrage is a high-speed, multi-hitting physical attack channeling a burst of electrifying energy. Chun Li unleashes a rapid series of powerful kicks targeted at a single foe within close range. Each kick delivers a precise dose of physical damage, with the final kick imbued with a surge of elemental lightning damage. The skill's damage scaling is primarily influenced by Chun Li's ATK stat, with a secondary contribution from her SPD stat. This technique doesn't just deal damage; it also serves a tactical purpose. Each successive kick incrementally reduces the target's Stability, making them more vulnerable to stagger and follow-up attacks from allies. The lightning-charged final kick has an increased critical strike chance, offering a satisfying burst of enhanced damage if it lands. Finally, should the target be afflicted with any elemental ailment (e.g., burn, freeze), the final kick's lightning damage is amplified, creating synergy with other party members. The ability is ideal for breaking down enemy defenses and capitalizing on elemental synergies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Hundred Rending Kicks! Witness my speed!

abilities.name: Rising Skylark Kick
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Chun-Li focuses her inner Kiko energy, unleashing a powerful, spiraling kick known as the Rising Skylark Kick. She launches herself skyward in a graceful arc, her leg a blur of motion. Enemies caught within the kick's trajectory suffer 80 (+60% Magic Attack) magic damage and are propelled into the air, rendered airborne for 1.5 seconds. Upon landing, Chun-Li's discipline manifests as 'Kiko Resilience', granting her bonus magic resistance equal to 15% of her current magic attack for 4 seconds, reinforcing her defenses. If 'Kiko Resilience' is already active, instead of further magic resistance, she gains a protective shield fueled by her Kiko energy, absorbing damage equal to 10% of her maximum health for 4 seconds, mitigating incoming attacks. The height and distance of Chun-Li's aerial maneuver can be subtly adjusted using directional inputs during activation, allowing her to deftly evade threats or aggressively pursue adversaries. Furthermore, enemies lifted by the Skylark Kick become vulnerable to aerial assaults, suffering increased damage from subsequent airborne attacks, taking an additional 10% damage from Chun-Li's aerial strikes for the next 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Kikoken Focus
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Chun-Li channels her Kiko Energy to launch a projectile forward, dealing magic damage to the first enemy hit. The base damage is relatively low, but this ability has a unique interaction with her 'Pressure Point' mechanic. For each stack of 'Pressure Point' on the target, the Kikoken's damage is increased by 10%. If 'Kiko Infusion' is active, the Kikoken pierces through enemies, dealing reduced damage (50%) to subsequent targets and applies a slow (20% movement speed reduction for 2 seconds). This ability is crucial for both harassing enemies from a distance and setting up powerful burst damage opportunities. The projectile's speed increases with Chun-Li's speed stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the force of my spirit energy!

abilities.name: Lightning Legs (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scaling improved — Gains extra potency at late levels, and Kiko Surge bonus duration increased.
(Patch) Role realignment: Ability further emphasizes assassin-style burst damage interactions.
abilities.description: Chun-Li's unparalleled speed and precision manifest as pure offensive power. She converts 12% of her total Speed into bonus Attack, reflecting her mastery of rapid strikes. Each successful connection of three consecutive Basic Attacks empowers her with 'Kiko Amplification'. The first three basic attacks that land on an enemy applies one stack each of 'Kiko Amplification' for a maximum of 3 stacks. Each stack increases Chun-Li's Magic Attack by 7%. Upon activating an Active Ability, Chun-Li expends all stacks of 'Kiko Amplification' to trigger 'Kiko Surge', enhancing her martial prowess. 'Kiko Surge' lasts for 2.5 seconds per 'Kiko Amplification' stack consumed. While under the effect of 'Kiko Surge', her Active Abilities receive bonus effects and deal an additional 20 (+5% Magic Attack) magic damage. Successfully connecting a basic attack during Kiko Surge extends its duration by .25 seconds up to a maximum of 2 seconds. This extension can only occur once per second.

abilities.name: Hoyokusen: Soaring Kiko Strike
upgrades: (Buff) Successful Hoyokusen execution now also grants a 30% movement speed increase for 3 seconds.
(Tuning) Increased base physical damage of the final kick from 150% to 175% of attack damage.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Chun-Li, channeling the very essence of her Kiko energy, unleashes a devastating flurry of kicks, culminating in a final, soaring strike. Upon activation, Chun-Li performs a rapid dash forward, spanning a distance of 7 meters. Should she collide with an enemy hero during this dash, the true power of the Hoyokusen is unleashed. She unleashes a blinding storm of seventeen lightning-fast kicks. During this sequence, Chun-Li is entirely invulnerable, immune to any form of crowd control, damage, or debuffs, showcasing her mastery and precision. The final kick in the sequence launches the target high into the air and deals 150% of her attack damage as physical damage. However, if Chun-Li has 'Kiko Infusion' active – achieved by successfully landing five consecutive auto-attacks or special attacks on enemy heroes - the final strike transcends mere physical damage. It instead deals true damage equal to 17.5% of the target's maximum health, bypassing armor and resistances, delivering a blow that even the most resilient foes cannot withstand. Moreover, the successful completion of the Hoyokusen's sequence grants Chun-Li unparalleled tactical advantage. It instantly resets the cooldowns of all her other active abilities, allowing her to chain her deadly attacks with devastating efficiency. Furthermore, for a duration of 4 seconds following the Hoyokusen, Chun-Li's attack speed is increased by 30%, amplifying her damage output even further. As the final kick connects, a fleeting, majestic image of a phoenix appears, symbolizing Chun-Li's unwavering spirit and her mastery of Kiko energy.

abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the darkness, and perish!

abilities.name: Denizen of Hell (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Akuma embodies the power of the Satsui no Hado. Whenever Akuma deals damage with an ability, he gains 1 stack of 'Satsui no Hado'. Each stack increases his damage dealt by 2%, up to a maximum of 15 stacks. However, for each stack of 'Satsui no Hado', Akuma's defense is reduced by 3% and damage taken is increased by 1%, representing the corrupting influence of the dark energy. When Akuma reaches 15 stacks, he enters 'Berserk' mode for 5 seconds, gaining 30% increased attack speed and critical hit chance, but his defense is reduced by an additional 15% and he takes 20% increased damage during the 'Berserk' phase.
abilities.flavorQuote: Power at any cost... is my creed!

abilities.name: Maximum Beat
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scaling enhanced, gaining increased potency at higher levels.
(Patch) Role Emphasis: This ability now reinforces controller-style interactions, emphasizing tactical gameplay.
abilities.description: Dee Jay executes a lightning-fast flurry of kicks, targeting a single enemy with a barrage of rhythmic strikes that deals damage and applies 'Rhythm Lock' for 3 seconds. 'Rhythm Lock' disrupts the target's focus, reducing their attack speed by 15% and slowing their movement speed by 10%. If 'Maximum Beat' is unleashed within 2 seconds of a preceding ability as part of 'Rhythm Flow', the effects of 'Rhythm Lock' are amplified. The attack speed reduction surges to 25%, and a 5% damage vulnerability debuff is applied, making the target more susceptible to subsequent attacks for the duration. Successfully landing this amplified 'Maximum Beat' grants Dee Jay a 'Tempo' stack, boosting his ability power by 3% per stack, stacking up to a maximum of 5 times for a total ability power increase of 15%. Each stack of 'Tempo' lasts for 6 seconds, incentivizing a proactive playstyle focused on chaining abilities and maintaining the rhythmic pressure to maximize Dee Jay’s supportive capabilities and overall impact on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Hype Wave
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~22%).
abilities.description: Dee Jay lays down a vibrant track, projecting a pulsating wave of sonic energy onto a chosen ally, granting them a 'Sonic Barrier' that lasts for 4 seconds. This 'Sonic Barrier' is designed to absorb incoming attacks, capable of mitigating up to 150 damage plus an additional amount equal to 10% of Dee Jay's magic attack power. Should the shielded ally be struck by an enemy attack while the 'Sonic Barrier' is active, they immediately gain the 'Sound Surge' status effect for 2 seconds. This 'Sound Surge' dramatically increases their offensive capabilities, boosting their attack damage by 10%. When activated as part of the 'Rhythm Flow', the 'Sonic Barrier' duration is extended to an impressive 6 seconds, ensuring prolonged protection. Furthermore, the 'Sound Surge' effect is enhanced, granting a 5% bonus to critical hit chance alongside the attack damage increase, amplifying their potential to deliver devastating blows. The successful execution of the 'Rhythm Flow' also triggers a personal benefit for Dee Jay, providing a burst of healing that restores 5% of his maximum health, allowing him to maintain his own well-being while supporting his team effectively.

abilities.name: Carnival Spin
upgrades: (Patch) Controller Emphasis: The kick's soundwave now lingers longer.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Dee Jay launches into a whirlwind of vibrant energy, executing a powerful spinning kick that strikes up to 3 nearby enemies within a 5-meter radius, dealing 80 (+40% Attack Power) physical damage to each and inflicting 'Rhythm Burn' for 4 seconds. 'Rhythm Burn' causes enemies to take 3% increased damage from all sources. When Carnival Spin is perfectly chained within Dee Jay's 'Rhythm Flow' (executed within 2 seconds after 'Rhythmic Beatdown' and 'Maximum Groove'), the 'Rhythm Burn' duration extends to 7 seconds, and the area of effect increases by 25%, affecting enemies within a 6.25-meter radius. Successfully completing the 'Rhythm Flow' sequence also empowers nearby allies, granting them a 7% increase to movement speed for 4 seconds, enabling them to aggressively capitalize on the increased damage vulnerability of their afflicted opponents, all while a thumping reggae beat pulses around them.

abilities.name: Tropical Tempo (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~47%).
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~50%).
abilities.description: Dee Jay gains increased benefits from performing actions within the 'Rhythm Flow' window. Successfully executing 'Rhythm Flow' sequences grants Dee Jay a 10% reduction in cooldowns for all abilities for 3 seconds. Additionally, each successful 'Rhythm Flow' increases the duration of Dee Jay's active buffs and debuffs by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 seconds, rewarding precise timing and strategic ability usage. Missing the 'Rhythm Flow' window incurs a minor penalty; Dee Jay's next ability cast will have its cooldown increased by 1 second, encouraging careful execution and rhythmic play.
abilities.flavorQuote: The rhythm is my strength!

abilities.name: Maximum Overdrive (Ultimate)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Dee Jay unleashes his ultimate musical and martial arts prowess, creating a 'Rhythm Zone' around him for 8 seconds. Allies within the 'Rhythm Zone' gain 15% increased damage and 10% increased movement speed. Enemies within the 'Rhythm Zone' have their healing reduced by 20% and receive 10% increased damage from Dee Jay's abilities. For each successful 'Rhythm Flow' performed by Dee Jay while 'Maximum Overdrive' is active, the 'Rhythm Zone' grants an additional 3% damage and speed boost to allies (stacking up to 3 times) and an additional 3% healing reduction and damage vulnerability to enemies. This ultimate ability demands precise timing and skillful ability sequencing to maximize its impact on both allies and enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Get ready for the ultimate performance!

abilities.name: Basic Attack

Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction

abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Roundillo Kick
abilities.description: Ayla performs a leaping kick, striking the target enemy. This attack deals 120% of Ayla's Attack Damage. If 'Primal Fury' stacks are available, consuming one stack grants this kick a guaranteed critical hit. Further, this empowered kick inflicts 'Minor Fracture,' reducing the target's Defense by 15% for 3 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 6 seconds. If no 'Primal Fury' stacks are present, the kick has a 15% chance to critically strike, granting Ayla one 'Primal Fury' stack on successful critical hit. The 'Minor Fracture' debuff cannot stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ayla kick! Make enemy fall!

abilities.name: Cat Attack
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ayla unleashes a flurry of scratches and bites, dealing damage over time. This attack deals 30% of Ayla's Attack Damage per second for 3 seconds. If 'Primal Fury' stacks are available, consuming one stack increases the damage per tick to 45% of Ayla's Attack Damage, and applies a 'Bleed' effect, dealing an additional 10% of Ayla's Attack Damage as True Damage over 3 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds. The 'Bleed' effect from 'Cat Attack' does not stack with itself. If the target is already bleeding, refresh the bleed duration instead. If 'Cat Attack' critically hits, Ayla gains 2 stacks of 'Primal Fury'.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ayla scratch! Hurt lots!

abilities.name: Charm
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Ayla attempts to charm the target enemy, stealing a portion of their stats. Ayla steals a random stat (Attack, Defense, Magic Attack, Magic Defense, or Speed) equal to 10% of the target's value for 5 seconds. If 'Primal Fury' stacks are available, consuming one stack guarantees the steal, increases the stolen amount to 15%, and grants Ayla one 'Primal Fury' stack. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. Stats cannot be stolen from the same target again for 8 seconds. This ability has a 30% chance to critically hit, which reduces the cooldown by 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ayla take! Make Ayla stronger!

abilities.name: Primal Instincts
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~8% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ayla's critical hits grant her stacks of 'Primal Fury'. Each stack increases her critical hit chance by 2% (max 10 stacks). Consuming stacks with abilities removes the corresponding critical hit chance bonus. Additionally, Ayla has a natural 20% resistance to Fire damage. Every 5 critical hits landed, Ayla steals 5% of the target's highest stat, but the effect is halved against bosses. If Ayla reaches max stacks of 'Primal Fury', her next basic attack has a 50% chance to stun the target for 0.75 seconds, consuming all stacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ayla feel power! Ready to fight!

abilities.name: Dino Tail
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~24%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~50%).
abilities.description: Ayla unleashes a devastating tail spin, striking all enemies in a large radius. This attack deals 200% of Ayla's Attack Damage. For each stack of 'Primal Fury' Ayla possesses, this damage is increased by 10%, consuming all stacks. If any enemy is below 25% health, this attack executes them. Enemies hit by this ability are knocked back a short distance. The ability has a 30% chance to inflict 'Fear,' causing enemies to flee for 1.5 seconds. This ultimate has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Ayla smash! All fall down!

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Brain Blast Blueprint
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jimmy gains 'Eureka' points passively over time and through assisting allies with buffs or debuffs (5 Eureka per buff/debuff applied). By pressing the 'Craft' button, Jimmy opens the Brain Blast Blueprint interface, allowing him to spend Eureka and Common Resources (Scrap Metal, Chemical Vials, Electronic Components - gained from enemy takedowns or environment interactions) to craft one-time-use Gadgets. Each Gadget has a unique effect and cost. Available gadgets rotate on a short timer, encouraging adaptability. The crafted Gadget replaces this ability slot until used. Eureka point accumulation rate increases slightly with each level. Each gadget consumes a varying amount of Scrap Metal, Chemical Vials, and Electronic Components, indicated in their blueprint. Failed crafts refund 25% of the Eureka cost, but no resources.
abilities.flavorQuote: Think, think, think!

abilities.name: Hypercube Constructor
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jimmy rapidly assembles a Hypercube Constructor, consuming Scrap Metal and Electronic Components. Upon activation, the constructor deploys a temporary zone that distorts space. Enemies within the zone have their movement speed reduced by 30% and their ability cooldowns increased by 20%. Allies within the zone gain 15% increased damage. The zone lasts for 5 seconds. After the 5 seconds are up, the cube destabilizes, dealing minor true damage to all units within its radius. The amount of true damage scales with Jimmy's magic attack. The Constructor takes 1.5 seconds to deploy, during which Jimmy is vulnerable. Using this ability also grants 10 Eureka points. Cost: 20 Scrap Metal, 15 Electronic Components. Cooldown: 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's bend some space!

abilities.name: Neutron Bubble Shield
upgrades: Improved Shield Matrix: Increases the shield's initial absorption capacity by 10% and the reflected damage by 5%.
Emergency Overload System: Reduces the shield's explosion timer to 3 seconds.
Adaptive Energy Redirection: The reflected damage now also slows the attacker's movement speed by 20% for 1.5 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Enhanced Energy Field: Improved ability scaling, becoming significantly more potent at later levels.
(Patch) Jack-of-all-Trades Optimization: This ability now emphasizes versatility, slightly increasing Eureka point generation.
abilities.description: Jimmy Neutron, harnessing the power of his immense intellect and garage inventions, projects a shimmering, translucent bubble around himself. This technological marvel, fueled by 15 Electronic Components and 20 Chemical Vials, manifests as a personal energy barrier, immediately granting Jimmy a shield that absorbs damage equivalent to 200 + (Jimmy's Magic Defense stat * 1.5). This shield isn't merely defensive; it ingeniously redirects 20% of the incoming pain back at the attacker, inflicting magic damage calculated from that reflected proportion. While encased within his invention, Jimmy’s focus on maintaining the shield reduces his movement speed by 15%, forcing him to prioritize strategic positioning over hasty retreats. Should the onslaught cease, and the bubble remain intact for a full 4 seconds, it doesn’t simply vanish. Instead, it overloads, creating a localized energy surge that deals magic damage to all enemies within a 300-unit radius, scaling based on the damage the bubble absorbed; reaching up to an additional 50% of the initial damage value. This overloaded burst also serves a secondary purpose: the resulting electromagnetic pulse cleanses Jimmy of all existing debuffs, shaking off the effects of enemy control and impairment. Activating this ingenious device also sparks inspiration, granting Jimmy 5 Eureka points towards his next groundbreaking invention. This ability has an 18 second cooldown, providing ample opportunity to recharge his inventive mind before deploying another ingenious defense.

abilities.name: Hyper-Growth Formula Launcher
abilities.description: Jimmy loads his custom launcher with a potent Hyper-Growth Formula, carefully synthesized from 25 Chemical Vials and 10 Scrap Metal scavenged from the battlefield. He then launches a vial towards the fray. Upon impact with the first enemy, the vial shatters, releasing a concentrated burst of hyper-growth energy that bathes the target in its mutating aura. The affected enemy swells in size, their cells rapidly multiplying and expanding. Their maximum HP is instantly augmented by a whopping 30%, reflecting their increased mass and resilience, and their attack damage surges by 20% for 6 seconds, making them a temporary behemoth on the battlefield. But remember, what goes up must come down; as the 6-second duration ends, the growth spurt reverses violently, and the target rapidly shrinks back to their original size, suffering damage equal to 15% of the bonus HP they gained during the growth phase. Should the target be reduced to zero health during the growth phase, the unstable energy surges uncontrollably to the nearest enemy instead. As Jimmy witnesses his experiment in action, he gains a burst of insight, accumulating 10 Eureka points. Be mindful of the formula's volatility; Jimmy requires a 20-second cooldown to recalibrate the launcher and prepare another dose.

abilities.name: Reverse Polarity Pulverizer
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Jimmy unleashes the Reverse Polarity Pulverizer, a devastating beam of energy that consumes a large amount of Eureka and all available resources. The beam deals scaling magic damage over 3 seconds to all enemies in a targeted area, increasing every second. At the end of the 3 second channel, the Pulverizer explodes, dealing additional true damage based on the total amount of Eureka consumed during the activation (1 true damage per Eureka). If Jimmy has less than 50 Eureka, he cannot activate the Pulverizer. Any gadgets crafted but not used are instantly consumed on use, granting bonus damage. Jimmy is stationary during the channel. Allies can move him or protect him while he fires. The Pulverizer's range and width scale with the amount of Electronic Components used. Damage scales with Chemical Vials. Duration scales with Scrap Metal.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to scramble some molecules!

character_v1.name: Sheen

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Melee basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: UltraLord Hyper-Fanatic Frenzy
upgrades: Lv10: Projectile count increased to 7, and wind damage potency enhanced by 15%.
Lv50: 'Starstruck' chance increased to 40% per hit, and duration extended to 1.25 seconds.
Lv100: Each hit now has a 10% chance to apply a minor stacking Vulnerability debuff, increasing damage taken by the target by 2% per stack, lasting 3 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Sheen's ultimate display of UltraLord devotion erupts into a whirlwind of excited energy. Upon activation, Sheen begins to rapidly unleash miniature UltraLord figurines, each launched with the force of a hyper-caffeinated tantrum. These figurines, imbued with sheer fanaticism, target a single enemy, dealing a barrage of Wind damage distributed across a rapid series of five attacks over 1.5 seconds. Beyond the initial damage, each tiny UltraLord is strategically designed to cause momentary distractions, applying a -5% Evasion debuff per hit, stacking up to a total of -25% for the full duration. As the figurines descend, Sheen's overwhelming admiration attempts to charm the target, inflicting 'Starstruck' with a 20% chance per hit, fixating the target on Sheen for 0.75 seconds. This fixation can potentially draw enemy attention away from allies, offering tactical advantages in positioning and protection.

abilities.name: Ultra Lord Uppercut
upgrades: Extends the leap's range by 10%, allowing for even more daring entries and escapes.
Amplifies the impact, boosting the damage of the leap by an additional 15% of attack damage.
(Adjustment) Concentrates the shockwave's energy, increasing the stun duration from 0.5 seconds to 0.75 seconds, but reducing the shockwave's effective radius by 50 units.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~6% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Sheen's boundless passion for Ultra Lord propels him into a high-octane leap inspired by his hero! He launches himself forward, crashing down upon the designated target with a potent, upward-swinging strike that inflicts physical damage equivalent to 80% of his Attack Damage. This display of Ultra Lord devotion instantly grants Sheen 1 stack of Ultra Lord Hype. However, if Sheen already boasts 3 stacks of Ultra Lord Hype, the landing transforms into a spectacular Ultra Lord Supernova, generating a localized shockwave. This shockwave stuns the primary target, along with all other enemies caught within a 150-unit radius, for a staggering 0.5 seconds! This maneuver isn't just about raw power; it's also about strategic positioning, allowing Sheen to aggressively jump into fights or quickly escape dangerous situations. Upon a successful landing, Sheen's combo potential skyrockets as his auto-attack timer is reset! Furthermore, his movement speed surges by 15% for a brief 1 second duration, guaranteeing he maintains the momentum to pursue cosmic justice or, at the very least, string together an amazing series of attacks that Ultra Lord himself would be proud of!

abilities.name: Guacamole Barrage
abilities.description: Sheen unleashes a rapid-fire barrage of Guacamole projectiles, dealing damage over time. Each projectile deals magic damage equal to 15% of his Magic Attack. Landing multiple projectiles grants additional stacks of Ultra Lord Hype, up to a maximum of 2 stacks per use. If Sheen is at maximum Ultra Lord Hype (5 stacks), this ability consumes all stacks, creating a Guacamole Explosion at the target location, dealing massive magic damage in an area equal to 150% of his Magic Attack, and slowing enemies by 30% for 2 seconds. This explosion is a key component to Sheen's burst damage, but requires careful management of the Ultra Lord Hype mechanic to utilize effectively. The explosion damage scales with Sheen's magic attack.
abilities.flavorQuote: They haven't invented the sour that's too sour for the Sheen!

abilities.name: Rocket Skate Dash
upgrades: (Bugfix) Corrected issue where Ultra Lord Evade would sometimes place Sheen inside of map geometry.
(Patch) Ultra Lord Evade now heals allies for 3% of their maximum health if Sheen passes through them.
abilities.description: Sheen activates his prototype rocket skates, instantly dashing a short distance in the targeted direction, leaving a trail of fire in his wake. The dash travels a fixed distance of 300 units and grants Sheen a brief period of untargetability for 0.3 seconds, allowing him to dodge incoming projectiles or reposition aggressively. If Sheen passes through an enemy champion during the dash, he gains one stack of Ultra Lord Hype, and the fire trail ignites, dealing 50 + (20% of Magic Attack) magic damage over 2 seconds to enemies who walk through it. The cooldown of Rocket Skate Dash is reduced by 1 second for each enemy champion hit by Sheen's basic attacks, encouraging aggressive play and rewarding skillful positioning. When Sheen has accumulated the maximum 5 stacks of Ultra Lord Hype, using Rocket Skate Dash causes its range to extend by 25%, making it more effective for engaging or disengaging and amplifying his mobility during critical moments.

character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased Damage during Ultra Lord Frenzy

character_v1.name: Biff

abilities.name: Hello? Anybody Home?
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Biff delivers a signature knuckle sandwich to a target enemy, dealing X physical damage. If the target is already affected by a debuff, the damage is increased by 20%. In addition, this ability applies 'Concussion' for 3 seconds. 'Concussion' reduces the target's attack damage by 15% and their speed by 10%. If Biff has at least 3 'Sports Almanac' charges, he can expend them to enhance this ability: The 'Concussion' duration is increased to 5 seconds and now also silences the target for 1.5 seconds. After using this enhanced ability, Biff gains 1 stack of 'Overconfidence', increasing his tenacity by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 20%.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Hello? Hello? Anybody home?"

abilities.name: Butthead Bully
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Minor Adjustment: Adjusted the ratio of shield scaling, resulting in a less pronounced effect in late-game scenarios.
(Bug Fix) Logic error in the Empowered version was fixed, which now properly affects all targets in AoE.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Biff Tannen channels his inner lout, unleashing a torrent of schoolyard insults and menacing glares in a wide area around himself, forcing all enemies within a radius of X to focus their attention on him. Each enemy affected becomes a 'Butthead', suffering a reduction of 20% to their magical defenses for a duration of 4 seconds. Furthermore, Biff's intense berating has a 30% chance to leave these 'Buttheads' momentarily stunned for 1 second, leaving them open to further attacks. As Biff revels in his dominance, he gains a shield that absorbs X damage for 3 seconds for each enemy successfully taunted. This protective barrier strengthens with Biff's own defenses, scaling with his defense stat. If Biff possesses at least 5 'Sports Almanac' charges, he can expend them to unleash an even more potent wave of intimidation. The empowered 'Butthead' debuff now reduces the movement speed of affected enemies by 30% for its entire duration, significantly hindering their ability to escape or engage. Additionally, Biff's shield is not only doubled in strength, but also extends its duration to a full 5 seconds, making him an even more formidable force on the battlefield.

abilities.name: BiffCo Takeover
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Biff calls upon his corporate influence, creating a zone of toxic waste at a targeted location for 6 seconds. Enemies within this zone take X magic damage per second and are afflicted with 'Contamination'. 'Contamination' reduces healing received by 40%. If Biff has at least 2 'Sports Almanac' charges, he may expend them to corrupt the zone further: The zone's duration is increased to 8 seconds, and enemies within are also silenced. The zone now leaves behind a lingering 'Sludge' effect for 4 seconds after it dissipates, slowing enemies by 20%. This ability’s initial magic damage also scales with Biff’s current 'Sports Almanac' charges, gaining 5% increased damage per charge held at the time of activation.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm gonna make this whole town BiffCo!"

abilities.name: Gray's Sports Almanac (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Biff passively accumulates 'Sports Almanac' charges over time. He gains 1 charge every 8 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 charges. These charges are essential for enhancing Biff's abilities, granting bonus effects and power. In addition, for every 2 'Sports Almanac' charges Biff possesses, he gains 3% lifesteal. When Biff is reduced below 30% health, he consumes all 'Sports Almanac' charges, gaining a shield equal to 5% of his maximum health per charge consumed. This shield lasts for 5 seconds. This passive incentivizes Biff to strategically manage his resources, balancing between empowering abilities and saving them for emergencies.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm gonna be richer than God!"

abilities.name: Gimme the Almanac!
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: Grants a small burst of healing to Biff and allies based on damage mitigated during the ability's active duration.
abilities.description: Biff, fueled by raw greed and the desire for temporal advantage, slams his fist down, attempting to rewrite destiny using the power of his 'Sports Almanac' stash. Upon activation, Biff consumes all 'Sports Almanac' charges, unleashing a localized temporal shockwave lasting for 5 seconds. This shockwave provides Biff with a stacking damage reduction based on the number of Almanacs consumed. For each Almanac used, Biff gains a 5% damage reduction, up to a maximum of 50% if all 10 Almanacs are used. Additionally, each consumed Almanac increases Biff's threat generation by 10% ensuring enemies are more likely to target him, essential for protecting his team. However, tampering with time carries risks. Each Almanac has a 10% chance of creating a temporal paradox, causing Biff to become 'Entangled in Time', which stuns him for 0.75 seconds and reduces his damage output by 25% for the stun's duration. This 'Entangled in Time' debuff ensures the effect of the almanac does not cause him to do more damage than intended when the almanac backfires. Although risky, the reward is great as all allies within a 20 unit radius gain a shield equal to 10% of Biff's maximum health which decays at 2% per second until the effect has expired. This ability's cooldown is 90 seconds, reflecting the intense strain of bending time to Biff's will. This ultimate is Biff's most powerful defensive tool, but demands tactical foresight due to its volatile nature.

character_v1.playstyle: Timeline Usurper: Manipulates combat with debuffs and altering the timeline.

abilities.name: Spectral Echo
upgrades: Lv10: +20% ATK scaling
Lv50: 'Minor Chill' duration increases to 3 seconds.
Lv100: Base damage increased; armor penetration buff increased to 10% for 3 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Buff: Ability damage scales with extra ATK.
(Patch) Role realignment: Now grants minor shield to self after hit, scaling with 10% of attack.
abilities.description: Marceline, with a flick of her wrist, conjures a fleeting illusion of herself, launching it forward to deliver a chilling, spectral touch to her foes. This attack deals physical damage, empowered by a fraction of her Attack stat. The damage, scaling with 50% of Marceline's ATK, is projected in a straight line, affecting the first enemy it encounters. Upon impact, the Spectral Echo leaves a chilling frost, inflicting 'Minor Chill' for 1.5 seconds. The 'Minor Chill' reduces the target's movement speed by 15%, hindering their escape or advance. This ability is intended for single targets, but its spectral nature allows it to momentarily pierce through the target's defenses, granting Marceline a temporary 5% increase to armor penetration against the affected target for 3 seconds. The attack is infused with light, adding an element of surprise and countering some inherent magical defenses, while still emphasizing Marceline's tank-style interactions.

abilities.name: Axe Bass Riff
abilities.description: Marceline shreds a powerful riff on her axe bass, launching a wave of sonic energy in a line. This wave deals 80 (+60% magic atk) magic damage to all enemies in its path and applies 'Red Resonance', marking them for 4 seconds. Enemies affected by 'Red Resonance' take 5% increased damage from Marceline's subsequent abilities. The sonic wave travels a moderate distance, allowing Marceline to harass enemies from a safe range or set up for more aggressive plays. This is her primary method of applying 'Red Resonance' to enemies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to turn up the volume!

abilities.name: Bat Swarm
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Marceline transforms into a swarm of bats, becoming untargetable and gaining 30% increased movement speed for 2 seconds. During this time, she can pass through enemies and obstacles. Upon reforming, enemies within a small radius around her take 60 (+40% magic atk) magic damage and are knocked back slightly. This ability allows Marceline to reposition quickly, dodge incoming attacks, or initiate fights. If an enemy already has 'Red Resonance', the damage is increased by 20%, and she heals for 3% of her max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's fly under the radar for a bit.

abilities.name: Crimson Thirst
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Marceline transforms into a bat, darting a short distance forward, closing the gap between her and the nearest enemy. Upon reaching her target, she reverts, sinking her fangs into them and inflicting 90 (+70% of magic attack) magic damage. This bite isn't merely a strike; it's a siphon. If the target is marked with 'Red Resonance', meticulously harvested by her other abilities, Marceline gorges on this energy, instantly healing herself for 8% of her maximum health and inflicting an additional 40 (+30% of magic attack) as a surge of pure, piercing true damage. Without the presence of 'Red Resonance', the siphoned heal is dramatically diminished, providing only 3% of her maximum health as immediate recovery, and the additional burst of true damage is suppressed entirely. The range of this bat-form lunge is limited, demanding careful positioning and thoughtful anticipation of enemy movements. A successful 'Crimson Thirst' not only damages the target, but also provides a crucial burst of sustain, making Marceline a resilient threat on the battlefield.

abilities.name: No Sphere

For a duration of 8 seconds, Marceline's own magic attack surges, gaining an additional 40 magic attack power. The unstable energy resonates outward, weakening the resolve of her enemies in a vast radius. Opponents caught within this field of corrupted power will find their own attack damage diminished by 25%, hampering their ability to strike effectively. Furthermore, enemies marked with the 'Red Resonance' status when No Sphere is cast find their torment deepened, as the duration of Red Resonance is brutally extended by a full 3 seconds. This prolonged suffering magnifies the advantages gained by Marceline's team, solidifying her position as a formidable force within the theater of battle.

These bonuses are consumed upon using a damaging ability, and all 'Radar Lock' stacks are then reset to zero. This ability encourages proactive positioning and rewards predicting enemy movements.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got you in my sights before you even know it.

abilities.name: Sensor Mine Deployment

If Miyu has 3 or more stacks of 'Radar Lock' when casting this ability, the barrage lasts twice as long, dealing damage twice. Enemies hit are also knocked back a short distance. Cooldown: 15 seconds. The beacon gives the enemy time to escape, but rewards predictive placement and synergizes greatly with 'Radar Lock'.

If Miyu has 4 or more stacks of 'Radar Lock' when casting this ability, the shield's strength is increased by 50%, and the dash distance increases to 550 units. Cooldown: 18 seconds. If Miyu has 5 stacks of 'Radar Lock' when casting this ability, the Arwing fires a second pass immediately after the first, dealing an additional 75 + (35% of attack) physical damage. character_v1.name: Clyde Fife

upgrades: Lv10: +10% base damage scaling

abilities.description: Clyde adjusts the dials on his gauntlet, unleashing a focused blast of thermal energy at a single target. This beam deals physical damage to the first enemy it strikes, scaling with Clyde's attack power. The beam is infused with heat, leaving the target Burning for 3 seconds, dealing additional physical damage over the duration. This Burning damage also scales with Clyde's attack power, ticking every second while active. This ability has a range of 15 meters, ensuring Clyde maintains a safe distance while applying the pressure. Any enemy struck is visually indicated with crackling heat distortions around them, and if they are already Burning, the remaining duration of the effect is refreshed.

abilities.name: Freeze Ray Fumble
abilities.description: Clyde attempts to emit a freeze ray, targeting the ally with the lowest health, healing them for X (scales with magic atk) HP and applying a shield worth 15% of their max HP for 3 seconds. However, due to Clyde's clumsiness, there is a 40% chance that the freeze ray backfires, instead freezing Clyde himself for 1 second, stunning him and reducing his speed by 25% for 5 seconds after. Activating this ability triggers 'Cincotrix Surge,' with a 50% chance to apply a random buff (increased attack, defense, or speed by 10%) or debuff (decreased attack, defense, or speed by 10%) to Clyde and the targeted ally for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Oops! Hope I didn't freeze myself again!

abilities.name: Force Field Flop
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~14%).
abilities.description: Clyde attempts to generate a force field around the ally nearest to him, granting them a damage reduction of 30% for 4 seconds. The force field has a 20% chance to expand unexpectedly, also affecting nearby enemies within a small radius, reducing their attack damage by 15% for the same duration. Unfortunately, the Cincotrix is somewhat unstable; there is a 30% chance that instead of protecting the ally, the force field implodes, dealing X (scales with magic atk) damage to the ally and stunning them for 0.75 seconds. This ability also triggers 'Cincotrix Surge,' with a 50% chance to apply a random buff (increased attack, defense, or speed by 10%) or debuff (decreased attack, defense, or speed by 10%) to all affected targets for 5 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Don't worry, I've almost got this force field thing figured out!

abilities.name: Fife's Flaw Finder
upgrades: Enhanced Error Handling: Greatly diminishes the likelihood of inconsistent interactions with unique enemy abilities.
Refined System Optimization: Reclassifies this ability as 'Utility', broadly benefiting Clyde and his allies through increased tactical awareness.
(Patch) Realigned Role Prioritization: Adjusts this ability to emphasize utility-centric interactions, improving team support and survivability.
abilities.description: Clyde’s extensive research, now compiled into the Flaw Finder, allows him to analyze combat scenarios with surprising insight. Each time Clyde becomes the target of an enemy's offensive maneuver, the Flaw Finder triggers, presenting a 35% probability of identifying a critical vulnerability in the attacker's operational methodology, resulting in the application of a targeted debuff known as 'Compromised Function'. This 'Compromised Function' significantly reduces the attacker’s damage output by 20% for a duration of 3 seconds, providing Clyde with a crucial edge in protracted engagements. Due to the computational intensity of real-time tactical analysis, the Flaw Finder requires periodic diagnostic recalibration; thus, this debuff cannot be applied to the same enemy more frequently than once every 8 seconds. Additionally, whenever Clyde is affected by a buff or debuff, the Flaw Finder immediately initiates supplementary protocols, fine-tuning its processes to either counteract the disadvantage or augment the advantage, effectively extending the duration of any status effect on Clyde by an additional 1 second. Further, the Flaw Finder enhances the potency of 'Cincotrix Surge'; buffs and debuffs originating from it gain an additional 5% effectiveness.

abilities.name: Cinco-Trikes!
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: The stun debuff is now applied to enemies hit by the wall collision.
abilities.description: Clyde, ever eager to showcase the Cincotrix's capabilities, attempts a high-speed maneuver. Activating the device, he launches forward in a chaotic burst, dealing X (scales with magic atk) magic damage to enemies he passes through. The trail left in his wake becomes an area of crackling energy that persists for 3 seconds, inflicting a stacking debuff called "Static Charge." Enemies caught within the static trail receive a stack every 0.5 seconds, increasing their vulnerability to subsequent electricity-based attacks by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 25%. Due to Clyde's somewhat haphazard control over the Cincotrix, there's still a 60% chance he'll overshoot, continuing his dash until he slams into a wall or obstacle. Upon impact, Clyde suffers a self-inflicted "Dazed" effect, reducing his movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 15% for 1.5 seconds. This collision also unleashes a small shockwave, dealing Y (15% of his magic atk) magic damage to nearby enemies within a 2-meter radius.

abilities.name: Cincotrix Overdrive
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Clyde pushes the Cincotrix to its limit, causing it to emit a chaotic wave of energy. All allies within a large radius gain a shield that absorbs X (scales with magic atk) damage for 5 seconds and have their healing received increased by 25% for 7 seconds. All enemies within the same radius are afflicted with a random elemental debuff (Fire: deals damage over time, Water: reduces speed, Earth: reduces defense, Wind: reduces attack) for 6 seconds. The Cincotrix, however, becomes unstable after this burst, reducing Clyde's speed and attack damage by 20% for 10 seconds after the initial effects end. This ability guarantees the activation of 'Cincotrix Surge,' applying a random buff (increased attack, defense, or speed by 15%) to all allies and a random debuff (decreased attack, defense, or speed by 15%) to all enemies for 7 seconds, stacking with any other effects.
abilities.flavorQuote: This might be a bit much, but I'm sure it'll help!

If no cards are present, Guilmon will still appear but will only deal 50% of the normal damage and not grant the damage reduction bonus.
abilities.flavorQuote: Guilmon, lend us your strength!

If the target is already afflicted by Paranoia, the duration of the Silence is increased by 0.5 seconds for each stack, up to a maximum of 4 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, reduced by 1 second for each stack of Paranoia currently on the target, to a minimum of 4 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: So, tell me again why you think you're not delusional?

abilities.name: Psychological Manipulation
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Improved Psychotherapy: Scaling factor of ability significantly increased.

abilities.description: Dr. Silberman deftly twists the threads of reality, offering a carefully constructed narrative. He soothes a selected ally's fractured psyche, restoring their health by an amount that scales with his magic attack. Simultaneously, he targets an enemy with a disorienting barrage of words, inflicting the 'Confused' status for 3 seconds. While Confused, the enemy's actions become unpredictable; they may lash out at nearby allies or wander aimlessly, their focus shattered. Furthermore, each use of 'Psychological Manipulation' layers one stack of Paranoia onto the bewildered target, deepening their descent into uncertainty. Should the chosen ally teeter on the brink of collapse, with their health plummeting below 30%, the healing power surges, amplified by 50%, providing a vital surge of resilience. And in a cruel twist, the 'Confused' status has a 20% chance to briefly stun the affected enemy for 1 second, interrupting their attacks and leaving them vulnerable, a testament to the power of his influence. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Point of No Return
upgrades: (Stability Patch) Improved reliability of Paranoia stack detection across all network conditions (observed desync - 11%).
(Redesign) 'Existential Dread' now also reduces healing received by 20% for its duration.
abilities.description: As Peter Silberman sows seeds of doubt and anxiety, enemies teeter on the brink. When a target accumulates five stacks of Paranoia from Peter's machinations, they reach their 'Point of No Return'. The overwhelming dread causes a complete mental collapse, instantly purging all Paranoia stacks. The afflicted enemy is then subjected to 'Psychogenic Fugue' for 2.5 seconds, a disorienting state where they become uncontrollably charmed, forced to flee in terror and becoming particularly vulnerable to further manipulation. During this fugue state, their attack damage and movement speed are reduced by 35%, hindering their ability to retaliate or escape. Once the Psychogenic Fugue subsides, the target is left reeling from 'Existential Dread' for 4 seconds, a potent debuff that strips away 60% of their Tenacity, rendering them susceptible to further crowd control effects. To prevent perpetual torment, subsequent inductions of 'Point of No Return' on the same target within a 12-second window will reduce the duration of the 'Psychogenic Fugue' effect by 0.75 seconds each time, down to a minimum duration of 0.5 seconds, ensuring a brief window of respite from Peter's psychological onslaught.

abilities.name: Institutionalize
abilities.description: Dr. Silberman summons a mental asylum cell around a targeted enemy, 'Institutionalizing' them for 4 seconds. The target is rendered invulnerable but unable to act or be targeted by allies. While 'Institutionalized', the target gains 2 stacks of Paranoia at the start and end of the duration. If the target is already at 4 stacks of Paranoia when 'Institutionalize' ends, they immediately suffer a 'Psychotic Break'. This ability has a cooldown of 18 seconds. 'Institutionalize' cannot be used on the same target twice within 25 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: A controlled environment is essential for proper treatment.

This ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds.

The icy terrain provides vision of the area. Multiple Frozen Ground patches can exist simultaneously, but their effects do not stack. abilities.flavorQuote: Let the storm rage on. The cold never bothered me anyway.

If an enemy is already affected by Frostbite, the ice lance shatters upon impact, creating a small area of ice shards around the target. These shards deal an additional 40 (+20% Magic ATK) magic damage to nearby enemies within a short radius, further enhancing Elsa's area control capabilities. The initial target takes full damage before the shard explosion occurs.
abilities.flavorQuote: My power flows through the air and into the ground.

abilities.name: Winter's Aura

Enemies with 3 stacks of Frostbite are frozen solid for 1 second, becoming completely immobile and invulnerable, after which they are cleansed of all Frostbite stacks. Allies near Elsa gain 5 (+2% Max HP) HP regeneration per second. This passive enhances Elsa's survivability and supportive capabilities, ensuring a constant presence of crowd control and sustain during engagements, making her a formidable presence in team compositions.
abilities.flavorQuote: The kingdom, it calls to me.

abilities.name: Glacial Prison
