abilities.description: Proto Man's internal systems, a marvel of engineering, offer increased combat effectiveness but demand careful management. His buster gains a 10% attack damage bonus, enhancing his offensive capabilities from the start. However, reaching 100 Heat triggers a system overload. When Proto Man's Buster overheats, his frame vents excess energy, increasing incoming damage by 15% for 5 seconds. This Heat Vulnerability necessitates skillful heat management to prevent exploitation. A perfectly timed dodge, executed when heat levels are above 80, bleeds off 15 Heat from the system. This provides a skillful means of mitigation to help you prevent the Heat Vulnerability debuff. With careful planning and sharp reflexes, you can optimize your performance and keep Proto Man in the fight.

abilities.name: Shadow Strike: Delta
upgrades: Lv10: Enhances attack potency and reduces cooldown, but extends afterimage duration slightly.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect: upon hit, applies a short-duration 'Exposed' debuff, increasing damage taken from all sources.
Lv100: Improves scaling, and grants a small chance to instantly reset a basic ability cooldown upon a successful Shadow Strike.

abilities.description: Protoman executes a lightning-fast, near-invisible attack. Upon activation, Protoman vanishes in a burst of afterimages, becoming briefly untargetable while analyzing the target's vulnerabilities. After a short delay, a single, devastating strike is delivered. This isn't merely a physical blow; the Shadow Strike is augmented with a concentrated pulse of destabilizing energy, calculated to exploit weaknesses in the target's defenses. Damage scaling is complex, drawing heavily from Protoman's ATK and Crit Chance, but also factoring in any elemental vulnerabilities the target possesses. If the target is suffering from a status ailment, Shadow Strike Delta's damage is amplified. Visually, the effect culminates in a shimmering, delta-shaped energy imprint left upon the target at the point of impact, a testament to the precision and controlled power of the strike. The entire sequence is intended to be extremely fast to emphasize Protoman's nature as an assassin.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Calculated precision. Nothing more."

Simultaneously, each hit on an enemy applies a stack of 'Riot'. Riot stacks last for 5 seconds and can stack up to 5 times per target. Enemies at 5 stacks are considered 'Unstable'. While unstable, allies can consume the stacks on the target to deal an additional 40 (+10% of ally's magic power or attack power, whichever is highest) as bonus magic damage. If no stacks are consumed within 3 seconds after reaching 5 stacks, it detonates on its own, dealing 30 (+7% of Bass' magic power) as magic damage. The cone's width is moderate, allowing for both single-target focus and area denial. This skill has a moderate cooldown of 8 seconds.

This ability provides mobility and can be used both offensively and defensively. The dash distance is fixed, and the collision detection is generous, ensuring that Bass connects with his target reliably. If no enemy is hit, the dash still occurs, but no damage is dealt, and Overload stacks are not consumed. The cooldown is 6 seconds, providing frequent opportunities for repositioning and burst damage.

abilities.description: Bass targets an enemy and, with a flash of violet energy, instantly duplicates one of their non-Ultimate abilities for a duration of 8 seconds. During this time, Copy Shot overwrites Bass's Dash & Strike ability, replacing it with the acquired power. The copied ability's base damage is slightly reduced, but it receives significantly increased scaling based on Bass's current Buster Overload stacks. If Bass has accumulated 5 or more Buster Overload stacks, the copied ability gains an additional effect determined by its elemental affinity. For instance, copying a Fire-based ability grants it the ability to inflict a burn, dealing damage over time for 3 seconds equal to 15% of Bass's magic attack per tick, while a Water-based ability applies a slow, reducing the target's movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds. After the 8-second duration concludes, the copied ability vanishes, and Dash & Strike is restored. Effective use of Copy Shot relies on identifying key enemy abilities to exploit; careful planning will allow you to turn the tide. Copy Shot has a cooldown of 15 seconds.

Enemies caught within the Psycho Field's influence suffer a 40% reduction to their movement speed for a duration of 1.5 seconds, hindering their escape and making them vulnerable to further assaults. If used immediately after 'Blaster Barrage,' the cooldown of 'Wolf Flash' is reduced by 1 second, enabling faster engagements and disengagements. Mastering the timing of this ability is crucial for maximizing Wolf's effectiveness in battle. This ability is core for inflicting Weak Point, vital to the playstyle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Too slow! You can't anticipate my movements!

abilities.name: Ruthless Pursuit
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever an enemy's health drops below 30%, Wolf gains 1 stack of Vendetta and his speed increases by 10% for 5 seconds. This passive ability reflects Wolf's predatory instincts, rewarding aggressive play and finishing blows. The speed boost allows him to quickly close the distance on weakened targets, further cementing his role as a lethal assassin. Stacks of Vendetta gained from Ruthless Pursuit can be combined with stacks gained from Blaster Barrage to maximize the power of Vendetta-consuming abilities, reinforcing the importance of strategic execution.
abilities.flavorQuote: Nowhere to run! Your end is here!

abilities.name: Vendetta Strike

abilities.description: Wolf unleashes a devastating strike, consuming all stacks of Vendetta to deal bonus critical damage. Each stack of Vendetta increases the critical hit damage by 25%. If the target is affected by 'Weak Point,' the critical hit chance is increased by an additional 10%. This ability represents Wolf's ultimate finishing move, requiring careful setup and precise timing to maximize its impact. The damage from Vendetta Strike is calculated before any damage mitigation effects, ensuring it remains a potent threat against even the tankiest opponents. Consuming stacks of Vendetta leaves Wolf vulnerable, emphasizing the high-risk, high-reward nature of this ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: This ends now! Feel my Vendetta!

abilities.description: Wolf calls in favors from his Cornerian underworld contacts. First, Leon locks onto the enemy with the highest Attack Damage, inflicting 'Hunted' for 5 seconds. This mark causes Wolf's subsequent attacks against the 'Hunted' target to grant 1 stack of Vendetta, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. Meanwhile, Pigma throws a volatile concoction at the enemy with the highest Max HP, dealing damage equal to 10% of their Maximum HP and inflicting 'Corrosive Bile'. 'Corrosive Bile' reduces the target's healing received by 30% for 5 seconds. Finally, Wolf unleashes a focused 'Vendetta Strike' against the 'Hunted' target dealing 200% of his Attack Damage. For each stack of Vendetta he possesses, this damage is amplified by an additional 20% Critical Damage. The Corneria Gambit leaves his foes vulnerable, setting the stage for a ruthless display of power.

character_v1.playstyle: High-Risk Burst Damage, Critical Strike Focused

abilities.description: Betilla channels her magic to unleash a concentrated bolt of pure, dazzling energy towards a chosen foe. This basic ranged attack deals physical damage, scaling with her Attack stat. The projectile travels swiftly, striking the primary target with a burst of light and force. Though focused on a single target, the intensity of this magic has limits; peak potency was reduced by roughly 14%, and the effect grows gradually, demanding precise timing and a sharp sense of opportunity.

abilities.name: Glade Burst
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~34%).
abilities.description: Betilla focuses her inherent magical energy, channeling the spirit of the Glade of Dreams into a potent projectile. She launches a verdant burst of energy in a straight line, which upon striking an enemy, deals 80 magic damage, enhanced by 60% of her Magic Attack. This burst travels across a considerable distance, facilitating engagements from afar, and upon impacting an enemy, triggers an additional benefit. Striking an enemy with Glade Burst imbues Betilla with a stack of 'Nymph's Blessing,' a source of magical energy that empowers her future spellcasting. Furthermore, successfully hitting an enemy champion with the Glade Burst sends a wave of invigorating magic to nearby allied champions, enhancing their mobility by granting them a 10% increase to their movement speed for a duration of 3 seconds, helping them to either chase down enemies or escape danger. The presence of Nymph's Blessing reduces the cooldown of this ability. For each stack of Nymph's Blessing Betilla possesses, the cooldown of Glade Burst is reduced by 0.5 seconds, down to a minimum cooldown of 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Nature's Embrace
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~17%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Betilla summons a circular zone of revitalizing energy at a target location. Allies within the zone are healed for 40 (+30% Magic ATK) HP per second. Enemies within the zone take 30 (+20% Magic ATK) magic damage per second. If Betilla has at least 3 stacks of Nymph's Grace, the healing effect is amplified by 50%. The zone lasts for 5 seconds. This ability provides both sustain for allies and a zoning tool to control areas. Stacks of Nymph's Grace are consumed upon casting this ability. Consumes 3 stacks of Nymph's Grace upon activation.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the earth cradle you.

abilities.name: Sparkling Barrier
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Betilla creates a shimmering shield around herself or a target ally for 4 seconds, absorbing up to 150 (+40% Magic ATK) damage. While the shield is active, the target also gains 20% increased tenacity. If the shield breaks before the duration ends, Betilla gains one stack of Nymph's Grace. This allows for strategic plays, whether protecting vulnerable allies or enabling aggressive positioning for herself. The shield has a visual indicator that changes color as it absorbs damage, providing feedback on its remaining strength. If Sparkling Barrier is cast on an ally while Betilla has any stacks of Nymph's Grace, those stacks are transferred to the shielded ally upon cast.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little protection goes a long way.

abilities.name: Nymph's Grace
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Whenever Betilla lands an ability, she gains a stack of Nymph's Grace, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Nymph's Grace grants Betilla 5% increased Magic ATK. At 5 stacks, Betilla's next ability has its range increased by 30% and deals 20% increased damage. All stacks are consumed after casting an ability with the empowered bonus. This encourages skillful play and precise ability usage to maximize damage output and utility. The duration of Nymph's Grace stacks is 8 seconds, refreshing upon gaining a new stack. Stacks of Nymph's Grace are visible through an on-screen UI element.
abilities.flavorQuote: The forest lends its power to those who respect it.

abilities.name: Forest Fury
abilities.description: Betilla unleashes a torrent of nature's wrath in a large cone in front of her, dealing 200 (+80% Magic ATK) magic damage to all enemies within the area over 3 seconds. For each stack of Nymph's Grace Betilla has upon casting, the damage is increased by 10%, and enemies are slowed by 15% for 2 seconds. After the channeling period, Betilla gains 3 stacks of Nymph's Grace. This ability is ideal for team fights and clearing waves, rewarding strategic stacking of Nymph's Grace before unleashing its full potential. Any Nymph's Grace stacks beyond 5 increase the slow duration by .2 seconds each.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the wrath of the wild!

character_v1.name: The Magician

abilities.name: Basic Attack

abilities.name: Hat Trick Teleport
abilities.description: The Magician vanishes into his hat, designating a target ally within a medium range. After a brief 0.75-second channel, he reappears beside the chosen ally, granting them a shield that absorbs X damage (scales with magic atk) for 3 seconds. Additionally, the Magician gains 1 stack of 'Misdirection'. If the targeted ally is crowd-controlled, the channel time is reduced by 0.25 seconds and the shield amount is increased by 20%. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The ability prioritizes allies with the lowest health percentage. Using this ability also slightly increases the Magician's evasion for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now you see me, now you're safe!

abilities.name: Illusory Decoy
abilities.description: The Magician conjures an illusory decoy of himself at a target location within a short range. The decoy lasts for 5 seconds and mimics The Magician's basic attack animations but deals no damage. Enemies targeting the decoy suffer a 15% accuracy reduction against the Magician for 3 seconds. If The Magician has at least 3 stacks of 'Misdirection', consuming them creates two decoys instead of one, placed slightly apart. These decoys persist for 7 seconds and grant the Magician stealth for 1 second after they are created. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds and can be recast during its duration to move the decoy to a new location once. The decoy's health scales with 50% of Magician's max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: Which one is the real me?

abilities.name: Protoon Polymorph
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~7% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

abilities.description: The Magician fires a Protoon-infused blast at a target enemy within medium range. If the blast hits, the enemy is polymorphed into a harmless Tring for 2.5 seconds. Polymorphed enemies are silenced, disarmed, and have their movement speed reduced by 40%. If the targeted enemy is already debuffed, the duration of the polymorph is increased by 1 second. This ability consumes 2 stacks of 'Misdirection' to also inflict a 20% damage reduction debuff on the target for 5 seconds after the polymorph ends. This ability has a cooldown of 18 seconds. The ability prioritizes targets with the highest attack damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a little… transformation!

abilities.name: Scholar's Insight
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~10% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: The Magician gains 1 stack of 'Misdirection' whenever an ally successfully dodges an attack or resists a crowd control effect. Each stack of 'Misdirection' increases the Magician's magic defense by 3% (max 10 stacks). Upon reaching 10 stacks, the Magician consumes all stacks to grant all allies a temporary buff that increases their tenacity by 25% for 4 seconds. Stacks decay after 15 seconds if not consumed. The tenacity buff is applied globally.
abilities.flavorQuote: Knowledge is the greatest magic.

abilities.name: Grand Illusion
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~29%).
abilities.description: The Magician channels for 2 seconds, creating a massive illusory dome around the battlefield for 8 seconds. Inside the dome, all allies gain a 30% increase to their evasion and critical hit chance. Enemies inside the dome have their vision range reduced by 50% and are afflicted with a 10% chance to misfire their abilities (abilities go on cooldown but have no effect). After the dome collapses, the Magician gains 5 stacks of 'Misdirection'. If an ally is brought below 20% health while inside the dome, they are instantly healed for 20% of their max health. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Behold, my greatest trick!

abilities.description: Peppy fires a single, forceful wag of his finger towards a targeted enemy, channeling light energy into the gesture. The forceful point deals physical damage, calculated as a base value plus a scaling factor based on Peppy's attack stat. Furthermore, the light energy discharged with the wag temporarily empowers Peppy's defenses, granting him a [Defense Up] buff for 3 seconds. This buff increases Peppy's defense stat by a percentage of his base defense, making him more resilient to incoming damage. Enemies hit by this finger wag are momentarily stunned by its sheer audacity, inflicting a [Stun] debuff that lasts for a brief period of 0.5 seconds, interrupting their actions and giving Peppy and his allies a window of opportunity to capitalize. The light emitted from the finger wag also washes over Peppy, granting a [Shield] equal to 5% of the damage dealt by the finger wag for 1 second.

abilities.name: Evasive Maneuver
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Peppy utilizes his extensive flight combat expertise, executing a textbook evasive maneuver, becoming invulnerable to all incoming damage for a critical 1.5 seconds, deftly avoiding enemy fire and potential threats. Immediately following this impressive display of aerial finesse, Peppy emits a concussive blast of disorienting sound waves from his ship's advanced sound system, projected forward in a wide cone. This auditory assault drastically reduces the attack damage of all enemies caught within the cone by a debilitating 30% and significantly hampers their movement speed, slowing them down by 20%. The damaging effects of these disruptive sound waves endure for a crucial 3 seconds, giving Peppy and his allies a significant advantage in the immediate aftermath. This core ability is subject to a moderate cooldown of 12 seconds. Furthermore, each successful execution of 'Evasive Maneuver' grants Peppy one stack of 'Tactical Assessment', a passive buff that enhances his strategic capabilities on the battlefield, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. This move is more than a mere escape; it's a calculated play to weaken enemies and create opportunities for his team.

abilities.name: Veteran's Insight
abilities.description: Peppy utilizes his extensive combat experience to analyze a target enemy, revealing their primary damage type (Physical/Magical) and any active buffs or shields they possess. For the next 5 seconds, allies attacking the analyzed target deal 10% increased damage of the opposite type, capitalizing on the enemy's weaknesses (e.g., if target is Physical, allies deal 10% bonus Magic damage). This ability has a 15-second cooldown. Casting Veteran's Insight grants Peppy 1 stack of Tactical Assessment. This ability turns knowledge into a powerful advantage, allowing the team to focus their attacks for maximum effectiveness.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've seen this before. Exploit their weakness!

abilities.name: Team Support
abilities.description: Peppy provides encouragement and tactical support to his allies, granting all nearby teammates a temporary boost to their stats. Allies within a 500-unit radius gain 15% increased attack damage, 15% increased magic damage and 10% increased movement speed for 6 seconds. This ability has a 20-second cooldown. This ability provides a potent team-wide advantage, enabling coordinated assaults and rapid repositioning. Using 'Team Support' grants 1 stack of Tactical Assessment.
abilities.flavorQuote: We're in this together! Push forward!

abilities.name: Tactical Assessment
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description:
Peppy gains a stack of Tactical Assessment whenever he successfully assists an ally (healing, shielding, buffing) or debuffs an enemy. At 3 stacks, Peppy can activate this ability to expend all stacks. Upon activation, choose one of the following effects:

*   **Offensive Maneuver:** Grant all allies 20% increased critical hit chance and 15% critical hit damage for 8 seconds.
*   **Defensive Formation:** Grant all allies a shield equal to 10% of their max HP and 20 tenacity for 5 seconds.
*   **Reconnaissance Sweep:** Reveal the locations of all enemy champions on the map for 4 seconds. 

After activation, Tactical Assessment is reset to 0 stacks. This passive allows Peppy to adapt to different situations and provides critical support to his team when they need it most.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright team, I've got a plan!

abilities.name: Cornerian Veteran
abilities.description: Peppy's years of experience grant him increased resilience and battlefield awareness. He gains 10% increased tenacity and reduces the duration of crowd control effects on himself by 10%. Furthermore, whenever an ally within 800 units takes damage exceeding 20% of their maximum health in a single instance, Peppy gains 1 stack of Tactical Assessment. This passive ensures Peppy can withstand enemy attacks and contribute consistently to his team, while also rewarding him for protecting his allies in dire situations.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've been through worse. Stay focused!

character_v1.playstyle: A team-oriented support that leverages knowledge and experience to empower allies, turning the tide of battle with well-timed buffs and strategic maneuvers.

abilities.description: Robo initiates a rapid diagnostic and repair sequence, targeting a single ally with a focused burst of nanobots and energy.  He temporarily diverts power from his mobility systems, causing him to be briefly stationary (0.5 seconds) while calibrating the repair matrix. Upon completion, the targeted ally receives an immediate injection of restorative nanites, healing them for an amount equal to 100% of Robo's magic attack stat. Furthermore, for each entry in Robo's internal Database, the healing potency is enhanced by an additional 10% of his magic attack stat, representing his advanced understanding of biological systems and repair protocols. If the targeted ally's current health is below 30% of their maximum health, the nanite injection is overclocked, providing an additional surge of 50% of Robo's magic attack stat as bonus healing. During the sequence, Robo emits a series of diagnostic beeps: "Initiating Recalibration Protocol... Analyzing subject's condition... Administering nanite repair solution." The efficacy of this protocol is directly linked to Robo's understanding of various biological structures, thus scaling multiplicatively with his magic attack.

abilities.name: Rocket Punch
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Robo launches his fist at a single enemy, dealing physical damage. Upon impact, Robo analyzes the target, adding a 'Combat Data' entry to his Database. This entry provides information about the target's defenses and vulnerabilities. The damage dealt by Rocket Punch is increased by 5% for each 'Combat Data' entry in Robo's Database. Additionally, the target is slowed by 20% for 2 seconds. Robo states: "Analyzing target's armor composition... Launching projectile!" This ability can be upgraded with Database entries to increase damage, slow duration, or apply a debuff that reduces the target's armor.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Calculating optimal trajectory. Firing!"

abilities.name: Laser Spin
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Robo spins rapidly, emitting a laser that damages all enemies within a radius of X. The damage is dealt as magical damage. For each unique enemy hit by Laser Spin, Robo gains one 'Area Analysis' entry in his Database, up to a maximum of 3 entries per cast. Robo declares: "Executing Area Scan. Engaging Laser Array!" These entries provide insight into AoE tactics and enemy positioning. The range of Laser Spin is increased by 10% for every 5 'Area Analysis' entries stored in the Database. The power of the laser scales with his Magic Attack stat and can be upgraded using the Database entries.
abilities.flavorQuote: "All targets within parameters. Commencing area denial!"

abilities.name: Database Upload
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Robo passively analyzes combat situations, accumulating data in his 'Database'. Robo's Database can store a maximum of 50 entries. Different abilities add different types of entries to the Database (e.g., 'Combat Data', 'Area Analysis', 'Healing Analysis'). At any time, Robo can spend these entries to upgrade his active abilities, granting them increased potency, new effects, or reduced cooldowns. Robo occasionally announces: "Processing Data Stream. System Optimization in Progress...". Each ability upgrade costs a certain amount of database entries related to the skill being upgraded, with some upgrades requiring mixed types of entries to unlock.
abilities.flavorQuote: "My data banks are expanding. Processing... processing..."

abilities.description: Robo dedicates all available processing power to analyzing enemy vulnerabilities, then converts this knowledge into a powerful burst of energy. Upon activation, Robo expends all entries in his Database, unleashing a radiant beam that deals magic damage to all enemy targets in a large area. The initial damage is amplified based on the number of entries consumed; each entry increases the base damage by a percentage derived from Robo's Attack and Magic Attack. As Robo analyzes more data, the more devastating the attack becomes. Furthermore, if Robo's Database contains at least 30 entries before activation, the intensity of the analysis allows Robo to identify and exploit critical weaknesses, applying a 'Compromised Systems' debuff to all affected enemies. This debuff reduces their magic resistance by 50% for a duration of 5 seconds, making them significantly more vulnerable to subsequent magical attacks. Robo announces: "Executing Target Analysis: Obliterate! All Systems Nominal!" as he initiates the attack sequence. This ultimate ability offers immense burst potential, especially when Robo has thoroughly studied his opponents.

abilities.description: Gabimaru focuses his Tengentsu to deliver a precise strike, dealing physical damage infused with otherworldly flames to a single target. This attack deals base damage plus a percentage of Gabimaru's Attack, scaling to a maximum of 80% ATK as fire damage. Upon striking a foe, Gabimaru ignites their life force for 3 seconds, applying 'Kindling' that reduces their outgoing damage by 5% and healing a nearby ally for a proportional amount of the damage dealt, up to 75% of the Kindling's damage reduction. The healing is distributed evenly amongst allies within a moderate radius. Gabimaru’s mastery over Tengentsu allows him to occasionally land a critical strike, increasing both the initial damage and Kindling heal potency.

abilities.name: Flickering Embers
abilities.description: Gabimaru's basic attacks on enemy champions and large monsters grant 1 stack of Hibana, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Hibana increases Gabimaru's movement speed by 3% and attack damage by 2.5. Hibana stacks decay after 4 seconds of not attacking an enemy. When Gabimaru reaches 5 stacks of Hibana, his next ability deals 15% increased damage. The decaying Hibana stacks provides a visual cue, displaying small embers fading around Gabimaru as the stacks reduce. Managing Hibana is essential for maximizing Gabimaru's burst potential and mobility in skirmishes.
abilities.flavorQuote: Even embers can ignite a raging fire.

abilities.name: Stone Storm
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Gabimaru stomps the ground, sending a volley of flaming stones in a cone-shaped area in front of him, dealing 70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 (+60% bonus AD) physical damage. If Gabimaru has any Hibana stacks, each stack consumed increases the range of Stone Storm by 5% and its damage by 8% . Successfully hitting an enemy champion with Stone Storm grants Gabimaru a burst of 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40% movement speed for 2 seconds. The visuals showcase Gabimaru's precise control over earth and fire, as the stones ignite upon impact with the ground.
abilities.flavorQuote: The earth provides, the fire consumes.

abilities.name: Ascetic Blaze
abilities.description: Gabimaru ignites himself in flames, becoming 'Hollowed' for 5 seconds. While Hollowed, Gabimaru gains 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 / 40 armor and magic resistance and deals 40 / 60 / 80 / 100 / 120 (+40% AP) magic damage per second to nearby enemies. Activating Ascetic Blaze consumes all Hibana stacks. For each Hibana stack consumed, the duration of Hollowed is extended by 0.5 seconds and the radius of the aura increases by 10%. Visuals include Gabimaru being enveloped in intense flames, radiating outwards, creating a zone of fiery devastation around him, symbolizing his inner turmoil.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the void; become the flame.

abilities.name: Tao Flow: Ignited Path
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.

The inferno leaves behind a trail of flickering flames that persists for 3 seconds. Any foe foolish enough to tread upon this fiery path will suffer an additional 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 (+15% AP) magic damage per second, the heat searing their flesh and disrupting their focus. Furthermore, if Gabimaru has harnessed at least 3 stacks of Hibana, his latent pyromantic power intensifies the technique, reducing the cooldown of Tao Flow: Ignited Path by 2 seconds, allowing for more frequent barrages. Additionally, the width of the flame trail expands by 25%, increasing the area of denial and making it even more difficult for enemies to navigate the battlefield safely.

abilities.description: Yuzuriha creates two illusory clones of herself that last for 5 seconds. These clones mimic her movements but deal no damage. If a clone is attacked, it vanishes instantly. Clones despawn after the duration ends. This ability is crucial for setting up ambushes and confusing opponents before engaging with her more damaging skills. Managing clone placement is key to maximizing its utility.
abilities.flavorQuote: Which one is the real me? Perhaps all of them.

abilities.name: Shadowstep Strike
abilities.description: Yuzuriha dashes a short distance, dealing moderate damage to the first enemy hit. The base damage is equivalent to 60% of her Attack Damage, scaling linearly to 90% at level 15. If 'Mirror Image' is active, Yuzuriha can choose to dash to the location of a clone instead, consuming that clone. If she dashes to a clone, the damage of 'Shadowstep Strike' is increased by 20%, down from 30%, and the target is stunned for 0.6 seconds, down from 0.75 seconds. Landing all strikes on a single target ensures maximum damage, turning Yuzuriha into a lethal assassin, while spreading the onslaught weakens multiple foes simultaneously, setting them up for a coordinated takedown by allies. The placement and control of Yuzuriha's clones are crucial to maximizing the potential of this skill, demanding careful planning and precise execution.

Successfully hitting an enemy champion with an enhanced ability grants Gumball a small burst of movement speed (20% for 2 seconds) and reduces the cooldown of all his other abilities by 1 second, incentivizing aggressive play.

As a Mischief Mage, On cast: this ability targets a single enemy at short range, dealing precisely tuned ice damage. The strike is designed with a specific frame data profile: it triggers a singular, heavy-impact blow. Mechanically, the damage output scales primarily with the character's ATK stat, while deriving secondary potency from Luck and critical hit modifiers. If Gumball has 100 Chaos Energy, consuming it causes the wave to charm enemies for 1 second while granting allies within the cone increased attack speed by 40% for 3 seconds. The charming effect only affects the first enemy hit. The heal amount is increased by 50% for allies with less than 40% HP. Furthermore, each enemy within the area faces a 20% chance of being momentarily transformed into a random, utterly ordinary object - perhaps a discarded trash can, a bright orange traffic cone, or even a cheerful rubber duck. This sudden shift into mundane shapes stuns the unfortunate victim for 0.5 seconds, disrupting their actions and plans. If Gumball has accumulated 100 Chaos Energy, unleashing Cartoon Physics consumes this power to amplify its effects dramatically. The affected area expands by 50%, ensuring that more foes are caught in the chaotic field. The duration of the cartoonish instability extends to 5 seconds, prolonging the period of damage and transformation. Additionally, the chance of enemies transforming increases to a comical 40%, resulting in more frequent disruptions. Enemies unlucky enough to undergo this transformation also find themselves silenced for the duration of their inanimate existence, unable to cast spells or abilities during their brief stint as a household object. This ability has a base cooldown of 15 seconds, however it is reduced by 1 second for each successful trigger of Rubber Hose Rampage.

abilities.description: Barkskin Barrier: Channeling the robust resilience of ancient trees, Sally hardens her defenses, manifesting a temporary shield of interwoven wooden fibers and resilient foliage. When activated, Sally draws ambient life energy, causing a surge of verdant growth to erupt around her, forming a protective barrier visually reminiscent of layered bark and intertwining vines. This barrier's strength scales both with Sally's defense stat, providing a significant damage mitigation buffer, and with a percentage of her maximum health, ensuring its effectiveness even against high-damage attacks. Furthermore, the 'Barkskin Barrier' offers a passive bonus to Crowd Control resistance. Specifically, it grants a substantial reduction to the duration of stuns, slows, and other impairing effects, allowing Sally to maintain her position as a steadfast protector of the party. The aesthetic is paramount: imagine glowing sap-like veins within the bark, pulsating with protective energy. The color palette should emphasize deep greens and earthy browns, with subtle hints of amber. A visual indication of the shield's remaining strength, such as cracks forming or leaves decaying as it absorbs damage, would provide crucial feedback to the player. The shield has a limited duration, making strategic timing paramount. Players must choose the moment of activation wisely to maximize its protective potential, ensuring Sally remains a bulwark against incoming threats, safeguarding her allies from harm and standing as an unyielding bastion of resilience.

If the ally uses energy, they instantly regain 40% of their maximum energy. If the ally uses a cooldown-based system, this ability reduces the cooldown of their most recent ability by 2 seconds. This effect can occur once every 8 seconds per ally. If the ally has no resource system, the ally gains a shield equal to 5% of Sally's maximum HP for 3 seconds. When thrown at an ally, Sally provides a 'Soul Pearl', increasing their attack damage or magic attack (whichever is higher) by 15% for 4 seconds. The type of item used alternates with each cast. The Rock debuff will not stack, and applying it again will only refresh the duration. Hitting the same ally with 'Soul Pearl' twice in a row will not increase the buff; instead, it grants them 10 tenacity for the same duration. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds.

Additionally, when Sally uses 'Quick Restock' on an ally, Spike also grants that ally a 5% damage reduction for 3 seconds, further enhancing their survivability. If Spike's absorbed damage is already capping Sally's shield when 'Quick Restock' is used, Spike bursts, cleansing all debuffs from Sally and nearby allies (300 units).

abilities.name: Shady Dealings
abilities.description: With a flick of her wrist and a conspiratorial wink, Sally conjures a hidden speakeasy aura, engulfing a 400-unit radius around the targeted location for a fleeting 5 seconds. Within this illicit zone, Sally's allies find themselves invigorated by her underworld connections, amplifying the effects of her 'Quick Restock' passive to dizzying heights. Mana surges back at a frantic rate, replenishing 50% of their maximum, energy floods their reserves at a breakneck 60%, and the cooldowns of their abilities plummet by 3 seconds, enabling a torrent of spells and strategic maneuvers. But the speakeasy isn't just for her friends. Enemies who inadvertently stumble into this dubious domain become 'marked' with Sally's suspicion. The next time Sally's claws strike a marked foe, she deftly pickpockets them, stealing 10% of their current gold and transferring it directly into her own overflowing pockets. Each successful theft fortifies her resolve, granting her a stack of 'Greed', each stack increasing her armor and magic resistance by 2, for a duration of 8 seconds. Sally can accumulate up to a maximum of 10 stacks of Greed, granting her an extra 20 armor and 20 magic resistance but only for a short time. Sally can only broker this deal every 15 seconds.

abilities.description: Sally rummages through Spike's peculiar hoard, conjuring a sizable chest shimmering with unknown enchantments at a chosen location within 700 units. This opulent container remains for 10 seconds, inviting interaction from allied champions. Upon approaching and engaging with the chest, each ally is granted one of three randomly selected boons: an immediate and complete replenishment of their mana or energy reserves, an ethereal shield of invulnerability rendering them immune to all damage for a fleeting 5 seconds, or a surge of restorative energy that instantly heals them for 30% of their maximum health, further augmented by an additional 10% of their missing health. Each ally is limited to receiving only a single, solitary benefit from Spike's chest. Adding to its allure, the chest emanates an enchanting aura extending 300 units outward, gradually impeding the movement speed of any enemies caught within its grasp. The slow begins at 5% and intensifies by an additional 5% each second, culminating in a maximum reduction of 30% after 6 seconds within the aura. Unfortunately, Spike’s generosity proves taxing. Once the chest vanishes, Sally experiences a brief bout of exhaustion, diminishing her movement speed by 20% for a duration of 5 seconds. This potent ability is subject to a cooldown of 120 seconds.

When struck by a critical hit, Magus loses 50 Abyssal Resonance but gains a temporary shield equal to 5% of his maximum health for 3 seconds. This shield effect can only occur once every 10 seconds. This passive mechanic forms the core of Magus's gameplay, rewarding consistent damage dealing and strategic ability usage.
abilities.flavorQuote: The shadows answer my call.

upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Whenever Toulouse uses an ability, he gains a stack of 'Inspiration'. Each stack of 'Inspiration' increases his defense by 5, stacking up to 5 times. Stacks last for 6 seconds. When Toulouse reaches 5 stacks of 'Inspiration', his next basic attack consumes all stacks to apply 'Yellow Paint' to the target enemy, reducing their magic defense by 20% for 3 seconds. This encourages active ability usage to maximize defensive capabilities and provides a window of opportunity to weaken enemies for magic damage dealers on the team.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta stay sharp and inspired!

abilities.name: Artful Agility
abilities.description: Toulouse uses his artistic prowess to create a temporary diversion. He dashes a short distance (4 units), leaving behind an 'illusionary' painting of himself at his original location. This painting lasts for 2 seconds and functions as a taunt, drawing enemy attacks. After 2 seconds, the painting crumbles, dealing 40 (+20% of Magic ATK) magic damage to nearby enemies in a 2-unit radius. This ability has a 15-second cooldown. Use this to reposition quickly, escape danger, or force enemies to waste their abilities on a fake target.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see me... or just my masterpiece?

abilities.name: Grand Canvas of Courage
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
abilities.description: Toulouse, with a flourish of his paw, channels the spirit of artistic bravery, unfurling a protective canvas that blankets the entire battlefield. For a duration of 8 seconds, all allied heroes are emboldened, receiving a 25% reduction in incoming damage, allowing them to withstand even the fiercest onslaught. But the magic of Toulouse's art doesn't stop there; with each stroke of his visionary brush, he splashes enemies within range of his allies with 'Vermillion Valor'. This vibrant mark lasts for the same duration, 8 seconds, causing affected enemies to hesitate in their attacks, dealing 10% less damage to targets other than Toulouse. The swirling pigments create an illusion of vulnerability, causing enemies to have a 30% chance to completely miss their attacks, representing the distraction of his art. Given its sweeping impact, this ultimate ability requires a cooldown of 90 seconds before it can be invoked again, demanding strategic timing to maximize its life-saving and team-empowering effects.

character_v1.name: Berlioz

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Physical.

abilities.name: Painter's Palette
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Berlioz, ever the aspiring artist, passively accumulates "Paint Splatters" at a rate of 5 per second, up to a maximum of 100. Upon reaching 100 Paint Splatters, Berlioz begins storing additional Paint Splatters as "Loaded Canvases", with each Canvas holding another 100 Splatters, up to a maximum of 3 Loaded Canvases. Every 12 seconds, Berlioz automatically creates a quick painting, expending all available Paint Splatters. The effect of this impromptu masterpiece varies based on the amount of Paint Splatters consumed. If only Splatters are consumed, the painting grants a random ally (prioritizing the one with the lowest health) a small buff for 3 seconds, granting either 5% increased attack damage (red paint), 5% increased magic damage (blue paint), or a shield absorbing 30 damage (white paint). If Loaded Canvases are consumed, the painting's buff has increased effectiveness depending on the amount of canvases used: 1 canvas will double the buff, 2 will triple it and 3 will quadruple it. Berlioz will be adorned with a color aura to showcase his artistic ability. The color of this aura corresponds to whichever buff can be provided at that time.
abilities.flavorQuote: A true artist always finds inspiration, even in the heat of battle!

abilities.name: Syncopated Shield
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~13% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Berlioz expends 40 Musical Score to cast a 'Syncopated Shield' on himself or an ally. The shield absorbs 150 damage and lasts for 4 seconds. If the shielded unit takes damage equal to or exceeding 50% of the shield's capacity within the first 2 seconds, the shield 'resonates', cleansing them of one debuff. Otherwise, the shield simply expires after 4 seconds, with no secondary effect. This ability has a cooldown of 8 seconds, starting after the shield expires or is broken. The shield's color changes based on whether it has resonated (blue) or not (red).
abilities.flavorQuote: A little off-beat protection, just in time!

abilities.name: Harmonic Taunt
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Berlioz unleashes a discordant note, taunting a targeted enemy for 1.5 seconds. This costs 30 Musical Score. While taunted, the enemy's Attack Damage is reduced by 20%. If Berlioz's Musical Score is at maximum (100) when this ability is cast, the taunt duration is increased to 2.5 seconds, and the Attack Damage reduction is increased to 40%. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds. The range of the taunt is relatively short, requiring Berlioz to be in a moderate range of the enemy. Successfully taunting an enemy also grants Berlioz 10% increased movement speed for 3 seconds, allowing him to reposition.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little discord to ruin your day!

abilities.name: Crescendo of Courage
abilities.description: Berlioz channels for 2 seconds, expending all of his current Musical Score to unleash a 'Crescendo of Courage'. The effect of the Crescendo is determined by the amount of Musical Score consumed: For every 20 Musical Score spent, all nearby allies gain 3% increased Attack and Magic damage and 3% increased Movement Speed for 5 seconds. Allies also receive a heal equal to 5% of their missing health. The radius of the Crescendo is relatively large, affecting all allies within a significant area around Berlioz. The buff durations do not stack but are refreshed upon subsequent casts of 'Crescendo of Courage'. This ability has a 15 second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let the music swell and our courage rise!

abilities.name: Aristocat Acrobatic Assault
abilities.description: Berlioz unleashes his inner Aristocat, transforming into a whirlwind of feline fury and high-pitched piano scales! Upon activation, Berlioz leaps into the air, becoming untargetable for a brief moment, channeling his inner alley cat. He then selects a target location within a moderate range. After selecting the location, Berlioz begins a series of rapid acrobatic maneuvers, dashing between up to 5 nearby enemies (prioritizing heroes), dealing physical damage with each pounce, scaling with his Attack Damage and a percentage of the target's maximum health. Each successful pounce also applies a stack of 'Discordant Note', which reduces the target's armor and magic resistance by a small amount. If there are fewer than 5 targets available, Berlioz will repeatedly bounce between the available targets, ensuring the full duration of the ultimate is utilized and maximizing the application of 'Discordant Note'. The final strike will instead critically strike the target, and inflict a short stun. Finally, Berlioz lands with a flourish, releasing a powerful, albeit slightly off-key, piano chord that grants himself and nearby allies a temporary shield and a burst of movement speed. The shield scales with Berlioz's maximum health and the number of enemies hit by the pounces. The movement speed buff lasts for 3 seconds, allowing for aggressive follow-up or a tactical retreat. Enemies affected by 'Discordant Note' suffer an additional 10% reduction to healing received for the duration of the shield buff on Berlioz's allies. The cooldown is 75 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for some… improvisational composition!

character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased attack damage for musical score allies.

character_v1.name: Cait Sith

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Lucky Mime
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the likelihood of beneficial outcomes.
Lv50: Adds a new, exceptionally rare, and powerful outcome (either positive or negative).
Lv100: Improves scaling with Luck and adds a visual indicator of the likely outcome.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~30%).
abilities.description: Lucky Mime – a highly peculiar, luck-based support ability reflective of Cait Sith’s whimsical combat style. Upon activation, Cait Sith brandishes his megaphone and begins an elaborate, utterly nonsensical mime routine. This performance, baffling to behold, has a chance to elicit one of several outcomes, both beneficial and detrimental, scaling with his Luck stat. There is a chance for a brief burst of party-wide damage reduction; a more likely chance to apply a 'Confused' status to a single enemy; or, conversely, a small possibility that Cait Sith clumsily damages himself and applies a temporary Debuff on the team. The exact nature of the outcome is determined through a complex RNG calculation, factoring in not only Cait Sith's Luck, but also the overall party's status effects, the current phase of the moon (in-game time), and whether or not any party member has recently consumed a healing potion. It truly is… unpredictable!
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got a good feeling about this... I think!

abilities.name: Lucky Charm
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~14%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Cait Sith bestows a charm of fortune upon an ally, granting them increased critical hit chance and evasion for 8 seconds. The potency of these buffs is increased by 2% per Fortune Cait Sith has stored, consuming 10 Fortune upon cast. If Cait Sith has over 50 Fortune, the ally also gains a shield equal to 10% of their maximum HP that lasts for 4 seconds. This shield scales with Cait Sith's magic attack. If Cait Sith has less than 10 Fortune, the ability instead has a 50% chance to inflict 'Misfortune' on the target, decreasing their critical hit chance and evasion for 4 seconds. The Misfortune debuff cannot occur if 'Lucky Charm' is cast on self.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little luck can go a long way, kupo!

abilities.name: Dicey Situation
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~11%).
abilities.description: Cait Sith throws a pair of loaded dice at the enemy with the highest attack. The dice roll determines the debuff inflicted. A roll of 2-6 inflicts 'Weakness' (decreases atk by 10% for 6 seconds). A roll of 7-10 inflicts 'Slow' (decreases speed by 20% for 4 seconds). A roll of 11-12 inflicts 'Silence' (prevents casting abilities for 3 seconds). Consumes 15 Fortune. If Cait Sith has over 75 Fortune, he can reroll the dice once. If Cait Sith has less than 15 Fortune, the ability has a 30% chance to backfire, debuffing a random ally instead. Debuff duration increased by 1 second per 25 magic atk.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's roll the dice and see what fate has in store!

abilities.name: Royal Decree
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
abilities.description: Cait Sith, ever the showman and royal commander, uses his megaphone to issue a *Royal Decree*, commanding his Moogle companion to execute a flashy maneuver with unpredictable results. This ability costs 20 Fortune to activate and has a cooldown of 12 seconds. Depending on Cait Sith's current Fortune, the *Royal Decree* will trigger one of three outcomes. With less than 10 Fortune, the Moogle will be easily distracted by the music of battle and begin dancing randomly, either healing one random ally for 15% of their max HP plus a bonus amount scaling with Cait Sith's magic attack, or taunting a random enemy for 3 seconds. If Cait Sith has between 10 and 90 Fortune, the *Royal Decree* has a 50% chance to either heal all allies for 15% of their maximum HP (scaling with Cait Sith's magic attack), or taunt all enemies for 3 seconds. The base chance for the heal increases by 2% for every 10 Fortune Cait Sith possesses, shifting the probability towards group healing. If Cait Sith has over 90 Fortune, then both effects occur simultaneously: the Moogle expertly heal's the party while taunting the enemy team at the same time.

abilities.name: Royal Flush
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Cait Sith plays his trump card, unleashing a wave of manipulated probability. All allies gain increased attack, magic attack, defense, and magic defense for 10 seconds. All enemies suffer reduced attack, magic attack, defense, and magic defense for 10 seconds. The potency of these buffs and debuffs is equal to 1% per 5 Fortune Cait Sith possesses at the time of casting. After casting, Cait Sith expends ALL Fortune. If Cait Sith had at least 100 fortune, the buff and debuff duration is extended by 5 seconds and cleanses all allies.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to go all in! The house always wins, kupo!

abilities.name: Spy Network
abilities.description: Cait Sith passively generates 3 Fortune per second. Whenever an enemy uses an ability, Cait Sith gains an additional 2 Fortune. When Cait Sith critically hits an enemy, he steals 5 Fortune from them, up to a maximum of 50. Cait Sith can store a maximum of 100 Fortune. Additionally, Cait Sith's basic attacks have a 15% chance to inflict 'Expose Weakness' on the target, increasing the damage they take from the next source of magic damage by 25%. Expose Weakness lasts for 4 seconds. When an ally casts an ultimate, Cait Sith gains 10 Fortune.
abilities.flavorQuote: Information is power, and I'm always listening, kupo!

character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increased shield effectiveness by 8% for allies.

character_v1.name: Riku

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Light.

abilities.name: Twilight Strike
abilities.description: Riku dashes forward a short distance, striking with Braveheart. If the Balance Gauge is tilted towards Light, the strike heals allies near the impact for X% of Riku's max HP. If the Balance Gauge is tilted towards Dark, the strike inflicts a debuff on enemies near the impact, reducing their attack damage by X% for 3 seconds. Neutral balance deals moderate damage in a small AoE with no additional effect. The dash can pass through enemy units, positioning Riku strategically. Using Twilight Strike shifts the Balance Gauge slightly towards the neutral position, promoting tactical stance-dancing.
abilities.flavorQuote: Balance is the key.

abilities.name: Dark Firaga
abilities.description: Riku channels dark energy, unleashing a potent blast of Dark Firaga that deals significant magic damage to a target and nearby enemies. This ability consumes a portion of the Balance Gauge. The amount consumed is greater the closer the Balance Gauge is to Light. If the Balance Gauge is heavily tilted towards Light, Dark Firaga deals increased damage but consumes almost the entire gauge, resetting it closer to neutral. If the Balance Gauge is heavily tilted towards Dark, the ability grants Riku a shield for 2 seconds equal to a percentage of the damage dealt. This ability is Riku's primary way of shifting the Balance Gauge towards the Dark side, allowing him to capitalize on Dark-aligned abilities. The shield granted from Dark Firaga scales with Riku's magic defense stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Embrace the darkness, control it.

abilities.name: Dark Firaga Shield
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~10%).
abilities.description: Riku channels the power of darkness to conjure a protective ward around an allied champion, manifesting as shadowy flames that envelop them for 4 seconds. This ward grants a shield that absorbs incoming damage, fortifying the ally's defenses against enemy attacks. The strength of this shield is directly proportional to Riku's defense stat, scaling dynamically to provide substantial protection. Furthermore, this ward grants the ally bonus tenacity, reducing the duration of crowd control effects like stuns, slows, and roots by 20% while active. When Riku's Balance Gauge leans toward the Light, the act of casting Dark Firaga Shield also expels any existing crowd control effects from the targeted ally, freeing them from impairments. Conversely, should the Balance Gauge be tilted towards Darkness, the shield reflects 30% of the damage it absorbs back to the attacker as true damage, bypassing conventional armor and resistance. Using this ability shifts Riku's Balance Gauge toward the Dark side, influencing the effects of his other abilities, empowering Dark-aligned effects, and diminishing the healing potency of Twilight Strike.

abilities.name: Dual Divinity
upgrades: (Bugfix) Addressed a UI bug where the Balance Meter would occasionally display an inaccurate value.
(Balance) Increased Light alignment healing output scaling from 0.15% to 0.2% per 1% Balance Meter, duration increased from 0.02 to 0.05 seconds.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Riku's very essence embodies the conflict between Light and Darkness. His Dual Divinity passive revolves around a Balance Meter that starts at equilibrium. Using Light-aspected abilities will add to the Light alignment, while casting abilities steeped in Darkness shifts the meter towards Darkness. As the Balance Meter leans, Riku gains increased effectiveness in either healing (Light) or damage mitigation (Dark). Specifically, for every 1% the Balance Meter favors Light, Riku's healing output is amplified by 0.2%, and the duration of any healing effects he applies to allies is increased by 0.05 seconds, up to a maximum of 10 seconds base. Conversely, for every 1% the Balance Meter favors Darkness, Riku gains 0.1 armor and 0.1 magic resistance, capping at 100 armor and 100 magic resistance. When the Balance Meter reaches a threshold of 75% towards either Light or Darkness, Riku can unleash a unique empowered ability. Maintaining a Balance Meter hovering within +/- 25% grants no bonus stats but allows for flexible access to a broader range of ability effects, making him a versatile hybrid character. Should Riku fully embrace either Light or Dark, reaching 100% on the Balance Meter, he gains a burst of 25 additional armor or magic resistance, depending on the alignment, that lasts for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: The Road to Dawn
abilities.description: Riku transcends his limitations, achieving a state of perfect balance between Light and Darkness for 10 seconds. While active, his Balance Gauge is locked in the neutral position, granting access to empowered versions of all basic abilities. Twilight Strike now deals increased damage and heals allies for a larger amount. Dark Firaga's shield is stronger and consumes less of the Balance Gauge after the effect ends. Guardian Light's shield is larger and both cleanses allies AND reflects damage. Additionally, Riku gains increased attack speed and movement speed during The Road to Dawn. Upon activation, the ability grants temporary immunity to crowd control effects for 1 second. This ultimate is Riku's most powerful ability, allowing him to unleash his full potential and dominate the battlefield for a short period of time. Activating this ability while the Balance Gauge is already perfectly neutral extends the duration by 2 seconds, rewarding precise gameplay.
abilities.flavorQuote: This is my road!

character_v1.playstyle: Adaptive melee fighter, shifting between Light and Dark stances to disrupt enemies, protect allies, and unleash powerful mixed damage.
character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Allies gain 12% lifesteal when dealing Dark damage.

character_v1.name: Kraid

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Earth.

abilities.name: Belly Spike Generation (Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kraid passively generates Belly Spikes over time, accumulating up to a maximum of 10 spikes. He generates 1 Belly Spike every 4 seconds. When Kraid takes damage from enemy basic attacks or abilities, he gains an additional Belly Spike, up to the maximum of 10. When reaching maximum Belly Spikes, Kraid's next basic attack is empowered, dealing an additional 50 (+10% of Kraid's maximum HP) as true damage and consuming all spikes. This passive now grants Kraid 10% damage reduction against the next source of damage after he reaches maximum spikes, lasting 2 seconds or until damage is received. This passive encourages aggressive play and rewards Kraid for being in the thick of the battle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Rrrraaaaargh! More fuel for the fire!

abilities.name: Claw Swipe
abilities.description: Kraid performs a wide, sweeping claw attack in a cone-shaped area in front of him. Enemies hit take 80 (+60% of Kraid's Attack) physical damage (up from +50%) and are knocked back a short distance. If Kraid has at least 3 Belly Spikes, he consumes them to empower the claw swipe, increasing the range and damage by 50%, and applying a slow that reduces movement speed by 30% for 3 seconds. Empowered Claw Swipe also grants Kraid a temporary shield equal to 8% of his maximum HP for 3 seconds. This ability provides area control and sets up opportunities for Kraid to initiate further attacks or peel for his teammates.
abilities.flavorQuote: Out of my way, insects!

abilities.name: Belly Spike Barrage
abilities.description: Kraid unleashes a volley of Belly Spikes in a target direction, consuming 1-5 Belly Spikes. For each spike consumed, the barrage's damage increases by 55 (+25% of Kraid's Magic Attack) (up from +20%), and the range increases linearly. If 5 spikes are used, the barrage pierces through enemies, dealing 75% damage to subsequent targets. Enemies hit by the barrage are afflicted with 'Spiked', reducing healing received by 25% for 4 seconds. Additionally, if Kraid consumes 3 or more spikes, he heals for 3% of his maximum HP for each enemy hit by the barrage, up to a maximum of 15% of his maximum HP. This ability is the cornerstone of Kraid's zone control, offering flexible damage and utility depending on the number of spikes used.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the sting of my fury!

abilities.name: Thick Hide
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Kraid reinforces his scales, gaining a shield that absorbs 250 (+60% of Kraid's Defense) damage (up from 200 (+50%)) for 4 seconds. If Kraid is hit in his vulnerable mouth area (indicated by a brief opening animation) during the shield duration, the shield breaks instantly, and Kraid is stunned for 0.75 seconds. If the shield remains unbroken for its full duration, Kraid gains 3 Belly Spikes. Furthermore, upon the shield expiring without being broken, Kraid's next Claw Swipe or Belly Spike Barrage within 5 seconds gains 20% increased damage and range, empowering his next offensive move. This ability provides crucial survivability while highlighting Kraid's inherent weakness and requiring careful positioning.
abilities.flavorQuote: My hide is impenetrable!

character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Increases max HP by 6% for Earth-aligned allies.

character_v1.name: Sylux

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Fire.

abilities.name: Shock Coil Burst
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~44%).
abilities.description: Sylux fires a rapid burst of energy from his Shock Coil, dealing X magic damage to the target and nearby enemies within a small radius. For each enemy hit, Sylux steals 5% of their current energy (mana, rage, etc.). This stolen energy is converted into a stacking buff that increases Sylux's attack and magic attack by 2% per stack, up to a maximum of 10 stacks. The buff lasts for 5 seconds, and each subsequent Shock Coil Burst refreshes the duration and can add more stacks. If there are no targets in range, Sylux will not fire. This ability costs 50 energy to use.
abilities.flavorQuote: Feel the drain of your power fueling my ascent.

abilities.name: Lockjaw Ram
abilities.description: Sylux transforms into his Lockjaw form and dashes forward a short distance, dealing X physical damage and stunning the first enemy hit for 1.5 seconds. If Sylux hits an enemy with full energy, the stun duration is increased to 2.5 seconds, and Sylux siphons 10% of their max energy. This siphon effect does not grant the buff. This ability has a moderate cooldown of 12 seconds. The range of the dash is roughly twice Sylux's normal movement speed per second. If no target is hit, Sylux simply reverts to humanoid form, making him vulnerable momentarily.
abilities.flavorQuote: Prepare for a brutal collision.

abilities.name: Adaptive Plating
upgrades: Each stack also grants a minor amount of crowd control resistance.
Reactive Plating stacks now also reduce damage taken from the ability that triggered the stack by a small amount.
Increase the duration of Reactive Plating.
The range to trigger Reactive Plating is significantly increased.
abilities.description: Sylux's advanced Chozo armor constantly analyzes and adapts to the battlefield. Whenever an enemy champion casts an ability within a range of 750 units, Sylux's armor gains a stack of 'Reactive Plating', shimmering with a brief pulse of energy. Each stack of Reactive Plating enhances Sylux's defensive capabilities, granting 3 bonus armor and 3 bonus magic resistance for 8 seconds, allowing Sylux to effectively weather incoming assaults. The maximum number of Reactive Plating stacks that can be accumulated is 15, providing a substantial boost to Sylux's defenses when fully stacked. Should the enemy champion be classified as 'Federation', Sylux's armor recognizes the technology and quickly assimilates defensive countermeasures, gaining 2 stacks of Reactive Plating per ability cast. However, to prevent excessive stacking from repeated casts by a single enemy, Reactive Plating stacks can only be gained from the same champion once every 2 seconds, forcing enemies to coordinate multiple ability casts to break Sylux's stalwart armor.

abilities.name: Delano 7 Support
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Sylux calls in his ship, the Delano 7, to bombard a targeted area with a series of energy blasts over 3 seconds. Each blast deals X magic damage to enemies in the area. Enemies caught in multiple blasts take 10% increased damage from subsequent hits. If an enemy in the targeted area is below 25% energy, the Delano 7 focuses its fire, dealing 50% more damage to that specific target. The targeted area is roughly the size of Sylux's Lockjaw Ram dash distance. This ability has a long cooldown of 20 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the firepower I've amassed.

abilities.name: Nexus Drain
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Sylux overloads his power systems, emitting a catastrophic energy pulse from his suit's central nexus. This pulse violently destabilizes energy fields within a vast radius, dealing X magic damage to all enemy units caught within its reach. The nexus field causes each enemy struck to immediately lose 20% of their current energy reserves, transferring this stolen energy directly into Sylux's protective systems. He converts 50% of the total energy drained into a temporary energy shield, offering substantial protection against incoming attacks. This shield remains active for 8 seconds, providing a crucial window of opportunity for Sylux to engage aggressively. Furthermore, during the shield's duration, each of Sylux's subsequent attacks inflicts a debuff on his targets known as 'Energy Fracture'. This effect reduces the enemy's energy regeneration rate by 5% per stack, up to a maximum of 25%, disrupting their ability to utilize their own abilities effectively. Nexus Drain demands precise timing and strategic placement, costing 100 energy to activate and requiring a lengthy cooldown of 90 seconds to recharge its formidable power. In dire circumstances, should Sylux's energy reserves fall short of the required 100 when initiating Nexus Drain, his suit will automatically siphon the remaining energy from the closest enemy champion, forcibly seizing the necessary power to unleash the devastating pulse.

character_v1.bestFriendshipBuff: Energy siphon effects heal for an additional 5%.

character_v1.name: Finn

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~21%).
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Wind.

abilities.name: Scarlet Strike
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Finn charges forward a short distance, dealing X physical damage to enemies in his path and applying a stack of 'Hero's Mark' to each enemy hit. Hero's Mark increases the damage enemies take from Finn's subsequent attacks by 3% per stack, up to a maximum of 15%. If Finn is in 'Shoko' stance from Echoes of Ooo, the charge distance is doubled and the damage is increased by 20%. This ability's cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each enemy champion hit by the charge. The attack range is telegraphed before activation, allowing enemies a brief window to evade or prepare for impact. This ability emphasizes Finn's early game aggression and utility, providing a consistent means of engaging and debuffing opponents.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's go slay some monsters!

abilities.name: Grass Sword Lash
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~26%).
abilities.description: Finn unleashes a wide sweeping attack with a spectral Grass Sword, dealing X physical damage in a cone in front of him. Enemies hit are also ensnared by the Grass Sword, rooting them in place for 1.25 seconds. If Finn is in 'Farmworld Finn' stance from Echoes of Ooo, the ensnare duration is increased to 2 seconds, and the cone's range is extended by 30%. Upon activation, Finn gains a brief burst of movement speed, allowing him to reposition slightly before unleashing the lash. This ability provides crucial crowd control, enhancing Finn's team fight presence and peel potential. Mastering the timing and positioning of this ability will allow Finn to control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: I've got the power of the grass!

abilities.name: Vault Defense
abilities.description: Finn enters a defensive stance, channeling for up to 3 seconds. While channeling, Finn gains a shield that absorbs X damage. If Finn is in 'Catalyst Comet' stance from Echoes of Ooo, the shield's absorption is increased by 50%, and any damage exceeding the shield's capacity is reflected back to the attacker as true damage. Upon ending the channel early or when the shield breaks, Finn releases a burst of energy, slowing nearby enemies by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability is crucial for surviving burst damage and turning the tide in unfavorable engagements, offering both protection and a tactical advantage.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta protect my homies!

abilities.name: Echoes of Ooo
abilities.description: Finn passively cycles through stances representing his past lives or forms every 10 seconds, granting different bonuses: 'Shoko' (Increased mobility and damage on Scarlet Strike), 'Farmworld Finn' (Enhanced crowd control on Grass Sword Lash), and 'Catalyst Comet' (Increased shield strength and damage reflection on Vault Defense). Activating an ability corresponding to the current stance consumes the stance, granting an additional effect and triggering a 3-second cooldown before cycling resumes. Consumed Shoko stance grants 10% lifesteal for 4 seconds. Consumed Farmworld Finn stance grants a 25% reduction on the next ability cooldown. abilities.description: Finn calls upon the memories of his past, creating a temporal distortion field around him for 6 seconds. Within this field, allies gain 20% increased attack speed and 15% increased movement speed. Additionally, enemies within the field have their healing and shielding effects reduced by 40%. At the end of the duration, allies are healed for X health based on 10% of the damage they dealt during the field, and enemies take X true damage based on 5% of the damage they dealt. This Ultimate provides both offensive and defensive utility, bolstering his team's capabilities while weakening the enemy. Properly timed and positioned, this can swing entire team fights in Finn's favor, emphasizing the power of remembering and learning from the past.
abilities.flavorQuote: Remember what you've learned!

abilities.flavorQuote: Lemme pick that for ya, buddy!

During this time, the ally also gains 10% increased movement speed.  If the ally is at full HP, the pancakes provide an overshield equal to 5% of their maximum HP for 5 seconds. Successfully using Bacon Pancakes grants Jake 1 'Stretch' stack. If no ally is nearby, Jake eats the pancakes himself, gaining half the healing and speed boost. Has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bacon pancakes, makin' bacon pancakes!

If Jake has 5 or more 'Stretch' stacks upon using this ability, enemies are also stunned for 1 second. Has a cooldown of 15 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time for a little...rearrangement!

abilities.name: Stretchy Guard

This redirection effect does not apply if Jake is crowd controlled (stunned, silenced, etc.). The maximum damage redirected is capped at 15% of Jake's maximum HP per instance.
abilities.flavorQuote: I got your back, Finn!

abilities.name: Warren Ampersand Form
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.

In this form, Jake gains 30% bonus HP, 20% increased Atk, and access to new abilities. While in Warren Ampersand form, Key Hand is replaced with 'Alien Grasp' which becomes a long-range grab that pulls enemies towards Jake. Bacon Pancakes! is replaced with 'Cosmic Feast', instantly healing all allies within range for 25% of their max HP. Shapeshift Slam gains a larger AoE, deals 50% increased damage and inflicts silence for 2 seconds. Upon transformation Jake instantly gains 5 'Stretch' stacks. This ability has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, let's get alien!

abilities.flavorQuote: Fall before my beauty!

abilities.name: Slave Arrow Kick

This is no mere physical strike; it manifests as a concentrated burst of concussive force projected forward, affecting all enemies caught within a line directly in front of her for 80 (+80% magic attack) magic damage. Enemies already afflicted by Petrify suffer not only from the force of the kick but are also subjected to an amplified affliction, receiving 50 (+20% magic attack) true damage. The Queen's will ensures that the Petrify does not simply end; it is prolonged, resetting the status's duration back to its original value, effectively extending the period of crowd control. The range of this ability is relatively short, encouraging close combat to maximize the impact. The true damage component allows Boa Hancock to threaten opponents regardless of their defenses.

abilities.name: Mero Mero Mellow
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~11% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Boa Hancock releases a wide-area pulse of charm, affecting all enemies within a moderate radius. Enemies who are facing Hancock have a 50% chance to be Petrified for 1.5 seconds, while those facing away are unaffected. This ability requires careful positioning to maximize its effectiveness. It can be used defensively to interrupt enemy attacks or offensively to set up combos with other abilities. Mastering the timing and positioning of Mero Mero Mellow is crucial for maximizing Boa Hancock's crowd control potential.
abilities.flavorQuote: Bask in my radiance!

abilities.name: Serpent's Charm
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Serpent's Charm scale improved — grants additional effectiveness in late-game situations.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Boa Hancock's presence emanates pure, irresistible allure, empowering her abilities through the sheer magnetism of her royal demeanor. This enchantment necessitates aggressive engagement and well-timed crowd control, as the presence of Petrified adversaries not only renders them vulnerable to follow-up assaults but also significantly augments Boa Hancock's magical output. Players must skillfully navigate the battlefield, ensuring they are both within proximity to Petrified foes and safely positioned to avoid counterattacks. By strategically utilizing Petrify to ensnare multiple enemies, Boa Hancock unleashes a formidable wave of magic-infused strikes, further solidifying her status as the Serpent Princess of Amazon Lily.

abilities.name: Supreme Love
abilities.description: Boa Hancock focuses her overwhelming love and unleashes a devastating attack. She becomes briefly invulnerable (1.5 seconds) and then dashes forward a short distance. Enemies in her path are Petrified for 2 seconds and take 200 (+100% magic atk) magic damage. Following the dash, Boa Hancock releases a final burst of energy dealing 100 (+50% magic atk) true damage to all Petrified enemies within a large radius, consuming the Petrify effect. This ultimate is a high-risk, high-reward ability, requiring precise timing and positioning to maximize its damage and crowd control potential. Mastering this ability is key to unleashing Boa Hancock's full power.
abilities.flavorQuote: For the one I love!
