Each stack of 'Dread' increases the damage they take from all sources by 4% and reduces their attack and movement speed by 2%. This passive reflects Death's constant, looming presence, weakening enemies simply by being nearby and punishing them further for engaging with him.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I do love the smell of fear."

This ability allows Death to quickly reposition, apply pressure, and control the battlefield, forcing enemies to respect his space and opening opportunities for follow-up attacks. The silence effect amplifies his disruptive capabilities against heavily weakened targets.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Everyone thinks they'll be the one to defeat me."

abilities.flavorQuote: "You're not living up to the legend."

The reduced cooldown provides added utility even when the execute condition isn't met.

abilities.flavorQuote: "Run, run, kitty."

abilities.description: Beat unleashes a burst of vibrant graffiti, creating a circular Tag Turf zone at the targeted location, covering an area roughly the size of two character models. Hostile characters caught within this freshly painted territory find their movements hampered, suffering a 20% reduction in movement speed, and their offensive capabilities are diminished with a 10% decrease in attack damage. Conversely, allied characters standing alongside Beat within the Tag Turf are energized, receiving a 10% boost to their movement speed. The effects of the Tag Turf last for 5 seconds, during which the graffiti's influence pulses outward every second, ensuring the debuffs and buffs are continuously reapplied to combatants within the area of effect. Should Beat have reached the pinnacle of his Tag Frenzy, with a full complement of stacks, any enemy unfortunate enough to be caught in the initial burst of graffiti is stunned for a crucial 2 seconds, providing a tactical advantage. Activating this ability instantly grants Beat 3 stacks of Tag Frenzy, further fueling his momentum. The ability has a 12 second cooldown before it can be used again, demanding careful planning and timing to maximize its impact. Beat's range is moderate, necessitating thoughtful positioning to effectively control key areas and manipulate the battlefield with his dynamic artwork.

The sonic blast inflicts X magic damage split over 3 seconds. The volatile pigments clinging to their systems actively scramble their ability to function, inflicting additional damage by disrupting systems. Should Beat have achieved 'Tag Frenzy' when he detonates his ultimate, the sound-suppressing effect on enemies intensifies, stretching to a full 3 seconds, leaving them utterly defenseless. The sonic and paint-based regenerative properties mend wounds and rejuvenate their fighting spirit. This ultimate embodies Beat's chaotic yet supportive style, transforming intense moments into opportunities for allies and setbacks for enemies, all while amplified by his unique sonic signature.

As the track hits its crescendo, allies find themselves invigorated by the rhythm; their attacks gain a ferocious edge, increasing damage dealt by 25% and amplifying their chances of landing critical hits by 15% for a full 7 seconds. Simultaneously, enemies caught in the sonic crossfire are overwhelmed by the sheer force of the music. 'Sonic Boombox' doesn't just shift the balance; it completely rewrites the rules of engagement, forging a decisive moment where overwhelming victory becomes not just possible, but inevitable.

abilities.description: Lucca carefully places a specially designed Miracle Aid Kit, consuming 1 Gadget Charge from her inventory. This kit emits a shimmering aura, extending 4 meters outwards, that bolsters allies within. Allies bathed in this aura experience a 12% surge in Attack Speed and a 8% increase in Movement Speed, enhancing their combat prowess and mobility. Moreover, if Lucca possesses a full complement of 3 Gadget Charges, the Aid Kit will emit a periodic revitalizing pulse every 3 seconds, mending the wounds of nearby allies. This pulse restores 25 + (0.18 * Magic Attack) HP to all affected allies, offering much-needed resilience in the heat of battle. The Miracle Aid Kit remains operational for 10 seconds, or until its structural integrity is compromised, sustaining up to 150 points of damage. Lucca must wait 12 seconds before deploying another kit, ensuring careful resource management and strategic placement on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Gadgeteer's Safeguard
abilities.description: Lucca, ever prepared with her inventions, deploys a personal energy field or grants it to a nearby ally, expending one precious Gadget Charge. This shimmering barrier absorbs incoming attacks, nullifying up to 100 + (0.4 * Magic Attack) damage, acting as a crucial buffer against immediate threats. Whether deployed on Lucca herself or a teammate, the Safeguard lasts for a tense 5 seconds, a window of opportunity for repositioning or unleashing a counter-attack. If, before its natural expiration, the Safeguard is overwhelmed and breaks, or if it reaches the end of its duration, it discharges a burst of energy. This burst propels nearby enemies backward a short distance and inflicts 40 + (0.3 * Magic Attack) magic damage. However, should Lucca possess the foresight and resources to maintain a full complement of 3 Gadget Charges when activating this ability, the Safeguard's duration is extended to 8 seconds, and the resulting energy burst significantly increases the knockback distance, disrupting enemy formations even further. After use, Gadgeteer's Safeguard requires a 15-second cooldown before it can be deployed again, demanding careful resource management and tactical planning.

abilities.name: Present for Later
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes jack ofalltrades-style interactions.
abilities.description: Lucca, ever the inventor, lays down one of her ingenious Telepod Traps. This high-tech marvel remains invisible to enemies, blending seamlessly into the environment. Once placed, the trap waits patiently for up to 20 seconds. Should an unsuspecting foe wander within a 2.5-meter radius, the trap springs to life, engaging its teleportation matrix. The device instantly beams all enemies within its radius to a pre-determined destination, set by Lucca during the trap's placement; this teleportation destination can be anywhere within a 6-meter range of the trap's original location. But the fun doesn't stop there! Upon successful transport, the trap self-destructs in a blaze of glory, unleashing a fiery explosion that deals 150 damage plus an additional amount equal to 100% of Lucca's Magic Attack. The lingering heat also leaves the teleport destination with a substantial 40% slow effect for a duration of 2 seconds, hampering enemy movement and giving Lucca and her allies a tactical advantage. This ability has a 70-second cooldown.

abilities.name: Tinkerer's Tenacity
upgrades: (Tuning) Charge Frequency: Reduced cooldown between charge generation to 17 seconds.
(Adjustment) Empowered Arsenal: Additionally grants 2.5% Spell Vamp for each Gadget Charge.
abilities.description: Lucca, ever prepared, keeps a reservoir of Gadget Charges ready for deployment. She passively generates 1 Gadget Charge every 20 seconds, storing up to a maximum of 3. Activating any of Lucca's abilities consumes one Gadget Charge, ensuring each gadget is fueled for action. But the innovation doesn't stop there; for each Gadget Charge Lucca possesses, her Magic Attack is boosted by 5%, capping at a 15% increase when all three charges are available. This bonus empowers her offensive capabilities and encourages mindful resource management. In dire situations, when Lucca's health dwindles below 25%, her inventive spirit kicks into overdrive! She regenerates Gadget Charges at twice the normal rate, giving her access to her gadgets faster and granting her more flexibility in the heat of battle. This resilience ensures she can continue supporting her team, even on the brink.

This display of affection costs 50 mana and is available every 8 seconds, allowing Valentino to maintain a constant flow of adoring, albeit temporarily controlled, fans.

abilities.name: Red Light District
abilities.description: Valentino creates a zone of 'Red Light' at a target location that lasts for 5 seconds. Enemies within the zone are slowed by 30% and take X magic damage per second. Additionally, enemies entering the zone gain 1 stack of 'Contractual Obligation' every second, up to a maximum of 3 stacks while inside. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds and consumes 75 mana. The air shimmers with lust and desperation, a playground where Valentino holds all the cards, and pleasure comes at a steep price. Zone Radius: 300 units, Cast Range: 700 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Welcome to my domain. You can check out any time you like, but you can never leave.

abilities.name: Soul Contract
abilities.description: Valentino marks a target enemy with a 'Soul Contract' for 8 seconds. While under the effect of 'Soul Contract', the target takes 15% increased damage from all sources. If the target has 3 or more stacks of 'Contractual Obligation', this ability also charms the target, forcing them to attack their nearest ally for 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds and consumes 100 mana. The contract is signed in blood and sealed with a kiss, a twisted agreement where the only winner is Valentino. Range: 600 units.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sign here, darling. It's just a formality… mostly.

abilities.name: Overlord's Aura
abilities.description: Valentino passively exudes an aura of dominance. Allies within 400 units gain 10% increased attack damage and 10 tenacity. Enemies within the same radius have their healing received reduced by 15%. In addition, whenever an enemy gains a stack of 'Contractual Obligation', Valentino gains a shield equal to 3% of his maximum health, stacking up to a maximum of 15% of his max HP as a shield. This shield lasts for 5 seconds. The air crackles with power, a testament to Valentino's influence and a constant reminder of his control.
abilities.flavorQuote: Remember who you're working for.

abilities.name: Grand Entrance
upgrades: (Patch) Enhanced Direction: This ability now prioritizes support-style interactions.
(Patch) Enhanced Direction: This ability now prioritizes utility-style interactions.
(Bugfix) Resolved conflicting trigger interactions that occurred during live matches, reduced occurrence by approximately 21%.
(Patch) Enhanced Direction: This ability now prioritizes healer-style interactions.
abilities.description: With a dramatic flourish, Valentino unleashes his ultimate charm, staging a 'Grand Entrance' within a 600-unit radius. Enemies caught in this spectacle immediately suffer X magic damage as his presence overwhelms them, simultaneously inflicting three stacks of 'Heart Eyes'. As the performance unfolds over the next 6 seconds, Valentino's manipulative artistry truly shines. Enemies already struggling with five or more stacks of 'Heart Eyes' are completely enthralled, becoming hopelessly devoted to Valentino’s entourage. Driven by an insatiable desire to be part of the inner circle, they uncontrollably rush toward the nearest allied hero within a 400-unit range, their pace quickened by a 30% movement speed boost in their desperate bid for attention. However, the illusion is fleeting. Upon reaching the targeted ally, the 'Heart Eyes' dissipate, and the crushing reality of unattainable adoration sets in, stunning the affected enemy for a devastating 1.5 seconds. But Valentino always ensures a dazzling finale. The allied hero closest to Valentino is showered with an intoxicating wave of affection, becoming 'Beloved' and reveling in the adoration, gaining an overwhelming +100% damage boost for 3 seconds, ensuring the performance concludes with a resounding ovation. This extravagant display requires a cooldown of 120 seconds and a mana cost of 200. In Valentino’s world, everyone has a role to play, and the highest honor is to bask in his attention.

character_v1.playstyle: Valentino excels at manipulating enemies, forcing them to turn on each other, and controlling the battlefield with debuffs and area denial. He thrives in prolonged engagements where he can stack 'Contractual Obligation' and turn the tide of battle through strategic target prioritization.
appearanceTags: Tall moth demon with pink skin
Signature red coat formed from wings

character_v1.name: Honey the Cat

abilities.name: Basic Attack
upgrades: Lv10: +small damage scaling
Lv50: +bonus crit chance / improved multi-hit interactions
Lv100: base damage increases and minor utility interaction
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Ranged basic attack dealing physical damage; elemental: Dark.

abilities.name: Shadow Sneak
abilities.description: Honey dashes a short distance, becoming briefly invulnerable during the dash. Upon reaching the destination, she leaves behind a 'Fashion Illusion' at her starting point that lasts for 3 seconds. Enemies that touch the Fashion Illusion are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. If Honey has at least one active 'Pop-Up Shop', the slow duration is increased to 4 seconds. Multiple uses within 5 seconds reduce the dash distance by 25% per stack, resetting after the cooldown. This ability allows Honey to quickly reposition and create strategic chokepoints.
abilities.flavorQuote: Did you see me move? Neither did they!

abilities.name: Pop-Up Shop
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Honey deploys a temporary 'Pop-Up Shop' at the target location. The shop lasts for 15 seconds and grants vision in a small radius. Enemies within the radius take 10 true damage per second. The maximum number of active Pop-Up Shops is 3. Each active Pop-Up Shop grants Honey 'Brand Awareness', increasing the effectiveness of her other abilities. Deploying a new shop while at the maximum number despawns the oldest shop. Enemies destroying a Pop-Up Shop refund 25% of the cooldown. This ability is core to Honey's zone control, creating areas of denial and empowering her kit.
abilities.flavorQuote: Now open! Limited time only!

abilities.name: Studio Strobe Burst
abilities.description: Honey launches a state-of-the-art, mobile photography drone towards the designated area, a device practically overflowing with cutting-edge strobe technology. Upon arrival, the drone unleashes a blinding wave of rapidly pulsating light, creating a zone of intense sensory overload. Enemies caught within the 4-meter radius of this dazzling display are immediately afflicted with the 'Blinded' status, their accuracy plummeting by a significant 50% and their movement speed reduced by 25%, leaving them vulnerable for a full 4 seconds. This disruption in their sensory input makes them easy prey for Honey's allies to take advantage of their disoriented state. Further enhancing this disruptive capability, if Honey currently has at least two 'Pop-Up Shops' actively operating on the field, the sensory assault from the strobe burst intensifies, inflicting the 'Stunned' status for a brief but crucial 0.75 seconds, completely incapacitating any affected foes, effectively interrupting their actions and opening up opportunities for decisive maneuvers. The photography drone has a limited battery life, deactivating after a total of 6 seconds. Careful planning and strategic deployment are essential to maximize the potential of this ability.

abilities.name: Signature Style
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Honey's basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of 'Style Points' to enemies hit, up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Style Points reduces the target's magic defense by 3%. When a target reaches 5 stacks, Honey gains a burst of speed, increasing her movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds. The speed boost is doubled if Honey has 3 'Pop-Up Shops' active. The stacks decay one at a time, every 2 seconds. This passive encourages aggressive play and rewards Honey for maintaining pressure on her opponents.
abilities.flavorQuote: Everyone wants a piece of my style!

abilities.name: Glittering Catwalk
upgrades: (Refinement) Resolved a rare issue where the visual effects of Glittering Catwalk lingered briefly after the duration expired.
(Balance) Adjusted the regeneration rate and damage per second values of Glittering Catwalk to enhance its utility as an area denial tool.
(Enhancement) Altered Glittering Catwalk's effects to further emphasize tactical control and engagement management.
abilities.description: Honey snaps her fingers with a flourish, instantly manifesting a shimmering catwalk in a line before her, lasting for a glorious 8 seconds. Allies who confidently stride down this catwalk find themselves infused with Honey's boundless energy. Their movement speed increases by a noticeable 30%, enabling swift maneuvers and relentless pursuit. They also receive a comforting dose of Honey's nurturing spirit, regenerating 3% of their maximum health every second, mending wounds and bolstering their endurance. Conversely, opponents stumbling onto Honey's glamorous stage are caught in its mesmerizing glare, their movement slowed by a substantial 40% as they struggle to maintain their footing. Furthermore, the sheer brilliance of the lights inflicts 50 magic damage per second, disorienting them and disrupting their plans. For each active 'Pop-Up Shop' that Honey has deployed, the Catwalk's benefits are amplified. The movement speed bonus and health regeneration rate for allies each increase by an impressive 20% per shop, up to a maximum boost of 60%. Thus, Honey transforms a simple strip of fabulous floor into a strategic advantage, converting style points into sheer combat effectiveness.

character_v1.playstyle: Honey excels at controlling areas with her 'Pop-Up Shops' and disrupting enemy formations with agile movements and fashion-themed debuffs. She focuses on strategic positioning and empowering her abilities through Brand Awareness.

character_v1.name: Iron Man

abilities.name: Repulsor Strike
upgrades: Lv10: Increases damage scaling to 60% ATK.
Lv50: Repulsor Strike now grants Iron Man a temporary shield absorbing damage equal to 10% of his maximum health for 3 seconds.
Lv100: If 'Stagger' is applied, the target also receives a debuff that reduces healing received by 25% for 5 seconds.
abilities.description: Iron Man unleashes a focused pulse of energy from his gauntlet, striking a single target with concussive force and dealing physical damage equal to 50% of his Attack stat. This initial strike also inflicts 'Armor Weakness' for 3 seconds, reducing the target's armor rating by 15%. Should Iron Man's armor rating be greater than the target's when this ability is activated, the strike's damage increases to 75% of his attack and applies a 'Stagger' effect for 1 second. Stagger interrupts most actions and briefly reduces the target's movement speed by 30%. In addition, Repulsor Strike generates a small amount of threat, drawing enemy attention toward Iron Man and making him a more appealing target for enemy attacks for 2 seconds. This threat generation increases based on his Armor rating and Max HP.

abilities.name: Repulsor Blast
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Iron Man unleashes a focused beam of energy from his gauntlets, dealing 90 (+60% magic atk) magic damage to the first enemy hit. This ability generates 10 Repulsor Charge. If Iron Man has at least 30 Repulsor Charge, he can consume it to empower the blast, causing it to pierce through the first enemy and deal 50% damage to enemies behind the initial target. The empowered blast also applies a stacking debuff, reducing the target's magic defense by 5% for 5 seconds, stacking up to 3 times, amplifying subsequent damage. This ability has a 6-second cooldown, allowing for frequent use and strategic resource management.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to even the odds.

abilities.name: Arc Overload
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~16%).
abilities.description: Iron Man channels the Arc Reactor's energy, creating a surge around him that lasts for 4 seconds. During Arc Overload, his basic attacks gain 40% lifesteal and inflict an additional 30 (+20% magic atk) magic damage on hit. Activating Arc Overload consumes 20 Repulsor Charge. If Iron Man has less than 20 Repulsor Charge, the lifesteal is reduced to 20%. This ability has a 12-second cooldown. The synergy between lifesteal and bonus damage makes it a potent tool for sustaining Iron Man in prolonged engagements, encouraging players to balance resource expenditure with strategic timing. The ability benefits from a high magic attack stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's crank up the juice!

abilities.name: Jet Propulsion
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~12%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~25%).
abilities.description: Iron Man engages his suit's thrusters, dashing a short distance in a target direction. This ability grants him a brief shield, absorbing up to 150 (+30% magic def) damage for 2 seconds. Jet Propulsion generates 15 Repulsor Charge upon use. If Iron Man has at least 40 Repulsor Charge, he can consume it to extend the dash distance by 50% and increase the shield value by 75 (+15% magic def). This ability has a 10-second cooldown. Jet Propulsion offers both offensive and defensive capabilities, allowing Iron Man to reposition, engage, or escape from danger effectively. It also promotes strategic use of Repulsor Charge for enhanced mobility and survivability.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gotta go fast!

abilities.name: Adaptive Armor (Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Iron Man's armor passively adapts to incoming threats. Every 5 seconds, he gains a buff based on the type of damage he has received most recently. If the last damage received was physical, he gains 15 armor. If the last damage received was magical, he gains 15 magic resistance. These bonuses last for 5 seconds. Additionally, Iron Man's maximum Repulsor Charge is increased by 25. This passive encourages players to be aware of the damage types they are facing and to adjust their playstyle accordingly, adding a layer of strategic depth to Iron Man's kit.
abilities.flavorQuote: My systems are always learning.

abilities.name: Hulkbuster Protocol (Ultimate)
abilities.description: Iron Man deploys the Hulkbuster armor, transforming for 12 seconds. While in Hulkbuster mode, his HP is increased by 500, his attack damage is increased by 60, and he gains the Unstoppable status, rendering him immune to crowd control effects. Each basic attack during this time consumes 5 Repulsor Charge and deals area damage in a small cone in front of him, dealing 50 (+30% atk) physical damage to all enemies hit. After the duration ends, Iron Man reverts to his normal form. This ability has a long 60-second cooldown. The Hulkbuster Protocol serves as Iron Man's ultimate trump card, allowing him to temporarily become a formidable melee threat and turn the tide of battle.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time to bring out the big guns!

character_v1.playstyle: Resource Management, Sustained Damage, High Mobility

character_v1.name: Captain America

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Captain America automatically blocks the next incoming basic attack every 8 seconds, reducing the damage taken by 75% and generating 1 stack of Vibranium Resonance. Additionally, each time Captain America is struck by an AOE attack he gains 1 stack of Vibranium Resonance. This ability has a cooldown of 2 seconds for AOE attacks. Vibranium Resonance stacks up to a maximum of 5. When Captain America reaches 5 stacks, he consumes all stacks to enter 'Rallying Cry' state for 5 seconds, granting himself and all allies within a moderate radius 15% increased attack speed and 10% damage reduction. Damage Reduction will not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can do this all day.

abilities.name: Vibranium Throw
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Captain America throws his shield at the targeted enemy, dealing 120% ATK as physical damage. If Captain America has any stacks of Vibranium Resonance, this ability consumes one stack to cause the shield to ricochet to one additional nearby enemy, dealing 80% ATK as physical damage. If the ricocheted target is affected by a debuff (stun, slow, etc) the primary target also gains the same debuff with a 50% effectiveness and duration of 1 second. Captain America regains his shield automatically after 3 seconds or immediately if he uses another ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: He's all over the place!

abilities.name: Strategic Advance
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~12% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Captain America dashes towards the targeted ally, granting them a shield equal to 10% of his max HP for 4 seconds. While the shield is active, all damage the shielded ally takes is redirected to Captain America. Consumes 1 stack of Vibranium Resonance to cleanse one debuff from the ally before applying the shield. This ability has a range slightly larger than average. This ability can be used on himself. If no ally is targeted, Captain America simply dashes a short distance.
abilities.flavorQuote: Avengers, move out!

abilities.name: Mjolnir's Call
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~39%).
abilities.description: Captain America calls upon Mjolnir, imbuing his shield with its power for 8 seconds. While active, basic attacks deal additional 50% magic attack as electric damage, and the 'Vibranium Throw' ability now calls lightning at the target area dealing 100% magic attack as electric damage to enemies within a small area of effect. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Consumes 2 stacks of Vibranium Resonance to also grant himself 30% increased magic defense for the duration. This ability can only be used if Captain America has at least 2 stacks of Vibranium Resonance.
abilities.flavorQuote: I can do this all day... and summon lightning!

abilities.name: Final Stand
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Captain America inspires his team, greatly boosting their effectiveness for 10 seconds. For the duration, all allies have 25% increased atk, def, magic atk, and magic def. In addition, Captain America becomes immune to all crowd control effects and gains 50% damage reduction. After the duration ends, Captain America consumes all stacks of Vibranium Resonance, healing all allies within a large radius for X HP per stack consumed. This heal scales with 50% of Captain America's defense and 50% of his magic defense.
abilities.flavorQuote: Avengers, assemble!

abilities.description: Black Panther is perpetually enveloped by Wakandan nanites, granting him unparalleled agility. He gains a 15% increase in movement speed and a 10% bonus to evasion. Furthermore, Black Panther's unique Vibranium suit absorbs incoming damage, converting 30% of all damage taken into Kinetic Energy. This energy can be unleashed through his other abilities. The maximum Kinetic Energy Black Panther can store is equal to 200% of his maximum health. Managing Kinetic Energy is crucial to maximizing Black Panther's effectiveness in battle, allowing for powerful bursts of damage or tactical maneuvers.
abilities.flavorQuote: Agility and resilience, the hallmarks of the Panther.

abilities.name: Vibranium Strike
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Black Panther unleashes a swift, precisely aimed strike with his Vibranium claws. Deals 100% of attack damage as physical damage to the target. If Black Panther has at least 25% Kinetic Energy stored, he can expend it to empower the strike, increasing the damage to 150% and applying a stacking bleed effect, dealing 10% of attack damage as true damage over 3 seconds, stacking up to 3 times. This ability has a cooldown of 5 seconds. Strategic use of Kinetic Energy allows Black Panther to control the flow of battle, applying pressure with sustained damage or conserving energy for more strategic plays.
abilities.flavorQuote: A single strike, perfectly executed.

abilities.name: Shadow Pounce
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~15% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~16% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Black Panther utilizes his advanced suit technology to briefly become nearly invisible, dashing a short distance to a target location. If Black Panther has at least 50% Kinetic Energy stored, expending it during the dash grants him true invisibility for 1.5 seconds upon arrival. The dash has a range of 8 units and a cooldown of 10 seconds. The true invisibility effect breaks upon attacking or using another ability. This ability enables Black Panther to swiftly reposition, initiate ambushes, or evade danger, making him a difficult target to pin down.
abilities.flavorQuote: They cannot see me, but they will feel me.

abilities.name: Kinetic Burst
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Black Panther expends all stored Kinetic Energy to unleash a powerful burst of energy, dealing damage to all enemies within a 5-unit radius. The damage dealt is equal to 50% of the expended Kinetic Energy as magic damage. Additionally, enemies hit by the burst are slowed by 30% for 2 seconds. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Careful management of Kinetic Energy is essential to maximizing the impact of this ability, allowing Black Panther to deliver devastating area-of-effect damage and control the battlefield.
abilities.flavorQuote: The power I absorb, I unleash!

abilities.name: Wakandan Tech Adaptation
abilities.description: Black Panther analyzes the battlefield and instantaneously adapts his suit to exploit enemy weaknesses. For 10 seconds, Black Panther gains a stacking buff based on damage received. For every instance of physical damage received, his attack damage increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. For every instance of magic damage received, his magic attack damage increases by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. This effect lasts for 8 seconds after activation. This ability has a cooldown of 60 seconds. This adaptation showcases Black Panther's tactical brilliance and access to advanced Wakandan technology, allowing him to turn enemy attacks into opportunities for increased damage output.
abilities.flavorQuote: Wakanda's technology, always evolving.

abilities.name: Squirrel Ambush
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes assassin-style interactions.

abilities.description: Squirrel Girl, fueled by a tactical need and twenty of her precious acorns, orchestrates a daring squirrel ambush targeting a single enemy champion. Upon activation, a coordinated strike force of squirrels descends from the foliage, focusing their efforts on a specific foe within a moderate range. The initial impact delivers a burst of X magic damage. What truly sets this ambush apart is the ensuing chaos: the targeted enemy finds themselves beset by relentless squirrel nibbles and scratches, applying a Mark to them for 5 seconds that increases the damage they take from Squirrel Girl by 10%. Each subsequent attack or ability from Squirrel Girl consumes the Mark, dealing an additional burst of true damage equal to 15% of the target's missing health, maximizing efficiency when eliminating wounded enemies. Should Squirrel Girl have accumulated additional acorns—specifically, up to 40 bonus acorns—the cunning rodent operatives enhance their assault. For every additional 10 acorns consumed, the squirrel squadron intensifies their efforts, extending the Mark duration by 1 second, allowing for sustained engagement and increased tactical flexibility. The squirrels, driven by a singular purpose, ensure the most opportune strike for their leader, granting Squirrel Girl a potent tool in isolating and eliminating key targets.

abilities.name: Nutty Command
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~28%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~21%).
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl generates 5 Acorns every 2 seconds. The maximum number of Acorns she can hold is 100. Additionally, allies near Squirrel Girl gain 5% increased movement speed. This passive allows Squirrel Girl to maintain a steady flow of resources, enabling consistent use of her active abilities. Positioning near allies is crucial to maximize the utility of the movement speed bonus, enhancing their mobility in skirmishes and rotations. Proper acorn management is key to playing Squirrel Girl effectively, balancing spending for immediate impact versus saving for larger, more impactful abilities.
abilities.flavorQuote: Gather 'round, it's time to strategize!

abilities.name: Acorn Armor
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl spends 30 Acorns to grant an ally a shield that absorbs X damage for 4 seconds. If the shield is not broken before it expires, the ally gains 10% increased attack damage for 6 seconds. This ability offers both immediate protection and a delayed offensive buff, rewarding skillful timing and target selection. Prioritize shielding allies who are likely to take significant damage or those who can best capitalize on the subsequent damage boost. The visual effect is quite charming - your ally becomes briefly covered in adorable acorn-shaped protective charms.
abilities.flavorQuote: A little protection goes a long way!

abilities.name: Tippy-Toe's Gambit
upgrades: (Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl commands Tippy-Toe to target an enemy, taunting them for 1.5 seconds. During this time, the enemy's damage is reduced by 15%. If the target attacks Tippy-Toe during this period, Tippy-Toe evades the attack and the enemy is rooted for 0.75 seconds, consuming Tippy-Toe. (Tippy-Toe respawns after 10 seconds). This ability offers a strong interrupt and damage mitigation tool, particularly effective against high-damage burst champions. Sacrifice Tippy-Toe strategically to control enemy aggression and create openings for your team. It is important to note that because Tippy-Toe is so small, most enemies don't realize they've even been taunted, leading to hilarious and effective results.
abilities.flavorQuote: Alright, Tippy-Toe, you're up!

abilities.name: Nutty Onslaught
upgrades: (Balance Adjustment) Fine Tuning: overall power slightly reduced, but late-game potency improved.
abilities.description: Squirrel Girl cracks her knuckles with a mischievous grin, unleashing a coordinated Nutty Onslaught from every nook and cranny. The squirrels, driven by the promise of tasty acorns, surge forward in a frenzied wave, dealing X magic damage to any enemy unfortunate enough to be caught in their path. As they swarm, the force of their combined assault knocks enemies skyward for a brief 1 second, disrupting their formations and setting them up for follow-up attacks. The power of this ultimate isn't just in the initial squirrel surge; it scales dynamically with Squirrel Girl's stored acorns. For every 10 acorns spent fueling this frenzy, the damage intensifies by 5%, and the duration of the knock-up effect extends by 0.1 seconds. This enhancement can stretch the displacement to a maximum of 2 seconds, ensuring a prolonged period of vulnerability for the unfortunate targets. Squirrels cascade from her pockets, leap from behind cover, and even materialize from thin air - a truly bewildering and overwhelming spectacle. Squirrel Girl's understanding of applied squirrel-power is truly unparalleled.

abilities.description: Panda embodies the might of three distinct Cursed Corpse forms dwelling within him: Panda, Gorilla, and Rhino, each a repository of specialized combat prowess and vulnerabilities. Panda begins each battle in his balanced Panda form, a versatile state of equilibrium. Upon activating most of his other abilities, Panda briefly channels the essence of the corresponding form, unleashing its unique advantages for 4 seconds. The Normal Panda form provides a consistent boon, increasing Tenacity by 12%, bolstering Panda's resistance to crowd control effects. The Gorilla form surges with raw aggression, granting a 24% increase to Attack, but reducing Defense by 12%. Conversely, the Rhino form fortifies Panda's defenses, increasing Defense by 24% while reducing Attack by 12%. However, over-reliance on a single form strains its internal integrity. Each form possesses a Core Integrity score, starting at 100. Each time Panda shifts to a specific form, its corresponding Core Integrity is reduced by 33. Once a Core's Integrity reaches 0, Panda cannot access that form until it regenerates to full Integrity. This regeneration process takes a fixed 5 seconds for each form, encouraging tactical decisions on when and which form to adopt. This constant interplay between forms and integrity management turns Panda into a strategic battlefield manipulator, demanding careful planning and predictive awareness. The careful management of Core Integrity is paramount to unleashing Panda's full potential, requiring him to alternate forms effectively to avoid locking himself out of crucial buffs or damage mitigation at critical moments.

abilities.description: Panda, true to his nature, expresses himself through a flurry of precise, yet powerful, strikes. Over the course of 2 seconds, he unleashes a series of jabs, each strike dealing a calculated 60 plus 60% of Panda's Attack stat as physical damage to his chosen target. Panda's stance dictates the additional effects accompanying this flurry. When in his default, composed state, each application of 'Expressive Beatdown' leaves the target with a stack of 'Perplexed'. 'Perplexed' reduces the target's Defense by 5% per stack, with a maximum of 3 stacks, representing their bewilderment at Panda's fighting style. When Panda shifts into his volatile Gorilla Mode, the 'Expressive Beatdown' becomes even more potent, now dealing 90 plus 90% of Panda's Attack damage and grants Panda 10% Lifesteal for the duration of the strikes. Shifting into his sturdy Triceratops stance grants Panda a shield for 3 seconds, absorbing 80 damage, plus 80% of his Defense stat, and if that shield is broken, it will apply the 'Taunt' status effect for one second to the target, compelling them to focus their attention on the undeniably charming Panda.

abilities.description: Panda focuses his cursed energy, unleashing a devastating strike. In his default Normal form, he delivers a crushing blow dealing 100 plus 100% of his Attack as physical damage to a single enemy, creating a shockwave that knocks the target back a moderate distance, disrupting their position. When channeling his Gorilla form, the attack's focus shifts to pure damage, increasing his critical hit chance by 15% and amplifying the potential for devastating blows; however, tapping into this raw power reduces his Gorilla Core Integrity by 20, pushing him closer to reverting to his normal state. When drawing upon the resilience of his Triceratops form, Panda becomes an unstoppable force, surging forward and becoming immune to all crowd control effects for the attack's duration; in addition, he reinforces his defenses, gaining 20% damage reduction for 2 seconds after the ability's completion.

abilities.description: Panda delves deep within his complex Cursed Corpse constitution, unleashing a rapid-fire, six-second metamorphosis through his three distinct cores. With each transformation, Panda gains access to the unique active ability tied to that specific form, dramatically enhancing both his offensive and defensive capabilities in a whirlwind of controlled chaos. The transformation sequence adheres to a strict, unyielding order: Normal Core, then Gorilla Core, finally Triceratops Core, with each form dominating Panda's physical and energetic presence for exactly 2 seconds, demanding unwavering focus and precise control. As each core is activated, the strain is palpable, immediately draining 15 Core Integrity from the corresponding source, forcing Panda to carefully manage his inner reserves. As the final form's influence wanes, the accumulated stress takes its toll, abruptly draining an additional 20 Core Integrity from his remaining reserves. This adaptive onslaught unleashes a total of 450 + (4.5 * Atk) physical damage to all enemies within a generous radius, pulverizing their defenses with each successive shift, while simultaneously manifesting a protective shield around Panda, absorbing 100 + (1.0 * Def) damage from incoming attacks. The sheer force of these consecutive forms threatens to overwhelm any foe that dares to challenge Panda's metamorphic might.

abilities.description: Goofy, ever the resourceful and endearingly clumsy hero, unveils his signature 'Goofy Getup'! In a flurry of limbs and exaggerated poses, Goofy rapidly dons a series of utterly ridiculous (and often hilariously ineffective) outfits and props, each providing a brief but beneficial effect. The initial phase involves a comical attempt to wield an oversized frying pan as a shield, granting brief damage reduction and a small chance to parry incoming attacks. Next, he might don a pair of spring-loaded shoes, allowing him to leap clumsily towards a targeted ally, granting them a short burst of movement speed and evasion. Finally, there's always the chance he'll break out his fishing rod and attempt to 'catch' an enemy, momentarily disrupting their casting animation. The success of these antics are governed by a combination of luck and timing, making this ability a thrilling gamble for both Goofy and his team. Remember that while the effects are inherently chaotic, their effectiveness depends on Goofy's current HP and resistance stats!

abilities.description: Dr. Light deploys a Helper Bot onto the battlefield. These bots are fragile, possessing only 50% of Dr. Light's Max HP, but provide invaluable support. Dr. Light can have a maximum of two Helper Bots active at any given time. Deploying a third bot will cause the oldest bot to self-destruct. Upon deployment, the bot pulses an aura affecting allies within a radius of 300 units, granting them 10% increased movement speed and 5% increased attack speed for 5 seconds. Helper Bots are immobile and prioritize staying near Dr. Light. The AI will target the closest hero at the beginning of their generation, however. Enemies targeting the Helper Bot will cause them to flash, gaining a temporary shield of 100 points that lasts for 3 seconds, with a 10 second cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Let's see what we can do with a little ingenuity!

upgrades: (Patch) Emphasis on controller role

abilities.description: Dr. Light channels his extensive engineering expertise, focusing sophisticated repair algorithms to enhance a chosen Helper Bot. Activating Adaptive Augmentation initiates a recalibration sequence, selecting a single, deployed Helper Bot to become the focal point of the doctor's attention. The targeted bot receives an immediate influx of energy, mending damaged circuits and restoring integrity, healing the bot for 20% of its maximum health. Furthermore, Dr. Light can implement a dedicated specialization protocol, permanently altering the bot's operational directives down one of two distinct upgrade paths: Offensive Calibration, re-tuning energy output to generate an amplification aura, granting allies within the bot's influence a 10% increase to their attack damage. Or Defensive Plating, generating a protective energy barrier around the selected Helper Bot, granting it a permanent shield equal to 10% of Dr. Light's maximum health. This shield automatically regenerates if depleted, restoring itself fully over a period of 15 seconds. Only one augmentation can be applied per bot, with Adaptive Augmentation having a cooldown period of 10 seconds between uses, allowing the doctor to adapt to changing battlefield dynamics and bot conditions. Choose wisely, as these augmentations are permanent!

abilities.name: Polarity Pulse
abilities.description: Dr. Light commands one of his active Helper Bots to emit a powerful Polarity Pulse. Upon activation, the selected Helper Bot overloads its internal regulators, sending out a wave of disruptive energy in a cone-shaped area extending 400 units in front of it, with a 60-degree arc. Enemies caught within this cone are subjected to a dual effect: they are forcefully knocked back a distance of 150 units, disrupting their positioning and interrupting channeled abilities. Following the knockback, the same enemies experience a localized magnetic field inversion, causing a reduction in their movement speed by 30% for a duration of 3 seconds. This effect is calculated based on Dr. Light's magic attack stat, with the slow potency scaling linearly with his magic attack, up to a maximum of 50% slow. The Polarity Pulse has a cooldown of 12 seconds, balancing its disruptive power with strategic deployment. The Helper Bot requires 1.5 seconds to charge up before it can release the pulse, indicated by a visual cue. During this time, the bot becomes more vulnerable, taking 15% increased damage. This ability provides a critical tool for area denial, peeling for allies, and disrupting enemy engagements, empowering Dr. Light's strategic impact on the battlefield.

upgrades: Gain a 10% movement speed buff when Reactive Hardening is fully stacked.

abilities.description: Dr. Light, a paragon of scientific foresight, has embedded his creations with defensive subroutines that dynamically respond to threats. Whenever Dr. Light or one of his Light Bots absorbs punishment from enemy abilities or basic attacks, his integrated systems perform a swift threat assessment, immediately initiating the 'Reactive Hardening' sequence. This sequence fortifies Dr. Light, increasing his armor by 3% for a duration of 8 seconds. This adaptive hardening effect can stack up to 10 times, representing the cumulative layers of protection derived from his analytical countermeasures. Furthermore, should one of Dr. Light's meticulously crafted Light Bots be critically damaged, diverting its structural integrity into a temporary shield, Dr. Light enacts a critical override. Power from the incapacitated bot is rerouted into an energy barrier, granting a shield that absorbs damage equal to 25% of Dr. Light's maximum health. This protective shield remains active for a crucial 5 seconds, allowing him to reassess and adapt to the changed tactical landscape. However, this emergency rerouting can only be activated once every 15 seconds for each individual Light Bot destroyed, forcing a balance between aggressive deployment and calculated preservation to fully leverage this defensive potential. The culmination of his life's work is to overcome any obstacle, and this passive exemplifies his mastery.

As Princess Zelda, her commanding presence fortifies her pirate crew, bolstering their attack damage by 20 and magic attack by 40, inspiring courage and amplifying their offensive capabilities. 'Barrel Bomb' is enhanced during the transformation, now granting allies caught in the blast a 'Courage' buff for 5 seconds, increasing their movement speed by 15% and bolstering their defenses by 10, empowering them to stand strong in the face of adversity. 'Grappling Hook' undergoes a remarkable transformation; it now pulls allies towards Tetra, providing them with a burst of healing equivalent to 5% of their max health upon arrival, mending their wounds and restoring their resolve in the heat of battle. 'Flintlock Shot', empowered by the royal lineage, now fires a restorative shot, mending an ally’s wounds for 7% of their max health, ensuring they remain in the fight. Upon reverting to her pirate form after the 15 seconds elapse, Tetra experiences a period of 'Weariness' for 4 seconds, during which her attack and magic damage are reduced by 15%, highlighting the toll of wielding such potent magic. This transformative ability has a cooldown of 120 seconds, reflecting the magnitude of power it commands.

Each successful evasion grants her 1 stack of 'Momentum', a testament to her growing agility and combat readiness. Upon reaching the maximum of 15 'Momentum' stacks, further successful dodges no longer increase the stack count; instead, they trigger a surge of primal energy, flooding her with 50 'Might'. This 'Might' empowers her next basic attack within 5 seconds, causing it to erupt with fiery energy and inflict additional fire damage equal to 30% of her total attack damage. This strike doesn't just harm; it strategically weakens, applying a 'Weak Spot' debuff to the target. Each stack of 'Weak Spot' increases the critical damage the target receives from all sources by 10%, stacking up to a maximum of 3 times. Thus, at maximum stacks, the target becomes significantly more vulnerable, suffering 30% increased critical damage, a tempting opportunity for Ju Fu Fu and her allies to exploit. When combined with 'Tiger's Roar', Ju Fu Fu's focused battle stance, the invulnerability granted by 'Tiger's Grace' extends to 0.9 seconds. abilities.description: Stimpy's natural exuberance provides a constant, if somewhat delayed, source of encouragement to his allies. Every 16 seconds, Stimpy gains 1 'Happy Helper' stack, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. If Stimpy or an allied hero's health drops below 30%, Stimpy bursts with excitement, deploying a wave of unconditional support to both himself and the endangered ally. Each target receives a shield that absorbs damage, its strength initially equivalent to 12% of Stimpy’s maximum health. For each 'Happy Helper' stack consumed in this effort, the shield's potency increases by an additional 6% of Stimpy's maximum health. Once this burst of aid occurs, Stimpy, temporarily overwhelmed by the effort, cannot accumulate new 'Happy Helper' stacks for the next 24 seconds. During this cooldown, Stimpy must rely on his other skills and the support of his team to stay in the fight and protect those he cares about. This passive encourages Stimpy to position strategically near his allies, ready to leap to their defense with a shield generated by his unique brand of unconditional enthusiasm.

abilities.description: Naruto focuses his chakra, forming a concentrated, palm-sized sphere of potent life force. He then propels this sphere towards a single ally within a medium range, mending their wounds upon impact. This injection heals for an amount equal to 40% of Naruto's Attack stat, plus a base heal amount of 50. In addition to the immediate heal, the target also gains a 'Fortitude' buff for 3 seconds. While under the effects of 'Fortitude,' the target's damage reduction is increased by 10%. Furthermore, if the target is below 25% health when this injection lands, they gain an additional 'Guts' buff for 2 seconds. 'Guts' prevents the target from being reduced below 1 health, potentially saving them from a fatal blow. This ability's healing and buffing capacity makes Naruto a valuable asset in keeping his allies alive and thriving on the battlefield.

abilities.description: Naruto, drawing upon his vast chakra reserves, expends 2 Clone Reservoir stacks, momentarily focusing his energy before summoning a Shadow Clone directly in front of a targeted enemy. This clone, a perfect copy in every way, unleashes a relentless flurry of taijutsu, a frenzy of punches and kicks that batter the opponent. Each strike from the Shadow Clone deals a percentage of Naruto's Attack Damage, specifically 2%, augmented by an additional percentage scaled to the target's current health, inflicting 5% of the enemy's remaining hit points as physical damage with each blow. The Shadow Clone continues its assault for a duration of 5 seconds, or until it has successfully landed a total of 10 hits. Should the targeted enemy be suffering from any form of crowd control impairment, such as a stun, root, or slow, the Shadow Clone's attack speed is drastically increased, gaining a 50% boost to its offensive tempo. Further, each successful hit during this heightened state applies a stacking debuff to the target, reducing their physical defense by 5% per strike, stacking up to a maximum defensive reduction of 25%. And, as a testament to Naruto's training, should the Shadow Clone successfully land all 10 blows, Naruto's own chakra control is reinforced, refunding 1 Clone Reservoir stack to the user.

Enemies at the epicenter of the explosion are knocked down for 1.25 seconds, providing a brief window for follow-up attacks. The ability has a 16-second cooldown. This ability serves as both a ranged damage tool and a disruption option. The knockdown effect on central targets allows Usopp to control enemy positioning and create space for himself and allies. The extended range increases his engagement options and enhances his skirmishing capability by punishing enemies attempting to close the distance.

Instead of striking their intended recipient, they will lash out at the closest entity - be it ally or foe - within their immediate attack range. Should no valid target exist within range, the afflicted character will hesitate, standing motionless, consumed by indecision. Yoda, demonstrating his mastery over the Force, gains 2 stacks of Clarity each time he successfully confuses an enemy. This ability requires intense focus and foresight, necessitating a cooldown period of 12 seconds before it can be employed again, ensuring its calculated use in pivotal moments of the conflict.

abilities.description: Yoda channels the Force, erecting a protective barrier around himself. For 4 seconds, Yoda generates a Force Shield, capable of absorbing up to 400 damage, scaling with his magic attack stat. Specifically, the shield's capacity increases by 0.75 for every point of magic attack Yoda possesses. As damage is absorbed, Yoda cunningly converts the energy into a restorative wave. After the shield dissipates (either by reaching its damage capacity or after the 4-second duration), Yoda receives healing equal to 50% of the total damage absorbed by the Force Shield. This healing is applied gradually over 3 seconds. Furthermore, for every 100 damage absorbed, Yoda gains one stack of Clarity, empowering his subsequent Force abilities. This ability has a 15-second cooldown, demanding strategic deployment in the heat of battle.

At 5 stacks of Clarity, Yoda can expend all stacks to grant 'Insight' to all allies for 8 seconds. 'Insight' increases attack speed by 25% and ability haste by 15%. After expending Clarity, Yoda cannot gain Clarity stacks for 5 seconds. This is Yoda's signature passive.

abilities.description: Yoda transcends the physical realm, momentarily becoming one with the Force, a beacon of light and power for his allies. For a fleeting 1.5 seconds, Yoda enters a state of pure invulnerability, untouchable by any harm as he channels the cosmic energy. Upon achieving this momentary enlightenment, Yoda projects a vast, shimmering field of Force energy, extending outwards in a massive circle. Enemies caught within this circle of influence immediately feel their connection to the Force disrupted, becoming 'Stunted' for 3 seconds, silencing their abilities and dampening their offensive capabilities by reducing damage output by 15%. Simultaneously, allies bathed in the Force's glow experience a surge of empowerment, gaining 'Foresight' for 7 seconds, increasing their critical hit chance by 35% and movement speed by 20%. This profound connection to the Force requires time to replenish, resulting in a cooldown of 90 seconds before Yoda can guide his allies again.

abilities.description: Zoro assumes a battle-ready stance, focusing his Haki and preparing a swift counterattack for precisely 1.3 seconds. During this brief window, if Zoro is struck by an enemy attack, he instantly retaliates with a devastating single-target Iai slash. This perfectly timed strike deals physical damage equal to a base amount X, augmented by an additional amount equivalent to 22% of the attacking enemy's maximum health. The damage calculation prioritizes the enemy's total health pool, ensuring consistent threat regardless of their current status. Successfully countering an attack also empowers Zoro, instantly granting him 2 stacks of Haki Imbued. Each stack increases his critical damage by 10%, and stacks can be consumed by other abilities. However, failure to trigger the counterattack within the 1.3-second window results in a mitigated penalty: Zoro still gains 1 Haki Imbued stack, and 60% of the ability's cooldown is refunded. Precise timing and acute awareness of enemy attack patterns are paramount to maximizing the devastating potential of Ittoryu Iai: Shishi Sonson. abilities.description: Zoro's relentless three-sword style seeks to leave lasting scars on any opponent daring to face him. Each of Zoro's basic attacks carries a 15% chance to inflict 'Pierced,' a grievous wound that ignores all defenses and deals true damage to the target. This damage equates to 2% of the target's maximum health, dealt over a 3-second duration, showcasing the depth of Zoro's strikes. When Zoro channels his Haki, his resolve intensifies. With each stack of 'Haki Imbued,' the probability of inflicting 'Pierced' escalates by 2%, reaching a maximum of 25% at five stacks, ensuring that enemies constantly feel the bite of his swords. Furthermore, Zoro's iron will grants him 10% tenacity, shortening the duration of crowd control effects such as stuns or slows, allowing him to stay in the fray and continue his relentless assault. Zoro's mastery extends his reach, granting an additional 50 units of attack range, allowing him to strike from a safer distance while maintaining control of the battlefield. The effects of each 'Pierced' application are independent, their 3-second timers unaffected by subsequent attacks, ensuring that the wounds accumulate and the pressure mounts. This passive transforms Zoro into an assassin who punishes enemy mistakes, with unavoidable damage wearing down even the sturdiest foes.

abilities.description: Mitotic Regeneration epitomizes Sakura's unparalleled control over cellular mitosis, manifesting as a potent healing wave. Upon activation, Sakura channels chakra into accelerated cellular division, unleashing a surging tide of restorative energy. This wave emanates outwards in a cone-shaped area, primarily targeting allies, but also possesses a unique interaction with enemies. For allies, the wave instantly restores a significant portion of their health, scaling dynamically with Sakura's maximum HP and Healing Power stats. Furthermore, it applies a Regen buff, granting sustained healing over time, with the duration and potency also scaling with Sakura's stats. Crucially, the wave's interaction with enemies inflicts a temporary 'Cellular Instability' debuff; rather than directly damaging foes, it disrupts their natural healing processes, effectively reducing their healing received from all sources for a short duration. This disruption is particularly effective against enemies that rely on self-healing or regeneration, making it a valuable tactical tool. Moreover, 'Cellular Instability' has a chance to trigger a secondary effect, causing a minor burst of damage-over-time effect proportional to the initial healing reduction. This ability is core to Sakura's role as a supportive healer, enabling her to sustain her team while simultaneously hindering enemy sustain strategies.

abilities.description: Donald Duck, fueled by his trademark temper, winds up with his comically large mallet before unleashing a mighty swing! This attack targets the closest enemy within a medium range, dealing a base of 60 physical damage plus an additional 40% of Donald's attack power. The cooldown on this ability is a swift 4 seconds, allowing for frequent outbursts of rage. Each use of Seething Sailor Swing generates 5 points of Rage, which fuels other abilities, but be warned: as Donald's Rage builds, his accuracy with this attack falters. With Rage between 0 and 50, the attack has a 100% chance to hit. From 51 to 75 Rage, there's a 25% chance the attack will miss. And if Donald's Rage exceeds 75, the attack's damage is boosted by 25%, but it has a 50% chance to target a random enemy within range, potentially hitting an unintended target. This chaos embodies Donald's unpredictable nature when his anger peaks.

Enemies hit while Donald has 50 or more Rage have a 20% chance to be stunned for 1 second.

abilities.description: Donald steels his nerves, drawing upon the salty wisdom of a thousand voyages, manifesting a shimmering bubble of pure, unfettered annoyance! For 4 seconds, Donald gains a shield that absorbs incoming damage, protecting him from harm. The shield's strength scales with Donald's level, providing significant damage mitigation, allowing him to weather even the stormiest of encounters. While this irascible barrier is active, Donald's speed increases by 20%, allowing him to navigate the battlefield with surprising agility, deftly dodging attacks and positioning himself for maximum disruptive impact. However, the intensity of his focus causes a slight dip in his usual offensive capabilities, reducing his attack damage by 15%. The shield also grants Donald immunity to crowd control effects, ensuring that he can't be stunned, silenced, or otherwise hindered during this crucial period. Even if the shield is shattered prematurely by an overwhelming onslaught, the immunity to crowd control remains for the full 4 second duration, a testament to Donald's sheer stubbornness. Once the shield dissipates, whether broken or expired, the concentrated frustration builds to a boiling point, imbuing his next auto-attack with bonus damage equal to 50% of the damage the shield absorbed, punishing his foes for daring to challenge his seaworthy spirit. Finally, as the last vestiges of the shield fade, Donald gains 10% evasion for 2 seconds, allowing him to deftly avoid incoming attacks and maintain his position in the fray, a testament to his surprisingly nimble footwork. Activating this ability also generates 15 Rage, fueling his other abilities.

However, after the 'Driven' state ends, Donald becomes momentarily 'Flustered'. While 'Flustered' for 3 seconds, Donald's healing output is reduced by 20%, and he cannot gain Irritation.

abilities.name: Elemental Shift
abilities.description: Arceus constantly cycles through elemental Plates in a set order: Fire, Water, Grass, Electric. Each Plate grants different effects. When on Fire Plate, allies within a medium radius gain 10% increased attack damage. While on Water Plate, allies gain 10% increased magic defense. While on Grass Plate, allies within a medium radius are healed for 2% of their maximum HP every second. While on Electric Plate, enemies within a medium radius have their movement speed reduced by 15%. These effects last as long as Arceus maintains the corresponding Plate and linger for 1 second after switching. The cycle continues indefinitely, providing a dynamic ebb and flow of elemental buffs and debuffs.
abilities.flavorQuote: The essence of creation flows through me, adapting to the needs of all.

abilities.name: Judgment Bolt
abilities.description: Arceus unleashes a Judgment Bolt, the type of which corresponds to the current active Elemental Plate. Fire Judgment deals damage in a line and inflicts a burn, dealing 5% of the target's maximum HP as damage over 3 seconds. Water Judgment creates a small area of effect that slows enemies by 25% for 2 seconds. Grass Judgment heals allies in a small area for 10% of their maximum HP. Electric Judgment stuns the primary target for 0.75 seconds. The bolt travels a medium distance and has a moderate cooldown of 8 seconds. The specific effect is determined at the moment of casting based on the current active Elemental Plate.
abilities.flavorQuote: By my judgment, the elements shall bend to my will!

Fire Plate grants a shield that absorbs 150 damage. Water Plate grants a shield that absorbs 100 damage and regenerates 1% max hp per second. Grass Plate grants a shield that absorbs 100 damage and heals the target for 5% max hp upon breaking. Electric Plate grants a shield that absorbs 200 damage. The shield lasts for 4 seconds or until broken and has a cooldown of 12 seconds. The ally must be within a medium range to be targeted.
abilities.flavorQuote: A shield of cosmic energy protects you!

This passive encourages diverse team compositions, enhancing Arceus's survivability and resistance to crowd control. Should an ally be multi-typed, that only counts as one type for the purposes of this passive.
abilities.flavorQuote: I draw strength from the diversity of creation.

abilities.name: Telekinetic Barrier
abilities.description: Eleven focuses her psychic energy to create a protective barrier at a target location within a medium range. This barrier absorbs incoming damage, shielding allies within its radius. The barrier's strength scales with Eleven's magic attack. The barrier lasts for a duration of 5 seconds, after which it collapses, releasing a pulse that briefly slows enemies caught within its radius by 30% for 2 seconds. Casting this ability generates 15 Psychic Resonance. The barrier has a health pool equal to 200 + (50% of Eleven's Magic Attack). This wave violently repels any enemies caught within its path, shoving them backwards with significant force. The distance enemies are pushed is directly proportional to Eleven's Magic Attack stat, ensuring a greater displacement potential as she grows in power. Any enemy struck by this telekinetic shockwave also suffers 80 magic damage, augmented by 40% of Eleven's Magic Attack. Enemies unlucky enough to be propelled into a solid obstacle, such as a wall, tree, or other immovable object, endure further agony in the form of True Damage equal to 20% of their maximum health, reflecting the raw psychic force of the impact. This surge of power also generates 20 Psychic Resonance within Eleven, fueling her more potent abilities. Telekinetic Repulsion possesses a medium range and has a cooldown of 8 seconds, requiring strategic deployment.

abilities.name: Sensory Deprivation
abilities.description: Eleven taps into the Void, creating a zone of sensory deprivation at a target location. Enemies within the zone have their vision drastically reduced and their attack speed slowed by 25% for 4 seconds. The zone persists for 6 seconds. Casting Sensory Deprivation generates 10 Psychic Resonance. The range of the zone is medium. While within the zone, enemies also have a 15% chance to miss their attacks entirely. The radius of the Sensory Deprivation zone is significant, affecting multiple enemies simultaneously. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. Sensory Deprivation can be strategically placed to disrupt enemy formations, providing cover for allies or setting up ambushes.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I can't see..."

abilities.name: Psychic Resonance

Overloaded Sensory Deprivation silences enemies within the zone for 2 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I feel... stronger."

abilities.name: Upside Down Collapse

This ability generates 30 Psychic Resonance upon cast, regardless of whether it hits enemies. The ultimate has a long range, allowing Eleven to influence engagements from a safe distance. The initial pull effect is gradual but becomes stronger over time, making it difficult for enemies to escape before the final collapse. This ability deals 250 + (80% of Eleven's Magic Attack) magic damage and has a cooldown of 90 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: "It's coming..."

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Battlefield Manipulation with Burst Potential

abilities.description: With a weary sigh, Jane produces a crushed pack, extracting a cigarette with trembling fingers. She lights it, inhales deeply, and then deliberately exhales a stream of harsh smoke towards a chosen adversary. This cynical exhale deals physical damage equal to 30% of Jane's Attack, augmented by a base damage of 10. The resulting cloud inflicts the 'Hack' debuff for 1.5 seconds. While afflicted by 'Hack,' the target suffers a 15% reduction in their attack speed, struggling to draw breath. Each subsequent 'Cheap Cigarettes' attack landing on the same target extends the 'Hack' duration by 0.25 seconds, up to a maximum of 2.5 seconds. Furthermore, should the target already be affected by the 'Dopesick' debuff—a state of debilitating withdrawal—'Cheap Cigarettes' inflicts additional physical damage equal to 10% of the target's maximum health, bypassing armor. This bonus damage is limited to once every 5 seconds per target, reflecting the lingering effects of the interaction.

After using Relapse, Jane gains 3 stacks of Withdrawal, representing the immediate return of her addiction’s influence. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: I backslid, okay? Like, what? What, you think I'm proud of this?

However, each stack of Withdrawal also increases the damage she takes from all sources by 3%, reflecting her growing vulnerability. abilities.flavorQuote: It was me. I killed her, man. I killed her.

abilities.description: With a weary sigh, Jane lights up another cigarette, the smoke curling around her and taking on an almost tangible form, a reflection of the fragile protection she offers her allies. Upon activation, Jane forcefully exhales a massive plume of smoke, instantly enveloping herself and all allied heroes within a 600-unit radius in a protective haze. This smoke grants the 'Fortified' buff for 4 seconds. Fortified provides an immediate shield, absorbing incoming damage equal to 25% of Jane's maximum health (increased from 20%), offering crucial shielding when it matters most. Moreover, allies under the Fortified effect receive a 30% reduction in damage taken from all sources for the duration, helping teammates withstand the most ferocious assaults. As the smoke disperses and the Fortified buff expires, all enemy heroes within a 400-unit radius are afflicted with the 'Smoked Out' debuff for a duration of 1.75 seconds (increased from 1.5 seconds). Smoked Out reduces their attack damage by 35% and their movement speed by 25%, crippling their ability to effectively engage in combat, as they cough and choke. Chain Smoker's Shield has a cooldown of 75 seconds.

abilities.description: Benson fixes his piercing gaze upon a single, hapless enemy, channeling the sheer force of his managerial disapproval into a concentrated blast of magical energy. This withering stare deals X magic damage directly to the target, embodying the crushing weight of unmet expectations. Furthermore, the targeted enemy is immediately afflicted with 'Subpar Performance', causing them to deal 15% less damage for a duration of 3 seconds, reflecting Benson's keen eye for identifying inefficiencies. The psychic backlash of this intense reprimand generates 10 Stress within Benson, representing the burden of his responsibilities. Should Benson's internal Stress Gauge exceed 50% prior to using this ability, the 'Subpar Performance' effect intensifies, increasing the damage reduction to 25% for the same 3 second duration. However, if Benson's accumulated Stress reaches a critical 100% threshold upon activation, he suffers a catastrophic Managerial Meltdown. Benson is Stunned for 1 second, symbolizing his temporary incapacitation, and his Stress is completely reset to 0, representing the cathartic release of his pent-up frustrations.

abilities.name: Overtime!
abilities.description: Benson forces an ally into 'Overtime', granting them 20% increased attack speed and movement speed for 4 seconds. This ability also grants the ally a shield equal to 10% of Benson's Max HP that lasts for 4 seconds. This ability generates 15 Stress. If Benson's Stress Gauge is above 50%, the attack and movement speed bonus is increased to 30%. If Benson’s Stress Gauge reaches 100% after using this ability, instead of buffing the ally, Benson consumes all stress and shields himself for 25% of his max HP.
abilities.flavorQuote: "You two! Work harder, or you're fired!"

abilities.name: Managerial Outburst
upgrades: Reduce stress penalty upon reaching 100 stress.
abilities.description: Benson, overcome by the sheer incompetence surrounding him, unleashes a torrent of pent-up frustration. He surges forward a short distance, propelled by pure, unadulterated managerial stress. During this short dash, lasting 2 seconds, Benson's built-in gumball dispensers go into overdrive, firing a cone of sticky projectiles at all enemies in front of him. Each gumball inflicts X physical damage upon impact, with a maximum of 10 gumballs able to strike a single target during the fit. The sheer act of expelling this much sugary ammunition generates 20 Stress within Benson, bringing him closer to his boiling point. Should Benson's Stress Gauge already be above 50% prior to unleashing this tirade, the force behind the gumballs becomes amplified, causing enemies struck to be knocked back a short distance, effectively disrupting their formations and potentially interrupting any abilities they were attempting to use. If Benson's Stress Gauge reaches 100% as a direct result of the Managerial Outburst, he enters a state of blind, furious resilience. For the duration of the 2-second gumball barrage, Benson becomes temporarily immune to all forms of damage, shrugging off attacks that would normally halt his advance. However, this enraged state also significantly impairs his movement speed, reducing it by 50%, rendering him a relatively stationary target amidst the chaos.

upgrades: [object Object]

abilities.description: Benson, ever the diligent manager, is prone to overwork and subsequent stress. Each time an ally unleashes an ability within a generous radius of Benson, his Stress Meter inflates by 5 units, reflecting his concern for operational efficiency. Furthermore, as his own health dwindles, the pressure mounts; for every 5% of Benson's maximum health he loses, the Stress Meter climbs another 10 units. When the pressure becomes unbearable and the Stress Meter maxes out at 100, Benson experiences a momentary but debilitating 'Meltdown'. During this 2-second meltdown phase, Benson is rendered stunned, his focus shattered, leaving him vulnerable to enemy attacks. Upon the meltdown's abrupt conclusion, the Stress Meter is immediately purged back to 0, giving Benson a chance to recover his composure. As a further measure of self-preservation, while Benson teeters below 30% of his maximum health, his inherent desire to stay on top of things compels him to absorb healing effects more efficiently, increasing the potency of all incoming healing by a significant 20%, helping him push through the deadline and maintain his composure.

abilities.description: Don-chan channels his boundless Taiko spirit into a life-saving rhythm for his allies. When activated, a series of four commands appears, each demanding either a resounding 'Don!' or a sharp 'Ka!' to match the beat. Successfully executing this musical sequence sends a surge of restorative energy to the targeted ally, mending their wounds and returning vigor, instantly healing them for a robust 15% of their maximum health pool. As the rhythmic healing takes effect, a protective aura forms around the recipient, a shimmering shield that absorbs incoming damage equal to 10% of Don-chan's own potent magic attack, safeguarding them from harm for a crucial 3 seconds. This protective shield is invaluable in weathering incoming attacks, offering a buffer against the enemy's onslaught. However, should the player falter, inputting one or more incorrect beats during the sequence, the restorative power weakens. The heal diminishes to a still-helpful 7.5% of the target's maximum health, and the shield's strength decreases to only 5% of Don-chan's magic attack. Moreover, its duration is halved, lasting for only 1.5 seconds, a fleeting defense against immediate danger. Drumming Benediction demands concentration and rhythmic precision, as it comes with a cooldown of 8 seconds, demanding careful management and well-timed execution for maximum impact on the battlefield.

Each successful input reduces the attack speed and movement speed of enemies within the affected area by a palpable 8% for a duration of 4 seconds; these effects stack additively, intensifying the rhythmic oppression with each perfectly timed strike. However, any incorrect input shatters the rhythmic flow, instantly resetting the debuff duration and demanding unwavering precision to maintain the cacophony of disruption. abilities.description: Jason channels the dark energy of Crystal Lake, becoming 'Empowered' for 8 seconds. While empowered, Jason gains 20% increased attack damage and his basic attacks cleave, dealing 40% of their damage to nearby enemies. Furthermore, each successful basic attack grants him 2 stacks of 'Camp Dread'. At the end of the empowered duration, Jason unleashes a devastating scream, fearing all nearby enemies for 2 seconds. If Jason reaches maximum Camp Dread stacks during this ultimate, the scream also deals X magic damage. The duration between his basic attacks are also dramatically reduced. This ability transforms Jason into a terrifying force, overwhelming enemies with increased damage and area-of-effect attacks.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Ki-ki-ki ma-ma-ma..."
