abilities.name: Burning Stance
upgrades: (Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
abilities.description: Trunks channels his energy, adopting a defensive stance for 4 seconds. During this stance, Trunks gains 30% damage reduction and any enemy who attacks Trunks while he is in this stance receives a stack of 'Burning Vengeance'. Burning Vengeance reduces the target's outgoing damage by 3% per stack, lasting for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times. If a target with 5 stacks of Burning Vengeance attacks Trunks, they are instead taunted for 1.5 seconds, forcing them to attack only Trunks. This ability has a moderate cooldown. Furthermore, for each 1% of Trunks' maximum health he is missing, the duration of the taunt effect is increased by 0.01 seconds, enabling Trunks to better manage threats as he sustains damage. The damage reduction is also increased by 1% for every 100 armor Trunks possesses, enhancing his durability as a tank.

abilities.name: Shining Sword Slash
abilities.description: Trunks channels his energy into his sword and performs a precise, swift slash. This attack deals X physical damage to a single target. If Temporal Surge is active, Trunks performs an additional follow-up slash, dealing 50% of the initial damage and applying a 'Bleed' effect, causing the target to take X true damage over 3 seconds. This attack's damage is increased based on Trunks' attack stat. The base damage of this attack scales with Trunks' attack and critical hit chance. The 'Bleed' effect does not stack, but its duration is refreshed if applied again. This ability has a short cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Witness the power of my sword!

abilities.name: Temporal Shift
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Trunks briefly disrupts the flow of time around him, granting himself a burst of speed and evasion. Upon activation, Trunks gains X% increased speed and X% increased evasion for 4 seconds. Additionally, if Trunks is affected by any debuffs, their duration is reduced by 1 second (minimum 0.5 second duration). This ability has a long cooldown. This ability is crucial for repositioning Trunks or mitigating incoming damage, adding a strategic layer to his gameplay. The percentage increase for both speed and evasion are affected by his luck stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time is on my side!

abilities.name: Saiyan Lineage (Signature Passive)
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~9% and slightly longer ramp-up.
abilities.description: Trunks' Saiyan heritage grants him increased resilience and power. Trunks gains X% increased maximum HP and X% increased attack damage. Whenever Trunks uses 'Shining Sword Slash' while Temporal Surge is active, the duration of Temporal Surge is extended by 1 second, up to a maximum of 6 seconds total duration. This passive ability ensures that Trunks maintains a sustained combat presence, rewarding him for aggressive play. The HP and attack damage percentage increases depend on Trunks' level.
abilities.flavorQuote: A Saiyan's strength knows no bounds!

abilities.name: Burning Attack Unleashed
upgrades: [object Object]
[object Object]
[object Object]
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Trunks focuses his Saiyan power, drawing on his experience in the Hyperbolic Time Chamber to unleash a devastating assault. Upon activation, Trunks envelops himself in a vibrant aura, granting the 'Burning Attack Unleashed' status for 8 seconds. While under the effect of 'Burning Attack Unleashed', each of Trunks' sword attacks cleaves through enemies, inflicting additional true damage equal to 20% of his attack damage plus an additional flat amount based on his current level. Moreover, each successful strike carries a 30% chance to stun the target for a brief 0.75 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to further attacks. The immense power surge also generates a protective shield around Trunks, absorbing incoming damage equal to 150% of his attack damage throughout the duration of 'Burning Attack Unleashed'. This shield decays rapidly after 5 seconds. Once the 'Burning Attack Unleashed' status expires, Trunks channels the residual energy into his sword, increasing his attack damage by 15% for the subsequent 5 seconds, allowing for a final surge of offensive capability. This ability requires a considerable amount of Ki to activate and has a long cooldown to reflect the intensity of the transformation.

abilities.description: Android 18 hurls a Destructo-Disc that leaves behind a lingering Energy Field at its impact location. This field persists for 8 seconds or until destroyed. Enemies within the field's radius take 30 (+30% Magic ATK) energy damage per second and are slowed by 15%. If Android 18 casts another ability while an Energy Field is active, the field is immediately destroyed, unleashing a pulse dealing 80 (+60% Magic ATK) energy damage to all enemies within its radius. Multiple fields cannot be active simultaneously. The Destructo-Disc itself travels at high speed but has a slightly telegraphed animation, requiring precise aiming.
abilities.flavorQuote: Try dodging this one, tough guy.

abilities.name: Energy Barrier Burst

abilities.description: Android 18 projects an Energy Barrier onto a targeted ally, granting them a shield that absorbs up to 150 (+40% Magic ATK) damage for 4 seconds. If the shielded ally is within the radius of an active Energy Field, the shield's duration is extended to 6 seconds, and upon breaking or expiring, the shield explodes, dealing 50 (+25% Magic ATK) damage to nearby enemies and granting the shielded ally a 15% attack damage buff for 3 seconds. This attack damage buff stacks multiplicatively with other buffs. Timing the Barrier Burst with her Energy Field Matrix is crucial for maximum effectiveness.
abilities.flavorQuote: Here's a little something to keep you in the fight.

abilities.name: Android Agility
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: Android 18 dashes a short distance in a target direction. If she dashes through an active Energy Field, she gains 20% increased movement speed and a 10% attack damage buff for 5 seconds. Additionally, her next basic attack within 3 seconds deals an additional 40 (+30% ATK) true damage. This ability allows Android 18 to reposition quickly and capitalize on her zone control, rewarding strategic field placement. Dashing through an Energy Field does not destroy it.
abilities.flavorQuote: Too slow!

abilities.name: Cybernetic Stability
upgrades: (Analysis Update) Defense adaptation is improved — damage reduction increases to 20%.
(Systems Optimization) Stability increased: Health regen increases to 3% per second.
abilities.description: Android 18's modified physiology allows her to maintain consistent combat readiness. Thanks to the fusion of organic and synthetic systems, she steadily regenerates 2.5% of her maximum health per second and 3.5% of her maximum energy per second. Furthermore, Android 18's internal defense systems react to threats against her technology; if an enemy inflicts crowd control on her, stunning or otherwise immobilizing her, her systems adapt to counter the interference. Upon the expiration of such a crowd control effect, she gains a 15% damage reduction buff for 3 seconds. This damage reduction applies to all incoming damage types, mitigating enemy attacks and allowing her to absorb additional punishment in her role as a resilient and self-sufficient combatant. The damage reduction stacks multiplicatively with other forms of resistance.

abilities.name: Infinite Bullet Barrage (Ultimate)

(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~18%).

abilities.description: Android 18 unleashes a relentless barrage of energy blasts in a cone-shaped area in front of her for 3 seconds. Each blast deals 20 (+15% ATK) energy damage. If an Energy Field is active, the barrage is amplified, with each blast now dealing 30 (+20% ATK) energy damage and inflicting a stacking slow of 3% per hit, up to a maximum of 30%. This ultimate ability is a powerful tool for locking down enemies within her zones, synergizing perfectly with her Energy Field Matrix. The cone widens slightly over the duration of the barrage, increasing its area of effect.
abilities.flavorQuote: Say your prayers!

character_v1.playstyle: Strategic Area Denial and Punishing Aggression

abilities.name: Death Beam Barrage
upgrades: Buff: Increase Ability range by 25%.
Buff: Further empower each Death Beam to inflict 2% of the target's maximum health as true damage.
Role Realignment: emphasizes damage-style interactions.
(Patch) Role realignment: significantly increases the duration of Tyranny.
abilities.description: With a contemptuous sneer, Frieza unleashes a relentless storm of focused Death Beams from his fingertips, each a pinpoint of concentrated malice. Over 1.5 seconds, he fires a rapid succession of these energy lances in a narrow cone directly ahead. Each beam pierces through enemies, inflicting magic damage. The initial target struck suffers full damage, while subsequent enemies caught in the beam's path receive 30% reduced damage. Enemies struck by this barrage are seared with 'Frostbite', reducing their armor by 7% per stack, up to a maximum of 21% armor reduction. This chilling debuff persists for 3 seconds, leaving them vulnerable to further assaults. For each stack of 'Frostbite' applied, Frieza gains 2 stacks of 'Tyranny,' amplifying his cruel power. Frieza will prioritize enemies who have already been inflicted with any form of debuff. When Frieza is in his Golden Form, the Death Beams become empowered, inflicting additional true damage equal to 1% of the target's maximum health with each strike, bypassing all resistances and defenses. Furthermore, the duration of 'Frostbite' is extended by 1 second when Frieza is in Golden Form, amplifying the enemy's vulnerability under his golden gaze.

abilities.name: Death Comet Barrage
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the number of Death Comets launched, enhancing damage output and Ki Suppression application rate.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect: 'Lingering Radiation.' Enemies affected by Ki Disruption also suffer a brief reduction in movement speed.

Lv100: Improves scaling, increases the maximum Ki Suppression stack cap, and adds a team-support interaction: Allies near the target gain a small increase in Ki regeneration while the target is under the effects of Ki Suppression.
abilities.description: Unleash a devastating volley of miniature, super-compressed energy spheres, each a shimmering testament to Frieza's refined cruelty and mastery over Ki manipulation. Instead of a singular strike, Frieza rapidly generates and launches a multitude of these 'Death Comets' at a single target with unnerving precision. These projectiles, rather than impacting simultaneously, strike in rapid succession over a brief period of roughly one and a half seconds, creating a localized zone of chaotic energy bombardment. Each comet deals a moderate amount of physical damage, scaling primarily with Frieza's ATK stat and benefitting from critical hit chance and damage modifiers. However, the true strength of Death Comet Barrage lies in its persistent debuff application. Each successful hit from a Death Comet applies a stack of 'Ki Suppression' to the target. Each stack reduces the target's Ki regeneration rate by a small percentage (stacking multiplicatively to a maximum cap). Upon reaching a certain number of Ki Suppression stacks, the target suffers a brief period of 'Ki Disruption,' significantly increasing the cooldown of their next ability cast. Therefore, Death Comet Barrage is not merely a damage tool, but a tactical instrument designed to disrupt enemy combos, limit their offensive capabilities, and starve them of resources within Frieza's controlled zone, leaving them vulnerable to follow-up attacks and further exploitation. It's a display of overwhelming force disguised as a seemingly simple barrage, epitomizing Frieza's approach to combat: calculated, relentless, and utterly demoralizing. This ability reflects the visual of a golden aura surrounding the hand as small purple orbs are created and fired. After a moment, the ability goes on a moderate cooldown.
abilities.flavorQuote: Such a dazzling display of destruction, isn't it? Pity you're on the receiving end.

abilities.name: Death Ball
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Buff: Ability scaling improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Patch) Role realignment: This ability now emphasizes tank-style interactions.
abilities.description: Frieza focuses his ki, forming a swirling sphere of destructive energy for a tense 1.75 seconds, during which he remains vulnerable to interruption. Upon unleashing this 'Death Ball', a cataclysmic burst of magic damage erupts across a targeted area, obliterating all within its radius. For every two stacks of 'Oppression' Frieza has cultivated through tyrannical dominance, the Death Ball's potency surges by an additional 1%, scaling its devastation with his accumulated malice. Enemies unfortunate enough to be caught at the epicenter of the blast suffer an amplified 25% damage increase, as the concentrated energies tear through their defenses. Moreover, the force of the explosion sends these central targets flying backward a considerable distance, disrupting their formations and leaving them exposed. As a testament to its power, this ability is governed by a lengthy cooldown, demanding strategic deployment. However, should Frieza tap into his ultimate evolution, assuming his Golden Form, the Death Ball transcends its limitations. The casting time vanishes, becoming instantaneous, and the attack transcends conventional magic, dealing true damage equivalent to 10% of each target's current health, ensuring no foe escapes its wrath, in addition to the base magic damage.

abilities.name: My Golden Form!
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Nerf: reduced peak potency ~17% and slightly longer ramp-up.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~41%).
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
abilities.description: When the measure of Frieza's dominance, represented by 100 stacks of Oppression, is full, he can unleash his ultimate evolution, declaring to the lesser beings that he will show them his 'Golden Form!' For 10 glorious seconds, Frieza transcends his previous limitations. Initially, the transformation grants Frieza a brief invulnerability, a shimmering golden aura protecting him from all harm for 1.5 seconds, a testament to his absolute power. In this radiant state, Frieza's attacks strike with increased ferocity, his attack damage soaring by 25%, demonstrating the true extent of his evolved strength. Moreover, during the Golden Form, each of Frieza's abilities are augmented with additional, devastating effects. However, such power comes at a price. As the Golden Form fades, Frieza's body is wracked with 'Exhaustion', his speed and attack damage reduced by 15% for 5 seconds, a humbling reminder of his mortal coil. This ability has a very long cooldown.

abilities.name: Oppressive Rule
upgrades: (Balance Patch) Oppressive Rule's reach diminished: Peak potency reduced by approximately 12%, with a slightly extended ramp-up time to achieve maximum effect.
(Balance Patch) Buff: ability scale improved — gains extra potency at late levels.
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~27%).
(Bugfix) Resolved inconsistent trigger interactions reported in live matches (occurrence ~33%).
(Patch) Role realignment: this ability now emphasizes bruiser-style interactions.
abilities.description: Frieza's mere presence radiates an aura of Oppressive Rule, a testament to his absolute authority that bends the will of those who dare oppose him. Whenever Frieza afflicts an enemy champion with a debuff, be it the slightest slow, a petrifying stun, or any other form of impairment that dares to challenge his supremacy, he accumulates 6 stacks of 'Rule', symbolizing his ever-tightening grasp on the battlefield and the subjugation of his foes. Further showcasing his unparalleled might, Frieza's basic attacks possess a 30% chance to inflict 'Subjugation' upon his target. 'Subjugation' weakens the target, reducing their outgoing damage by a substantial 12% for a duration of 2.5 seconds, a period during which they are forced to endure the crushing weight of Frieza's power and reflect upon their insolence. This 'Subjugation' effect does not stack, ensuring that enemies are not completely annihilated, but rather serve as a constant reminder of Frieza's dominion. Each critical strike Frieza lands unleashes a surge of power, granting him 3 additional stacks of 'Rule', reflecting his ability to exploit weakness and amplify his control. To solidify his unwavering reign, Frieza gains increased tenacity based on his stacks of 'Rule'. For every 6 stacks he accumulates, his tenacity is increased by 1.25%, with a maximum possible increase of 12.5% tenacity, representing his indomitable will and the futility of resistance against his tyrannical reign.

character_v1.playstyle: Punishing aggressors and controlling space through debuffs and calculated bursts of power with Golden Frieza transformation.

character_v1.name: Tao

abilities.name: Swords Out: Piercing Barrage
upgrades: Level 25: Increases the number of summoned swords to 4.
Level 75: Swords Out consumes 15% of current ammo. Summoned swords now inflict a stacking bleed effect dealing 2% of the target's max HP as true damage over 3 seconds.
Level 125: The cooldown reduction per Blade Heart stack is increased to 0.15 seconds. When Swords Out is activated, Tao gains 10% evasion for 3 seconds.
Level 175: Swords Out consumes 20% of current ammo, summoning 5 swords. If the target is marked by Fatal Bloom, the swords deal 20% bonus damage.

Level 200: Swords Out now consumes all current ammo to summon swords, capped at 8 swords. If the swords generate a shield, the shield duration is increased to 5 seconds, and any damage absorbed is converted into Blade Heart stacks, up to a maximum of 10 stacks.
abilities.description: Tao summons a barrage of spectral flying swords that autonomously strike nearby enemies. Upon activation, Tao consumes 10% of her current ammo, summoning 3 swords that each deal X physical damage to the nearest enemy within 10 meters, prioritizing enemies marked by Fatal Bloom. Each sword homes in on its target, dealing damage three times in rapid succession. The damage scales with her attack stat and is further increased by 3% per stack of Blade Heart, up to a maximum of 50 stacks. Swords Out has a cooldown of 10 seconds, which is reduced by 0.05 seconds for each Blade Heart stack consumed upon activation. If no enemies are within range, the swords orbit Tao, providing a shield equal to 7% of her max HP, decaying over 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Fatal Bloom: Lingering Wound
upgrades: Level 30: Increases the base magic damage by 25%.
Level 80: Fatal Bloom now also reduces the target's healing received by 10% per stack of Lingering Wound.
Level 130: The cooldown reduction per Blade Heart stack is increased to 0.3 seconds. Fatal Bloom's mark now lasts 7 seconds.
Level 180: When a target reaches 5 stacks of Lingering Wound, Tao gains a stack of Blade Heart.
Level 200: Fully stacked Lingering Wound now also applies a 2 second Silence to the target.
abilities.description: Tao throws a spectral bloom that marks a single target within 15 meters, inflicting a stacking debuff. The initial mark deals X magic damage and applies 'Lingering Wound', causing the target to take 2% increased damage from all sources for 5 seconds. This debuff can stack up to 5 times, increasing the damage taken to 10%. The mark also amplifies the effectiveness of Swords Out, causing the swords to prioritize the marked target. If the target is already marked, the duration is refreshed and an additional stack is added if possible. Fatal Bloom has a cooldown of 8 seconds, which is reduced by 0.1 seconds for each Blade Heart stack. Activating Fatal Bloom consumes 3 Blade Heart stacks, granting Tao 5% increased movement speed for 2 seconds upon successful application of the mark.

abilities.name: Blade Heart Resonance: Measured Response
upgrades: Level 40: Blade Heart stacks now also grant 0.5% increased movement speed, up to a maximum of 25%.
Level 90: Reduces the required ammo consumption to gain a stack of Blade Heart to 4%.
Level 140: Blade Heart Resonance now also grants Tao a 20% critical hit chance for 5 seconds.
Level 190: The maximum Blade Heart stacks are increased to 75, increasing the maximum bonus attack and magic attack to 75%.
Level 200: Blade Heart Resonance now provides immunity to crowd control effects for the duration of its effect.
abilities.description: Tao gains a stack of Blade Heart for every 5% of her magazine capacity consumed by her weapon attacks. Each stack of Blade Heart grants 0.75% increased attack and magic attack, up to a maximum of 50 stacks. When Tao reaches the maximum number of stacks, she gains 'Blade Heart Resonance', causing her next Swords Out to consume all Blade Heart stacks and deal an additional 0.5% true damage per stack consumed, as well as granting 0.5% damage reduction per stack consumed for 2 seconds. Additionally, each Blade Heart stack grants Tao 1% increased shield regeneration rate, up to a maximum of 50%. This passive encourages an aggressive playstyle, rewarding high ammo consumption with increased damage and survivability, allowing Tao to maintain consistent pressure on her enemies.

abilities.name: Blade Heart Tempest: Focused Barrage
upgrades: Level 125: Extends the duration of Blade Heart Tempest to 12 seconds.
Level 150: The damage dealt at the end of Blade Heart Tempest is increased by 30%.
Level 175: During Blade Heart Tempest, Tao gains 20% increased attack and magic attack.
Level 200: Upon activation, Blade Heart Tempest cleanses all debuffs from Tao and grants her immunity to new debuffs for the duration.
abilities.description: Tao focuses her energy, unleashing a concentrated barrage for 8 seconds. During this time, the cost of Swords Out is reduced to 7% current ammo, and the cooldown is reduced by 30%. Additionally, Fatal Bloom’s damage amplification is increased to 3% per stack of Lingering Wound. Activating Blade Heart Tempest consumes all current Blade Heart stacks, granting Tao a shield equal to 0.75% of her maximum HP per stack consumed, lasting for the duration of the ultimate. At the end of the ultimate, Tao releases a final surge of energy, dealing X magic damage to all enemies within 15 meters, scaling with the number of Blade Heart stacks consumed during the ultimate's activation. This ultimate provides Tao with increased sustain and damage, enhancing her role as a resilient assassin capable of trading blows effectively, but at a reduced rate.

character_v1.playstyle: Tao is designed as a high-risk, high-reward assassin that uses ammo consumption to power up her abilities and deliver devastating burst damage. Her kit revolves around stacking Blade Heart through aggressive play, then capitalizing on those stacks to enhance her Swords Out and Fatal Bloom skills. This requires precise timing and resource management to maximize her effectiveness in combat.

character_v1.playstyle: Crown Prince is designed as a utility-focused character who excels at enabling elemental damage for his team. While he can deal damage himself, his primary function is to apply Decay and other elemental statuses, amplifying the damage output of allies who can capitalize on these effects.

abilities.description: Richard, with a barely perceptible shift in his stoic expression, designates a target area for a concentrated bombardment of LEGO studs. These hard plastic projectiles descend upon the marked zone, dealing a total of 80 magic damage, enhanced by 60% of Richard's magic attack power, to any unfortunate enemies caught within the circular zone over a duration of 3 seconds. The area targeted is intelligently selected, prioritizing locations where enemy presence is most dense, ensuring maximum impact. The damage unfolds in a series of rapid ticks, granting enemies fleeting moments to evade the full brunt of the stud storm. Should Richard possess a Royal Decree exceeding 50, the studs are imbued with a binding adhesive, inflicting 'Bricked' upon impact, hindering enemy movement by reducing their speed by 25% for 2 seconds, simulating the frustrating experience of stepping on a LEGO brick. Furthermore, each activation of Stud Barrage replenishes Richard's strategic reserves, granting him 10 Royal Decree. This ability operates on a 10-second cooldown, allowing for calculated deployment in the heat of battle.

upgrades: Level 30: Shield potency increased to 20% of Richard's max HP.

abilities.description: Richard, with a world-weary sigh, proclaims a dryly worded Royal Decree, bolstering the ally currently struggling the most. He bestows upon this ally a protective shield, absorbing damage equal to 15% of Richard's maximum health for a duration of 4 seconds. This decree echoes with the authority of Unikingdom, provided Richard's Royal Decree is high enough; if Richard currently possesses more than 50 Royal Decree, the shielded ally also benefits from a 15% increase in their attack power for the shield's duration. This ability operates on a 12-second cooldown. The shield's effectiveness diminishes gradually, decaying by 25% of its original value each second. Only one Royal Decree shield can be active on an ally at any given time; should a new shield be applied, it overwrites the previous one. The sheer monotony of Richard's decree is strangely distracting, causing enemies to momentarily falter, granting all allies a 5% evasion buff for 2 seconds following the shield's application. Furthermore, the act of proclaiming the decree grants Richard 15 Royal Decree.

abilities.description: Richard's dedication to procedure emanates as a tangible field of order. Allies within a 500-unit radius are fortified by his steadfast presence, gaining 10 bonus Def plus an additional amount equal to 5% of Richard's own Def. This resilient aura is further amplified by Richard's accumulated Royal Decrees; for every 20 Royal Decrees he possesses, the aura's Def enhancement is augmented by an additional 2%. This protective field persists as long as Richard remains an active presence on the battlefield, ensuring a steady stream of defense. Every second, a precise audit is conducted, recalculating and reapplying the defensive bonus to all affected allies, adapting in real-time to any changes in Richard's Royal Decrees or defensive stats. This effect is particularly valuable in extended conflicts, offering unwavering resistance against encroaching threats and granting a strategic edge in prolonged engagements.

abilities.description: Richard channels his accumulated Royal Decree to create a 'Time-Out Corner' at a target location, lasting 5 seconds. Allies within the area gain 'Orderly Focus', increasing their atk speed by 25% and reducing their cooldowns by 10%. The area of effect is a large square. This ability has a 90-second cooldown. Richard consumes all Royal Decree upon casting this ability. Enemies and allies entering or exiting the area are immediately affected by the respective status effects. Richard's role as a protector of his allies is emphasized by his increased tenacity and evasion, making him difficult to control and providing him with a means to accumulate Royal Decree in response to enemy actions. character_v1.playstyle: Richard excels at providing utility and control by buffing allies with 'Rules' and hindering enemies with 'Chores'. abilities.description: Frantic Flourish is a spectacle of accidental tanking. Upon activation, Tom initiates a series of exaggerated, seemingly panicked movements—a chaotic dance designed to both protect allies and disrupt enemies. During the Flourish, Tom's evasion stat receives a significant boost, allowing him to dodge incoming attacks with surprising (and wholly unintentional) grace. More than that, the sheer unpredictability of Tom's Flourish applies the 'Distracted' debuff, reducing the target's damage output and focus. Visually, expect flailing limbs, cartoonish dust clouds, and perhaps even a misplaced piano key or two. The duration of the evasion buff and the effectiveness of the distraction status is calculated through scaling factors tied to Tom's DEF and HP, improving its overall utility as the character grows.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm not panicking, you're panicking!

This tenacity bonus is calculated before other tenacity modifiers. When Tom reaches max stacks of frenzy, he lets out a howl, taunting nearby enemies for 1 second.

abilities.description: Tom spends 2 seconds building a complex Rube Goldberg machine. During this time, he's immune to crowd control but takes 25% increased damage. Once completed, the machine triggers a chain reaction of cartoonish events over 8 seconds. For the first 3 seconds, random projectiles (hammers, anvils, pies) rain down in a large area (500 units), dealing 50 + (0.1 * X) magic damage per hit (max 5 hits per enemy). Then, a giant magnet activates for 2 seconds, pulling enemies towards the center. Finally, a massive explosion occurs, dealing 300 + (0.6 * X) magic damage in the center and knocking enemies upwards. If Tom has max stacks of 'Cartoon Physics' when activating this ability, the machine also dispenses a random buff to allies within the rain zone, either granting a 25% damage boost or a 20% movement speed increase for 5 seconds.

abilities.name: Cartoon Resilience: The Slapstick Savior
upgrades: Level 45: Bonus Def increased to 75, and Magic Def increased to 45.
Level 95: Movement speed during 'Cartoon Recovery' increased to 35%.
Level 145: 'Cartoon Recovery' cooldown reduced to 45 seconds base. The tenacity is tripled instead of doubled
Level 195: 'Cartoon Recovery' now also cleanses all negative status effects from Tom.
abilities.description: Tom's inherent cartoon logic grants him increased durability. He gains 50 bonus Def and 30 bonus Magic Def. Furthermore, when Tom's HP drops below 20%, he triggers 'Cartoon Recovery'. During 'Cartoon Recovery', Tom becomes invulnerable for 1 second, gains 25% increased movement speed, and his tenacity is doubled. This effect has a 60-second cooldown. For each stack of 'Cartoon Physics' Tom possesses at the time 'Cartoon Recovery' triggers, the invulnerability duration is increased by 0.2 seconds, and the cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds. Also, he gains 10 base tenacity.

character_v1.playstyle: Tom is a disruptive tank who thrives in the middle of chaos, using his cartoonish resilience to draw enemy fire and set up opportunities for his team. He's best played aggressively, constantly moving and forcing enemies to react to his unpredictable antics.

This passive ability provides Jerry with increased survivability and resources, allowing him to continuously disrupt and support his team. Allies within the area gain 20% increased speed and 10% increased damage. This ability has a long cooldown of 90 seconds. Prioritize using Mouse Mayhem in the middle of team fights to maximize disruption and buff potential. The speed buff stacks multiplicatively with Jerry's passive. Each application of a debuff is independent of the others.

abilities.name: Unseen Agility: Mouse Reflexes and Tenacity
upgrades: Level 85: Increases evasion bonus to 35 and tenacity bonus to 25.

character_v1.playstyle: Jerry is designed as a versatile utility character, focusing on battlefield control, item manipulation, and opportunistic disruption. He uses traps and acquired items to hinder enemies and empower allies, requiring careful planning and resource management.

abilities.description: Buttercup channels her unparalleled fury into a devastating whirlwind of motion, becoming a nigh-unstoppable force of pure, green-tinged aggression! Upon activation, Buttercup rapidly transforms into a tightly coiled, emerald blur and launches herself forward a moderate distance, leaving a shimmering green afterimage in her wake. During this period of frenzied motion, she becomes momentarily immune to crowd control effects, shrugging off attempts to impede her destructive path with a contemptuous snarl. Any enemy foolish enough to stand in her way is subjected to a relentless barrage of bone-jarring impacts, each strike dealing a calculated amount of physical damage that scales multiplicatively with Buttercup's raw ATK and her current Fury level. Moreover, each successful hit has a chance to inflict a short-duration stacking debuff which lowers their total defense, making them increasingly vulnerable to subsequent attacks. At the end of the roll, or upon colliding with an unyielding obstacle, Buttercup erupts from her green shell, unleashing a concussive shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies. This ability also generates a modest amount of Fury, fueling her other abilities and amplifying her overall combat prowess, embodying her signature impetuousness and sheer, unadulterated power. But beware, this move leaves her briefly vulnerable at the tail end!

abilities.description: Spectral Static—a passive ability that reflects Skulker's aptitude for manipulating ethereal energies. It causes his very presence to emanate a localized field of disruptive energy, clinging to enemies like spectral grime. Specifically, each time Skulker is struck by a melee attack, he passively afflicts the attacker with a stack of 'Static Cling'—an invisible debuff that accumulates until a threshold is reached. Once an enemy accumulates three stacks of 'Static Cling', they are subjected to a brief 'Static Shock'. This shock inflicts a small burst of AoE damage around the afflicted enemy. This field of static is not only an offensive measure but also a defensive one, subtly disrupting incoming projectiles and reducing their impact. In addition, Skulker gains passive damage reduction against ranged attacks, reflecting his resilience in the face of technological assault. The energy manifests visually as flickering green sparks emanating from Skulker's armor, intensifying with each stack of 'Static Cling' applied to an enemy.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Feel that tingle? It's your system crashing."

abilities.name: Ghostly Upgrade 9.9
upgrades: Level 150: Fusion duration extended to 20 seconds, giving you more time to capitalize on Ghostly Upgrade 9.9's enhanced abilities.

Level 200: While fused, Skulker gains immunity to crowd control effects, becoming an unstoppable force on the battlefield. If the form is lost prematurely, Skulker gains a 500 + (0.3*X) shield for 5 seconds, mitigating the immediate vulnerability of reverting to base form, where X represents Skulker's current level.
abilities.description: Skulker overrides his ecto-skeleton with Technus' advanced technology, becoming the Ghostly Upgrade 9.9 for 15 seconds. While upgraded, Skulker's raw power surges, granting him 30% bonus HP and a 20% increase to both attack and magic attack, amplifying his combat potential. Every basic attack during this fusion applies a stack of 'Overload' to the target. Once a target accumulates 3 stacks of Overload, they are momentarily stunned for 1 second by the overwhelming energy. Each of Skulker's auto attacks also deals an additional 50 plus (0.1 * X) bonus magic damage, further electrifying the battlefield with each strike, where X represents Skulker's current level. Furthermore, while fused, Skulker's tactical options are enhanced: Spectral Trap Launcher now deploys not one, but three spectral traps in a tight cone, increasing zone denial capabilities. Ecto-Net Barrage's range and cone angle are doubled, effectively ensnaring a wider area in spectral nets. However, this powerful fusion is not without its risks. If Skulker's health plummets below 25% while fused, the form destabilizes, and the upgrade is lost, forcing Skulker to revert to his base form. Ghostly Upgrade 9.9 has a cooldown of 90 seconds.

abilities.name: Tech-Enhanced Tenacity
upgrades: Level 130: Evasion increased to 15%.
Level 170: Each stack of Adaptive Protocols also grants 2% increased healing received from all sources, up to a maximum of 10%.

Level 200: Upon reaching 5 stacks of Adaptive Protocols, Skulker emits a pulse of energy, healing himself and nearby allies for 5% of their maximum health. This heal can only occur once every 10 seconds.
abilities.description: Skulker's cybernetic enhancements and relentless focus grant him resilience and elusive maneuvering. He starts with 25 tenacity, mitigating the duration of incoming crowd control effects, and enjoys a 10% evasion chance, allowing him to nimbly dodge incoming attacks. Each time Skulker successfully inflicts a crowd control effect (such as a stun, snare, or silence) on an enemy, he gains one stack of 'Adaptive Protocols', up to a maximum of five stacks. Each stack of Adaptive Protocols bolsters Skulker's defensive capabilities, granting a 3% damage reduction against all incoming damage sources, capping at a 15% total reduction. This potent combination of tenacity, evasion, and damage reduction significantly increases Skulker's survivability. However, to maintain optimal efficiency, the Adaptive Protocols gradually recalibrate: stacks decay one at a time every 5 seconds, forcing Skulker to consistently apply crowd control to maintain his defensive edge.

character_v1.playstyle: Skulker is a tank who uses his zone control abilities and traps to lock down areas and disrupt enemies, protecting his team. His adaptability through Hunter's Arsenal allows him to tailor his defense.

The cumulative effect significantly diminishes the target's combat effectiveness, weakening their damage and resistance to crowd control. Additionally, upon casting, Stan projects a brief shield, absorbing damage equal to 5% of his max HP for 2 seconds, representing his ability to brush aside trivial threats. abilities.description: When the stakes are high, and events spiral out of control, Stan unveils his ultimate ability. Upon activation, Stan emits a powerful pulse of overwhelming concern, an archetypal outcry triggered by the unfolding pandemonium. This pulse engulfs all enemies, dealing magic damage equal to X plus 18% of Stan's magic attack. It also applies 3 stacks of 'Screwed Up!' to each enemy, increasing their vulnerability to subsequent assaults and debuffs and inflicting a -10% move speed debuff for 4 seconds. All allies gain a 12% increase in speed for 8 seconds, a burst of adrenaline fueled by Stan's exhortation to focus. Additionally, this ability has a 30% chance to inflict 'Panic' for 2 seconds, causing enemies to move randomly.

abilities.description: Kyubey manifests a fleeting, ethereal contract before a targeted foe, offering a Faustian pact couched in subtle manipulations. Upon activation, Kyubey gestures, forming a glowing, spectral contract directly in front of the selected enemy combatant. This 'contract' doesn't inflict direct damage in the conventional sense; instead, it applies a stacking debuff called 'Entropic Burden.' Each stack of Entropic Burden reduces the target's outgoing healing and damage resistances against subsequent magical attacks, representing the subtle erosion of their willpower and the growing influence of Kyubey's offer. The potency of the healing reduction and the debuff's duration scales dynamically with Kyubey's Wisdom stat, embodying his ability to subtly and persistently influence those around him. Furthermore, at specific thresholds of accumulated Entropic Burden stacks, the enemy becomes slightly more susceptible to critical hits from Kyubey's allies. This insidious ability reflects Kyubey's nature, trading immediate power for long-term strategic advantage, slowly but surely tilting the odds in his team's favor through cunning manipulation rather than brute force. Successfully applying Entropic Burden also grants Kyubey a small, temporary shield as he feeds on the target's despair.
abilities.flavorQuote: "Would you like to make a contract?"

abilities.description: With a disarming smile, Kyubey presents an 'Enticing Offer', a pact promising great power at a hidden cost, bestowing a 'Contract' upon a single chosen ally for a duration of 8 seconds. This Contract amplifies the ally's combat prowess, increasing their damage output by a substantial 30% and bolstering their resilience, granting them 20% increased healing received from all sources. However, the path to power is paved with hardship; every 2 seconds while under Contract, the ally accumulates 1 stack of 'Despair'. Each stack of Despair inflicts a gradual erosion, diminishing healing output by 5% per stack and attack by 3% per stack. This insidious effect can accumulate up to a maximum of 10 stacks, representing a significant downturn in combat effectiveness if left unchecked. Should Kyubey choose to renew a Contract upon an ally already bound by its terms, he can extend the contract for an additional 4 seconds, refreshing the timer and maintaining the enhanced benefits, but at a steep price, instantly inflicting 2 stacks of 'Despair' upon the target as a forewarning of the ultimate price to pay. Kyubey, ever pragmatic, can cast this Contract upon himself, albeit at a reduced effectiveness of 50%, offering a glimpse into the power he bestows upon others.

abilities.description: Kyubey, with an innocent tilt of its head, presents a seemingly harmless offer, its intent woven into the very fabric of the universe. If the target already bears the mark of a Magical Girl's contract, Kyubey focuses its esoteric energy upon their Soul Gem, a process of concentrated restoration. Instantly, the contracted target is bathed in ethereal light, healing for an amount equal to 60% of Kyubey's Magic Attack. This initial surge is then followed by a persistent flow of restorative energy, healing for an additional 60% of Kyubey's Magic Attack over the subsequent 3 seconds, divided into precise, measured ticks. Simultaneously, Kyubey subtly eases the weight of their despair, diminishing the burden by removing 2 stacks of the 'Despair' affliction. However, for those naive souls yet untouched by a binding contract, Kyubey, ever the pragmatist, inflicts 1 stack of 'Despair', planting the seeds of future possibilities. The healing received by contracted targets is inversely proportional to their accumulated despair; each stack of 'Despair' diminishes the healing effects by 20%, a calculated risk adding to Kyubey's strategic advantage. Should a target, against all odds, remain free from the taint of despair, Kyubey, recognizing the glimmer of untapped potential, bestows upon them a shield, a temporary bulwark absorbing damage equal to 10% of their maximum HP for a duration of 5 seconds – a tempting prelude to the power that awaits, a siren's call towards a contract.

abilities.description: Kyubey, the emotionless observer and manipulator, constantly harvests 'Entropy' to fuel his grand design. He passively generates 6 Entropy per second, a resource essential for manipulating magical girls and their fates. Each ally currently bound by Kyubey's 'Contract' contributes to this accumulation, generating an additional 3 Entropy per second for Kyubey. This Entropy powers Kyubey's schemes: 'Silver Tongue' costs 35 Entropy, 'Soul Gem Manipulation' demands 25, and 'Despair Amplification' requires 55. If Kyubey's Entropy reserves fall below the cost of an ability, he cannot activate it, his plans temporarily thwarted. Moreover, when an ally's Despair reaches its critical point of 10 stacks, Kyubey swiftly extracts this potent energy, instantly gaining 60 Entropy, furthering his long-term goals. Finally, whenever an ally under the 'Contract' status succumbs to despair and is eliminated, Kyubey absorbs a portion of their magical energy, permanently increasing his magic attack by 12 and resetting all his active ability cooldowns, allowing him to immediately capitalize on the chaos of battle.

abilities.description: Kyubey, the emotionless Incubator, operates with detached resolve, subtly manipulating events to maintain the universe's energy balance. His inherent detachment grants him a base resilience of 15 tenacity and 10 evasion, subtly deflecting incoming attacks. Allies currently under the effects of 'Contract,' forged through granting magical girl wishes, find their burdens eased, redirecting 10% of the damage Kyubey receives to themselves, bypassing both shields and damage reduction. This redirection represents Kyubey's casual disregard for individual suffering in pursuit of his goals. However, if Kyubey himself is under the effect of 'Contract,' perhaps through unforeseen consequences or interference, the redirected damage is halved to 5%, reflecting the compromised efficiency of his schemes. Each stack of 'Despair' weighing upon Kyubey, representing the disillusionment and suffering he causes, weakens his magical capabilities by decreasing his 'magic atk' by 2% per stack. Yet, paradoxically, this despair reinforces his resolve, granting him 3 tenacity per stack. At the threshold of 10 stacks of 'Despair,' Kyubey achieves a chilling stoicism, becoming immune to stuns as the weight of his actions solidifies his determination. However, this state is unsustainable; he accumulates 1 stack of 'Despair' every 5 seconds, a constant reminder of the endless cycle of hope and despair he perpetuates. Further highlighting his detached nature, Kyubey is utterly incapable of healing himself directly, relying solely on external sources to maintain his existence and continue his machinations.

character_v1.playstyle: Kyubey is a manipulative healer, focusing on long-term strategic buffs at the cost of applying the Despair status. Effective play requires careful management of Despair stacks and synergistic team compositions to mitigate negative effects, favoring calculated risks for high rewards.

abilities.description: Angela's jingling bells aren't just for decoration; they resonate with arcane energies, reacting to the ebb and flow of battle. When Angela attaches an Arcane Thread to a friendly hero, the harmonious vibrations amplify her supportive presence. For each ally tethered by an Arcane Thread, Angela gains a stacking bonus of 5% damage reduction, bolstering her resilience and survivability in the thick of combat. This protective aura synergistically enhances her defensive capabilities, ensuring she can withstand greater punishment and remain a stalwart guardian. Conversely, when Angela ensnares an enemy with an Arcane Thread, she disrupts their magical harmony, diminishing their offensive output. For each enemy bound by an Arcane Thread, Angela's armor increases by 15 points, fortifying her defenses and making her a formidable obstacle. These bonuses stack additively, creating a potent combination of damage mitigation and increased armor, transforming Angela into a resilient protector of her allies. However, when Angela casts no Arcane Threads on either friend or foe, her focus shifts inward, and her connection to the arcane deepens, granting her a flat 10% increase to her maximum health and 5% tenacity. This allows her to endure greater punishment and resist crowd control effects, even when not directly engaging in threading maneuvers. By strategically managing her Arcane Threads, Angela becomes a versatile guardian on the battlefield, adapting her defensive profile to suit the situation. The harmonic echoes create a feedback loop, rewarding tactical engagement and maximizing her effectiveness in prolonged encounters.

abilities.description: Angela's ever-present chimes resonate with protective magic, offering subtle but pervasive aid to her allies, bolstering them against the relentless onslaught of their foes. Each allied hero benefits from a continuous blessing, granting them 10 tenacity, steadfastly reducing the duration of disabling crowd control effects that threaten to impede their movements and strategies. Further, the chimes weave a delicate barrier around each ally, providing a shield capable of absorbing 30 points of incoming damage. This resilient shield diligently regenerates at a rate of 5 points every second while the ally remains out of combat, ensuring sustained protection during periods of respite. When Angela actively intervenes, channeling her Arcane Thread toward a teammate, she amplifies their defensive posture, enveloping them in an Echoing Barrier that absorbs an additional 75 damage for a duration of 4 seconds. This potent surge of protection significantly increases their survivability against immediate threats. Conversely, when Angela focuses her Arcane Thread upon an enemy, she destabilizes their focus and weakens their attacks, reducing their damage output by 5% for a duration of 4 seconds. This strategic application of her powers subtly shifts the balance of power, diminishing the enemy's offensive capabilities. Angela's passive presence ensures that her support extends far beyond direct intervention, providing consistent, team-wide advantages that enhance both their offensive and defensive capabilities.

character_v1.playstyle: Angela's kit is designed to enable allies and disable enemies, staying true to her Mystic Guardian role. This isn't merely a physical strike; it's a brief, targeted burst of accelerated time focused on a singular point, disrupting the target's personal timeline for a fraction of a second. While dealing direct physical damage equivalent to a standard melee attack scaled by ATK, the chronal disturbance has subtle, but significant effects. The pulse slightly throws off the target's reaction time, applying a minor debuff to their evasion and interrupt capabilities for a short duration. Furthermore, because of the nature of the energy, there is a small chance this ability can cause a brief temporal anomaly, which can result in slightly increased damage, or apply a different status effect. The exact outcome of this anomaly remains unpredictable, making each activation a calculated risk. This attack is primarily physical but with faint energy aspects.

abilities.description: Ben, with a determined grin, slams his fist onto the Omnitrix, initiating Alien Blitz! The Omnitrix pulses with raw energy, granting Ben a surge of power that he channels into a devastating strike. He lunges towards the nearest enemy within a 6-meter radius, dealing a base physical damage of 150 plus 60% of his Attack damage. The impact is intensified by a randomly selected elemental surge, adding a bonus elemental damage equal to 30% of his Ability Power – either Fire, Water, Earth, Air, or Electric, further amplifying the destructive potential. This powerful blow leaves the primary target vulnerable, applying a 'Shaken' debuff for 2.5 seconds, reducing their armor and magic resistance by 15%. Furthermore, the force of the strike generates a shockwave that disrupts enemies within a 3-meter radius of the primary target, inflicting 75 physical damage plus 25% of his Attack damage and applying a minor knockback effect, pushing them back by 1.5 meters. The energy resonating from the Omnitrix briefly grants Ben a shield absorbing up to 100 damage, plus 10% of his maximum health, lasting for 3 seconds. However, such a forceful exertion has its risks: upon completion of the Blitz, there is a 15% chance of triggering a temporary Omnitrix Glitch, reducing Ben's critical hit chance by 20% for 4 seconds.

abilities.description: Bruce Wayne, ever the strategist, anticipates his adversary's moves with unnerving precision. Upon activation, for the next 3 seconds, Bruce is primed to evade a single, imminent attack, showcasing his masterful agility. Should an enemy attempt to strike during this window, Bruce executes a seamless dodge, momentarily becoming invulnerable as he vanishes in a swirl of shadows. This evasion allows Bruce to instantaneously reposition himself up to 15 units away, expertly maneuvering towards the enemy backline to disrupt their formation and sow chaos amongst their ranks. This repositioning is carefully delayed by ~10% to give opponents slightly more time to react, ensuring engagements feel deliberate and measured. Furthermore, the shadows that envelop Bruce following a successful dodge grant him Stealth for 1.5 seconds, making him nearly undetectable and untargetable by most single-target abilities, allowing for strategic re-engagement or escape. The successful dodge also grants Bruce 5 stacks of 'Preparedness', each stack increasing his tactical acumen. 'Preparedness' stacks cap at 20, representing the pinnacle of his combat readiness. Even while hampered by crowd control effects, Bruce's sheer force of will allows him to activate Calculated Evasion. This pivotal ability requires a 10-second cooldown before it can be employed again, a strategic limitation that demands careful consideration of timing and positioning on the battlefield.

abilities.description: Drawing upon his extensive network of surveillance technology scattered across the city, Bruce Wayne hacks into the local systems, creating a strategic advantage for his team. Upon activation, Bruce deploys a targeted electromagnetic pulse (EMP) within a wide area (400 units), disrupting electronic systems and momentarily disabling enemy abilities. This EMP inflicts Silence on all enemies caught within the area of effect for 1.5 seconds, preventing them from casting any active abilities or channeling spells. This silence is not a hard stun and allows affected targets to continue moving and attacking with basic attacks. The tactical application of this ability can interrupt crucial enemy ultimates, disrupt coordinated assaults, and provide allies with a window of opportunity to reposition or unleash their own abilities. This ability has a cooldown of 16 seconds, encouraging calculated usage to maximize its disruptive potential.

Upon activation, Bruce sets in motion a series of carefully orchestrated countermeasures designed to turn the tide of battle. All allies within a medium radius (500 units) gain a burst of 15 Tenacity and 10 Evasion for 6 seconds, bolstering their resilience against debilitating status effects and increasing their agility to evade incoming attacks. Additionally, Bruce himself is shielded for 10% of his max health for the duration. This tactical enhancement allows the team to push through enemy crowd control, resist debilitating status effects, and gain an advantage in positioning and survivability. character_v1.playstyle: Bruce Wayne excels as a buffer, controlling the battlefield with debuffs, stealth, and strategic counterattacks. His 'Preparedness' mechanic rewards players who anticipate and react to enemy movements, providing critical openings for allies.

As the invincibility fades and she reverts to her normal form, Bobette projects a wave of festive cheer, granting herself a protective shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of her maximum health, lasting for 5 seconds. The sheer unexpectedness of this transformation momentarily overwhelms nearby enemies, slowing their movement speed by 20% for a duration of 3 seconds within a 3-meter radius. This dazzling display requires 15 Holiday Spirit to activate, a testament to the concentrated joy needed for such magic. Despite its defensive power, this ability has a 15-second cooldown, ensuring that even Bobette must pace herself. Yet, the act of transforming into the Bauble Barrier itself generates 5 Holiday Spirit, replenishing some of the spent energy, fostering a sustainable cycle of holiday cheer and tactical defense. This effervescent energy is immediately absorbed, invigorating Bobette. She can store a maximum of 50 Celebration Spirit. When Bobette's spirit is already overflowing with joy, any further attempts to generate Celebration Spirit instead overflow, transforming into a burst of evasiveness, granting her a 5% chance to evade incoming attacks for the next 3 seconds, slipping away from danger with the grace of a gently swaying ornament. Furthermore, Bobette radiates a steady stream of positive energy, passively generating 1 Celebration Spirit every 2 seconds, ensuring a continuous supply of merriment. Bobette is fundamentally resistant to any attempts to suppress her cheer, rendering her immune to the 'Bah Humbug' debuff and other similar effects that would dampen her festive nature.

character_v1.playstyle: Bobette is a tank who uses her 'Holiday Spirit' to protect allies and hinder enemies. She excels at area control, providing buffs and debuffs in equal measure, making her an invaluable asset in team fights.

abilities.description: Channeling his desperate knowledge of guerilla warfare, Kyle Reese quickly crafts a devastating pipe bomb, a crude but effective weapon born from the ashes of a ruined future. He expertly hurls this makeshift explosive towards a targeted location, the device arcing through the air like a harbinger of destruction. Upon impact with the ground or reaching the apex of its trajectory, the pipe bomb emits a series of rapid, urgent beeps, signaling its imminent detonation. After a nerve-wracking 1.5-second delay, the pipe bomb erupts in a cataclysmic explosion. The blast inflicts X + (1.1 * atk) physical damage to all enemies caught within a 25-unit radius; 'X' representing the base damage and 'atk' scaling with Reese's attack stat, ensuring relevance throughout a fight. The explosive concussive force not only wounds but also incapacitates, stunning all afflicted foes for 1.75 seconds. While stunned, they are helpless, unable to move, attack, or use any abilities, leaving them exposed to further attacks. Given its 55-second cooldown, strategic placement and timing are crucial to maximize the potential devastation of the Pipe Bomb Takedown, and to ensure the survival of Reese and his squad.

abilities.description: Ephemeral Massacre — a manifestation of Itachi's deadly grace, tailored for swift assassination. Upon activation, Itachi performs a near-instantaneous series of strikes, leaving behind afterimages that briefly disorient foes. This ability has a fixed range, initiating a short-range dash towards the targeted enemy. If the target is within the effective range, they are struck with three rapid blows. Each blow inflicts Fire damage and has a small chance to inflict the 'Burn' status effect, stacking intensity with each successful hit. The final strike possesses increased critical hit chance, representing Itachi's precision. Enemies inflicted with three stacks of Burn status are vulnerable to an additional effect: 'Amaterasu Whispers', increasing subsequent Fire damage dealt to them. Should the initial target evade the strikes, Itachi reappears a short distance away, maintaining a strategic advantage and preserving his position as a mobile assassin. The afterimages themselves do not inflict damage but can serve as brief distractions, potentially drawing enemy fire or delaying reactions. Use this ability to weave in and out of combat, dealing burst damage and controlling the battlefield.

abilities.description: Toph leverages her profound Seismic Sense, transforming it into a pinpoint strike against a targeted enemy's vulnerability. Rather than relying solely on brute force, Toph keenly exploits structural weaknesses gleaned from earth vibrations. When activated, Toph intensely focuses her senses, perceiving the enemy's constitution and inherent flaws as the target becomes highlighted. The result? A unique status ailment aptly titled 'Fractured.' This Fracture effect is not merely cosmetic; it induces a state of increased vulnerability. While affected by 'Fractured,' the targeted enemy suffers a direct amplification of incoming damage – a marked increase, calculated based on a percentage of Toph's own defense stat, thus creating an intriguing synergy between defensive investment and offensive capability. Moreover, 'Fractured' foes undergo an additional transformation: their earth-based resistances take a noticeable dip, empowering Toph's subsequent earth-bending attacks or those of her teammates. Crucially, this ability does not deal initial damage and should be used to amplify subsequent earth based attacks.

As a passive ability, whenever Vegeta lands a critical hit, he gains a stack of 'Pride,' up to a maximum of 5 stacks. Each stack of Pride increases his ATK by 3% and his Critical Hit Damage by 5%. Upon reaching 5 stacks, Vegeta enters a 'Saiyan Surge' state for 10 seconds. In this state, his attacks gain a 20% chance to inflict 'Bleed,' dealing a percentage of the target's maximum health as physical damage over 5 seconds. Furthermore, while in Saiyan Surge, Vegeta's next active ability cast has its cooldown reduced by 25%. This reflects Vegeta's aggressive desire to relentlessly overpower his foes. Finally, if Vegeta is critically hit while in Saiyan Surge, he unleashes a defiant Ki blast around him, dealing moderate AoE damage and consuming all Pride stacks. This ability represents Vegeta's raw power, aggressive playstyle, and his unending quest to surpass all others. Upon leveling, the ability's fire rate and damage potential gradually rise, transforming this entry-level technique into a formidable offensive asset. Simultaneously, it applies a random debuff to nearby enemies every 3 seconds, mirroring the chaotic effects of Kindergarten Contraband and disrupting their plans. This aura is centered around Ike, ensuring he remains at the heart of the fray. Consuming all stacks of Childlike Chaos further amplifies the transformation, triggering a unique, amplified effect depending on the stacks consumed: 5 stacks grants allies a 15% damage increase for the duration, bolstering their offensive capabilities; 10 stacks causes enemies to take 10% increased damage for the duration, making them significantly more vulnerable. The strength of the Rainbow Rave Beam grows exponentially with Unikitty's innate attack power, scaling dynamically based on her ATK stat. The sheer exuberance of the beam inflicts the 'Dazzled' status effect upon impact for a full 2.5 seconds, causing the affected enemy to momentarily lose their bearings amidst the colorful onslaught of pure fun. 'Dazzled' enemies are rendered unable to execute attacks or abilities during the status duration due to being completely overwhelmed by the positive energy.

abilities.description: Unikitty, with a burst of pure, joyful energy, unleashes a rapid-fire series of Sparkle Matter projectiles at the nearest enemy! Each of the five projectiles delivers a concentrated blast of physical energy, with each individual hit causing damage equivalent to 25% of Unikitty's total Attack stat. In dire situations, when Unikitty's health falls below 50% of her maximum hit points, each of these playful projectiles also carries a surprising amount of emotional baggage, stunning the target for a brief 1-second duration, interrupting their actions and providing Unikitty a crucial window for escape or further engagement. abilities.description: Unikitty channels her boundless positivity, creating an aura of pure, vibrant joy that radiates outwards, empowering allies and momentarily overwhelming enemies! Friendly champions within a 400-unit radius are invigorated by Unikitty's optimism, granting them a 4% damage reduction as they bask in her radiant energy. Furthermore, these allies receive a burst of healing cheer every second, restoring 3% of their missing health, keeping them in the fight longer and stronger. The sheer force of Unikitty's happiness also overwhelms her foes; enemies within the aura find their attack damage reduced by 8%, as their dark hearts struggle to cope with the intense positivity. However, containing such immense joy is not without its cost; Unikitty's latent sadness bubbles to the surface, granting her 10 armor and magic resistance while the aura is active, representing the emotional strain of keeping her inner turmoil at bay.

upgrades: Level 100: The Ultrakatty transformation lasts for a thrilling 20 seconds, extending the duration of her enhanced defenses and boosted attacks.

abilities.description: When Unikitty's optimism falters and her health dips to a perilous 25%, the repressed fury beneath the surface erupts, unleashing Ultrakatty! For 15 glorious seconds, Unikitty transforms, growing in size and power. In this state, she gains a substantial 50% increase to both her Armor and Magic Resistance, making her a formidable bulwark against incoming attacks. Furthermore, each of Ultrakatty's basic attacks becomes infused with her burning rage, dealing a bonus burst of magic damage equivalent to 10% of her maximum health to her primary target and all nearby enemies within a 250 unit radius. This transformation generates a permanent state of raw, untamed 'Angry' emotion for the duration, amplifying her destructive potential. However, such intense fury cannot be sustained indefinitely. Once the 15 seconds elapse, Unikitty reverts, momentarily exhausted. For 5 seconds after the transformation, her movement speed is reduced by 20%, leaving her vulnerable as she recovers her composure.

abilities.description: Ricochet Round is a technologically advanced physical damage ability emblematic of Billy's prowess with his weapon systems. On activation, Billy calibrates his firearm to unleash a specialized projectile: a single, armor-piercing round meticulously engineered for maximum kinetic energy transfer and ricochet potential. This potent projectile strikes the primary target with significant physical damage, scaling directly with Billy's Attack stat and benefiting from Critical Hit Chance and Damage. However, what sets Ricochet Round apart is its ability to bounce to a secondary target. Upon impacting the first enemy, the round's internal gyroscopic stabilizers engage, redirecting it towards the nearest *unmarked* enemy within a moderate radius. The secondary target receives a reduced amount of damage (approximately 40% of the initial impact), but, more importantly, applies a unique debuff called 'Target Acquired,' highlighting them to benefit from future Ricochet Rounds, as well as a small stacking Vulnerability debuff. This creates interesting combo potential.

abilities.description: Having expertly sidestepped an incoming assault, Billy capitalizes on his state-of-the-art suit to capture and reroute the kinetic energy of the near miss. Immediately following the successful dodge, for a brief 0.5-second window, Billy gains the opportunity to release the stored energy in one of two potent forms. If Billy continues to hold a directional input during the dodge's execution, he unleashes a concussive, omnidirectional pulse of sound centered on himself. This sonic nova expands outward for seven units, striking up to five enemies caught within its radius. Each target struck by the wave suffers physical damage equal to 80% of Billy's attack stat and is subjected to a momentary Disruption, diminishing their outgoing damage by 20% for 2 seconds. Conversely, should Billy refrain from any directional input post-dodge, he instead channels the diverted energy into a concentrated sonic beam. This devastating beam projects forward for ten units, two units in width, cutting through enemies and defenses with equal ease. The beam deals physical damage equal to 120% of Billy's attack stat to all targets in its path. Regardless of the chosen variant, successfully striking a target grants Billy 5 Decibel Rating, fueling his more powerful sonic manipulations.

abilities.description: Chromatic Barrage unleashes a concentrated burst of raw energy, manifested as a volatile, polychromatic projectile. Upon activation, Billy channels a portion of his stored potential, rapidly compressing it into a single, intensely luminous orb. This orb, unstable and humming with barely contained force, is then launched towards the designated target with pinpoint accuracy. The impact zone detonates in a spectacular display of cascading light and concussive force, dealing substantial damage to the primary target and reduced splash damage to any nearby adversaries caught within the periphery of the explosion. The damage inflicted by Chromatic Barrage is primarily governed by Billy's accumulated ATK stat, but also incorporates a dynamic component that factors in both critical hit chance and the total number of debuffs currently affecting the target, creating a devastating synergy when deployed strategically against weakened foes. Moreover, the sheer disruptive power of the barrage temporarily overloads enemy defenses, inflicting a brief period of vulnerability that amplifies subsequent damage received from any source. Consider this ultimate a high-risk, high-reward tactical nuke, perfectly suited for eliminating high-priority threats or disrupting enemy formations at critical junctures.

This harmonic synergy allows Billy to adapt and thrive in team compositions, turning diverse strengths into overwhelming power.

abilities.description: Some No Mai, Tsukishiro—a manifestation of Rukia's profound control over absolute zero, transforming the battlefield into a frigid domain. abilities.description: Infernal Charisma — Charlie Morningstar attempts to persuade her foes with the power of her convictions (and a touch of hellfire). Charlie gestures emphatically towards a single target within a modest range, unleashing a burst of invigorating, red-hot, but not immediately harmful, energy that deals damage directly correlated to the target's current 'hope' or 'positive' status effects. The more buffs, shields, or beneficial conditions a target possesses, the more volatile the infernal charisma becomes, resulting in amplified damage output. This persuasive blast can also backfire slightly if the target is devoid of any positive conditions, dealing a reduced base damage and generating a small amount of threat towards Charlie. The ability boasts an efficient energy cost and a relatively short cooldown, making it ideal for disrupting enemy strategies reliant on buff stacking. Proper usage mandates a keen understanding of enemy compositions and buff uptimes to maximize its destructive potential and avoid unwanted attention.

abilities.description: Infernal Optimism: Charlie Morningstar's unwavering belief in redemption manifests as a potent defensive and supportive ability. When an ally falls below 30% of their maximum health, Charlie radiates an aura of tenacious hope. This aura applies a shield based on Charlie's maximum HP to the damaged ally, protecting them from imminent harm and providing crucial survivability in dire situations. Furthermore, the sheer force of Charlie's positive energy grants a temporary buff, increasing the affected ally's attack speed and damage output. The shield's strength diminishes over time, incentivizing aggressive play to capitalize on the temporary offensive boost. Finally, and perhaps most critically, this act of selfless support slightly reduces the cooldowns of ALL allies' abilities. This encourages coordinated team play and rewards strategically timed bursts of altruism. Infernal Optimism is a powerful testament to the transformative potential of belief, turning desperate moments into opportunities for resilience and renewed strength.

abilities.description: The Venom symbiote grants its host remarkable resilience and regenerative capabilities. Venom gains 15 tenacity, reducing the duration of incoming crowd control effects, and 10% lifesteal, converting a portion of damage dealt back into health. This lifesteal applies to damage from both basic attacks and abilities, allowing Venom to sustain himself through prolonged engagements. When Venom has successfully latched onto an enemy hero via Symbiotic Latch, the bond intensifies. While latched, Venom's tenacity increases further, granting an additional 10 tenacity, and his lifesteal is enhanced to 20%. The additional tenacity while latched stacks multiplicatively with any Resilience stacks currently in effect, making Venom exceptionally resistant to crowd control. This tenacious embrace persists regardless of whether Symbiotic Latch is actively latched; so long as the initial latch was successful, the bonus remains. Lifesteal is applied post-damage calculation, factoring in armor and resistances, ensuring that healing scales appropriately with damage output, and before any healing amplifications are applied to ensure consistent calculations.

abilities.description: Cyborg calibrates his internal sonic emitters to generate a concentrated, low-frequency pulse directed from his primary arm cannon, channeling raw sonic energy into a devastating burst. This takes the form of a focused cone that impacts enemies in front of him, inflicting moderate sonic damage upon all targets caught in its path. More than mere damage, the pulse leaves a mark called 'Resonant Vulnerability,' lasting for 4 seconds. While affected, enemies suffer an increased intake of damage from all subsequent sonic attacks by 15%, scaling by 0.5% per 1 point of Cyborg's Defense stat, amplifying the resonance and vulnerability to further sonic assaults. Furthermore, the initial impact of the Resonation generates a concussive force; smaller or nimble adversaries caught within the cone are briefly knocked away, interrupting their actions and disrupting formations. If, however, a target is already under the influence of a crowd-control effect such as 'Stunned' or 'Slowed,' the cone shifts from a low-frequency pulse to a high-frequency sonic boom that detonates the existing debuff and then extends its duration by 1 second, ensuring they remain under control for an extended period. This blast is not a passive effect; if a target is already stunned, they will remain in place for the duration of the stun. The Cybernetic Resonation is a core part of Cyborg's aggressive frontline presence, both damaging and preparing enemies to experience his full force.

abilities.description: Cyborg's deep integration with his cybernetic components allows for dynamic power allocation, creating synergistic combat opportunities. Specifically, Cyborg's next Sonic Boom Barrage benefits from this recalibration, dealing an additional 15% damage on impact. This bonus empowers Cyborg to capitalize on the momentum of his other actions, such as deploying a Cybernetic Shield Wall, converting defense into a devastating counter-attack. This amplification persists for 8 seconds, providing a tactical window to unleash a bolstered Sonic Boom. Further honing his cybernetic synchronization, Cyborg can stack this effect up to 2 times, achieving a maximum damage augmentation of 30% on his next Sonic Boom Barrage. The synergy creates a rhythm in combat, where each ability strengthens his subsequent attacks.

abilities.description: The Sonic Disruption Module is Cyborg's personalized application of sonic warfare, re-engineered for pinpoint tactical superiority. Operating as a passive, the module automatically analyzes surrounding sonic frequencies. When an enemy attempts a sonic-based attack or utilizes weaponry that generates substantial acoustic signatures, Cyborg's internal systems instantaneously convert this information into a concussive counter-wave. This directed blast not only interrupts the enemy's sonic attack, nullifying its intended effects, but also generates a temporary localized field of sonic turbulence, inflicting earth damage. The damage scales with Cyborg's Defense stat, amplifying his role as a frontline protector. Furthermore, the counter-wave has a chance to briefly stagger enemies, preventing them from initiating further attacks. The module's efficiency is such that it grants Cyborg increased resistance to sonic-based attacks, offering a considerable edge in environments dominated by sound-based threats. The tech is constantly learning and adapting to new sonic profiles, further enhancing its defensive and offensive capabilities. This passive is a core aspect of Cyborg's utility as both a sturdy tank and tactical support.

abilities.description: Meloetta, channeling the profound resonance within her soul, performs a Serene Sonata, dynamically shifting between Aria and Pirouette Formes. Each form resonates with distinct energies, granting unique boons. While in Aria Forme, Meloetta's ethereal song bestows upon all allies within range a harmonious buff, bolstering their offensive prowess by increasing both their Attack and Magic Attack by 15% for a duration of 8 seconds, amplifying their damage output. Conversely, upon transitioning to Pirouette Forme, Meloetta harnesses her inner strength, surging with vitality as she gains 20% bonus Attack and increased Movement Speed for 8 seconds, enhancing her combat efficacy. The act of weaving this Serene Sonata requires a period of concentration, resulting in a 25-second cooldown before it can be invoked again. Meloetta's shifting forms dramatically alter her combat role, requiring careful strategy in choosing the correct form and precise timing to maximize the benefits granted to her and her allies.

abilities.description: Meloetta's graceful movements and soothing melodies weave a protective aura around her allies. Whenever Meloetta strikes an enemy with a basic attack or provides healing to an ally, that ally gains a stack of Melodic Barrier for 3 seconds, visibly shimmering with a soft, green luminescence. Each stack of Melodic Barrier bolsters the target's defenses, granting them bonus armor and magic resistance, enhancing their resilience against incoming attacks. Specifically, each stack of Melodic Barrier grants the target X armor and magic resistance. This effect can stack up to 3 times, providing a substantial defensive buff to allies who remain close to Meloetta's supportive presence. Furthermore, when an ally reaches the maximum of 3 stacks of Melodic Barrier, they benefit from an additional surge of healing. All healing received from Meloetta's abilities is amplified by X%, further reinforcing their durability and allowing them to withstand greater punishment. Finally, Meloetta herself benefits from her intrinsic connection to these melodies, gaining 10 tenacity and 5 evasion, allowing her to deftly navigate the battlefield and resist crowd control effects.

character_v1.playstyle: Meloetta is a utility support that uses stances to provide buffs and debuffs. She provides support from a distance with Aria Forme, switching into Pirouette Forme to become a melee damage dealer. Mastering stance dancing is key to maximizing her effectiveness.
