abilities.description: Mojo Jojo, ever the loquacious villain, unleashes his potent intellect in the form of a 'Monologue Minefield'. This ability, triggered by the presence of a marked target, forces Mojo Jojo to launch into an extended, self-aggrandizing speech. The intensity of this verbose onslaught is such that it inflicts considerable mental strain on the targeted opponent. Specifically, once a target is marked by one of Mojo's traps, this ability will cause the targeted enemy to be trapped in place as Mojo Jojo launches into a villainous lecture. The intensity of the ranting causes a temporary stun and grants a significant decrease in enemy damage resistance for a brief duration. The duration of both effects scales positively with Mojo Jojo's intelligence and charisma stats; the better he articulates his villainous plans, the more devastating the effect. Furthermore, the tactical deployment of this Monologue is no mere distraction; the sheer volume of villainous exposition generates a resonating field that disrupts enemy focus, lowering their critical hit damage. The power of this ability is not to be understated. It is Mojo Jojo at his most Mojo Jojo-est! Use with caution! Side effects of ability use can include temporary hearing loss, eye twitching, increased vulnerability to psychological damage, and the overwhelming desire to join the forces of good. These side effects are not the responsibility of Mojo Jojo or the game developers.

abilities.description: Debbie, ever the strategist, analyzes the battlefield and identifies the ally currently in the gravest danger. She swiftly intervenes, offering Calculated Aid in the form of both immediate recuperation and bolstered defense. Debbie instantly restores health to the ally with the lowest current health percentage, healing them for an amount that scales with her magic attack. In addition, she grants them a resilient shield, fortifying their defenses and absorbing incoming damage, scaling with Debbie’s Defense, for a duration of 3 seconds. This shield not only safeguards them from immediate threats but allows them to reposition and continue fighting effectively. Her Calculated Aid focuses on proactive protection rather than simply reactive healing, buying time and giving allies the upper hand in desperate situations. It is, ultimately, a calculated gambit, designed to turn the tides of battle and secure her team's victory by preserving a vital member. The shield degrades to nothing at the end of the 3 seconds.

abilities.description: Road Runner, always several steps ahead, kicks up a furious cloud of desert dust and grit as he accelerates forward for a brief period, lasting 6 seconds. This swirling vortex of disorienting particles lingers in his wake, creating a zone of discomfort for any unfortunate opponents who wander into its sandy embrace. Enemies caught within the roiling dust cloud will find themselves not only taking 30 plus an additional amount equal to 10% of Road Runner's Attack stat as physical damage, once every second, but also slowed, their movement speed reduced by 15% as they struggle to navigate the reduced visibility and stinging sand. Even if Road Runner decides to halt his rapid movement, the dust cloud stubbornly persists for its full duration, continuing to hinder and harm those caught inside. This makes it ideal for both zoning control and dealing damage while maintaining strategic distance.

abilities.description: Road Runner's legendary speed isn't just for running; it's also for confounding enemies! Whenever Road Runner narrowly avoids an attack, performing a swift dodge, there's a 20% chance he kicks up a swirling 'Dust Devil' mirage in his wake, right where he was moments before. This mirage, a convincing illusion of the Road Runner himself, immediately and irresistibly compels the attention of a single, randomly selected enemy within a 5-unit radius, taunting them to fixate on the dust cloud for 1.5 seconds. The cacophony of 'Beep-Beeps' and swirling dust is so mesmerizing that the same enemy can't be fooled by another Dust Devil Diversion for another 10 seconds – ensuring they don't fall for the same trick twice in quick succession. This clever distraction occurs anytime Road Runner dodges, regardless of how the dodge was triggered or its source, giving him a consistent edge in confusing his pursuers and creating chaos on the battlefield.

abilities.description: With a burst of improbable speed and a defiant “Meep Meep!”, the Road Runner becomes a blur, executing a short, targeted dash in a straight line, leaving a swirling vortex of dust and displaced air in his wake. Enemies caught in this whirlwind of cartoon physics suffer 100 points of magic damage, further amplified by 30% of the Road Runner's magic attack stat. The sheer audacity of his speed is enough to momentarily stun opponents for 1 full second, leaving them dazed and disoriented. Furthermore, the wind generated by his passage creates a powerful drag, slowing enemies hit by 30% for a duration of 3 seconds, making them easy prey for allies or a quick exit for the Road Runner himself. This short but impactful dash requires careful planning, as its fixed distance demands precise positioning to maximize its disruptive and damaging potential.

abilities.description: Road Runner's legendary swiftness provides him a 15% chance to outright evade any incoming attack. This isn't just a simple dodge; Road Runner is so fast, the attack never even connects! When the Road Runner successfully avoids an attack due to his blinding speed, he gains a burst of acceleration, increasing his movement speed by 20% for a fleeting 2 seconds. This sudden burst also grants him one stack of 'ACME Acceleration.' Each stack of ACME Acceleration supercharges his next attack, increasing its damage by 5%, stacking up to a maximum of 5 times. The evade calculation occurs before any damage considerations, ensuring that if the Road Runner evades, the attack is completely nullified. This allows him to maintain his momentum and capitalize on his near-impossible speed, turning near misses into opportunities for swift, devastating counter-attacks.

character_v1.playstyle: The Road Runner's design emphasizes mobility and sustained damage through hit-and-run tactics. He's built as a bruiser who can weave in and out of fights, leaving behind damage while stacking evasion.

abilities.description: Spunky's Surprise! — Rocko, ever the responsible pet owner, keeps his loyal companion, Spunky, close at hand... and close to his enemies! Whenever Rocko finds himself surrounded by the unkind denizens of this strange world, Spunky, ever eager to assist, unleashes a chaotic burst of undirected energy! In terms of gameplay, this ability triggers reactively whenever three or more enemies are within a moderately sized radius of Rocko. Upon activation, Spunky emits a series of five (5) rapidly-firing, short-ranged projectiles. Each projectile deals a percentage of Rocko's base Attack stat as direct damage, scaled primarily by his Luck stat; however, these projectiles are notoriously inaccurate, their trajectories decided by an intricate algorithm mimicking Spunky's own frantic movements. Projectiles can hit the same target multiple times, or even, in some instances, fly harmlessly past all foes. Due to Spunky's unpredictable nature, each projectile has a small chance to inflict one of three minor status effects: 'Dazed' (briefly reduces enemy movement speed), 'Confused' (slightly lowers enemy accuracy), or, hilariously, 'Covered in Fur' (a purely cosmetic debuff with no combat implications). While unreliable, 'Spunky's Surprise!' can provide a much-needed edge in desperate situations, reflecting the chaotic-yet-ultimately-helpful nature of Rocko's beloved pooch!

abilities.description: Rocko summons forth the spirit of the legendary Chokey Chicken, channeling its aggressively insistent salesmanship into a debilitating grapple. This signature passive, a devastating single-target technique, emphasizes Rocko's bruiser role by momentarily transforming him into a whirlwind of relentless customer service. Upon activation, Rocko latches onto a nearby enemy with surprising speed, his eyes widening with the crazed fervor of a door-to-door vacuum cleaner salesman. He proceeds to deliver a rapid flurry of sales pitches – so persuasive, so utterly overwhelming – that they manifest as pure physical damage, scaled primarily by Rocko's attack power. Each excruciating offer to "improve their lives with the latest in home sanitation technology!" translates into a distinct hit, creating a burst of damage. During the execution of the Chokey Chicken Chokehold, Rocko gains a momentary increase to his own defense, representing his unwavering commitment to the sale, while the target suffers a stacking debuff to their evasion, symbolizing their increasing mental fatigue from the sheer onslaught of marketing tactics. This ability is most effective against single, isolated targets, as the pressure of the pitch requires Rocko's full attention and unwavering focus. Timing is key; use it to interrupt casting animations or to punish enemies who overextend themselves.
abilities.flavorQuote: I'm not trying to pressure you, I'm just trying to IMPROVE YOUR LIVES!

abilities.description: Ganon, fueled by ancient pacts and sinister ambitions, thrusts his Trident forward, channeling raw, untamed darkness into a single, devastating projectile aimed at a chosen foe. For 8 seconds, each application of 'Bargain' empowers Ganon’s subsequent dark magic attacks against the afflicted enemy, increasing their damage by 5%, up to a maximum of 25% with 5 stacks. The accumulation of these dark pacts diminishes the target's magic resistance, making them increasingly vulnerable to the darkest arts Ganon commands. abilities.description: Ganon, channeling malevolent sorcery through his Skull Trident, unleashes a piercing projectile in a targeted direction, dealing an initial X magic damage to all enemies caught in its path, signifying the raw force of his dark ambition. Upon impact, the ground cracks and fissures erupt, transforming the area into a 'Warlock's Waste' that lasts for 5 seconds. This corrupted terrain reduces the movement speed of enemies by 20%, hindering their escape, and inflicts 'Miasma', a vile curse that siphons 1% of their maximum health per second as magic damage, showcasing Ganon's insidious control over life itself. The Warlock's Waste visually manifests as shadowy energy crackling along the ground, making it clear to all who behold it that they are under Ganon's dominion. abilities.description: Effie's Sugarcoated Command is a marvelously manipulative maneuver that blends the art of distraction with a subtle deployment of tactical advantage. Upon activation, Effie flourishes her hand with dramatic flair, creating a shimmering, illusory confection that briefly captures the attention of a single target enemy. This confectionery projection, resembling an exquisitely decorated cake or perhaps a tower of delightful pastries, hangs tantalizingly in the air before rapidly dissolving, leaving the target slightly dazed and disoriented. During this brief period of bewilderment, the targeted enemy suffers a decrease in their combat effectiveness, experiencing a reduction in both attack damage and accuracy as their focus is momentarily compromised by the allure of the ephemeral treat. Simultaneously, Effie amplifies the morale of a chosen ally, imbuing them with a fleeting surge of confidence. This inspiration manifests as a temporary increase in critical hit chance and a bolstering of their resolve, affording them greater resistance to incoming status ailments or crowd control effects. This exquisitely orchestrated display of support and subtle debilitation reflects Effie's knack for controlling situations from behind the scenes, offering a strategic edge wrapped in a veneer of whimsical indulgence.

abilities.description: Cato, a relentless survivor hardened by countless trials, channels his raw resilience, forging a temporary bond with an ally and mending their wounds by drawing from his own vitality. As the lines of past battles etch deeper, he expends a fraction of his indomitable fortitude to restore a base amount of X health to a single chosen ally, enhanced by 5% of Cato's maximum health. Once this pact is established, Cato imbues his target with a 'Blood Pact', boosting their physical damage by 5% and their magical damage by 10 for 5 seconds, turning the tide of survival. Upon casting, Cato's primal hunting instincts sharpen, increasing his damage by 5% and speed by 3% for 5 seconds in the form of a 'Savage Pursuit' stack. However, each strike of Savage Pursuit has a toll. At three or more stacks of Savage Pursuit, Cato's tactical vision wanes. For each stack of Savage Pursuit, his evasion is reduced by 5%, and the hunt blurs his decision making, creating a 20% chance per stack for his next basic attack to lash out at a random ally instead of the enemy—a constant reminder of the sacrifice for the hunt, and the fine line that lies between survival and demise.

abilities.description: Cato, ever the pragmatist, lays down a hidden tripwire. This creates a circular zone, 4 meters in radius, that persists for 5 seconds. Any enemy entering this zone triggers the trap, experiencing an immediate 20% reduction in their movement speed. This slowing effect accompanies a surge of electricity, dealing initial magic damage equal to X, scaling with 10% of Cato's magic attack, then burns the area for 3 seconds, dealing the same initial damage over that duration. The slow effect pulses every half-second, refreshing the duration if the enemy remains inside the electrified zone. Once the 5-second duration is over, the wire will disappear, leaving no trace of the deterrent behind. This trap is cunning, but not invincible and it is visible to other members of the opposing team.

abilities.description: When Cato's health is critically threatened, dipping below 20% of his maximum, his years of hardened experience kick in, triggering a final, desperate gambit. He immediately expends all accumulated Tactical Advantage stacks, converting them into a surge of resilience and a defensive bulwark. Upon activation, Cato is enveloped in a damage-absorbing shield, providing protection equal to a base value of X plus an additional shield strength based on 12% of his missing health at the moment of activation. This shield remains in effect for 5 seconds, giving him a window to turn the tide. Simultaneously, Cato consumes each Tactical Advantage stack, triggering an immediate burst of healing. Each stack consumed restores health equivalent to X base health plus 4% of Cato’s maximum health. This instantaneous influx of vitality reinforces his resolve, allowing him to weather the storm and potentially snatch victory from the jaws of defeat.

Balancing sobriety and inebriation is key to maximizing his healing and area control capabilities, embodying his role as a mentor and survivor.

abilities.description: Haymitch produces a glass filled with amber liquid, the contents of which appear both innocuous and deceptively potent. Upon imbibing a generous portion himself (for tactical purposes, naturally), Haymitch performs a sweeping, somewhat unsteady gesture towards his allies. The mystical fumes emanating from the glass coalesce around the designated target, providing a refreshing, if somewhat alcoholic, buff. Specifically, this ability grants a moderate heal over time, representing a temporary boost in morale and resilience. Simultaneously, the target benefits from increased attack speed, fueled by a reckless abandon granted by the 'spirits'. However, prolonged exposure can induce a state of 'Drunken Courage', resulting in slightly diminished accuracy but significantly heightened critical hit chance. Manage your team's sobriety wisely, or they might just stumble into victory... or a ditch.

abilities.description: Haymitch signals for a hasty retreat, splashing a bit of his potent, locally sourced spirits towards his allies. When used with at least 25 Intoxication, all allies within a radius of X are invigorated, receiving a sturdy shield that absorbs damage equal to 15% of Haymitch's magic attack for 3 seconds. This alcoholic surge also propels them forward, increasing their movement speed by 25% for the duration, providing a critical window for repositioning or escape. However, if Haymitch’s Intoxication level is low, below 25, he instead conserves his drink for the ally most in need, the one currently suffering with the lowest health. That ally gains a smaller shield worth 8% of Haymitch's magic attack, along with a 15% speed boost for the same 3-second duration. This strategic imbibing always costs Haymitch 25 Intoxication, focusing his blurred mind.

abilities.description: Haymitch, ever the strategist despite appearances, leverages his… unique perspective to bend the rules of engagement. Upon activation, Haymitch designates a circular area on the battlefield. After a brief, tipsy pause of 2 seconds – time enough for a swig of something strong – this designated zone becomes a 'Refraction Zone' for a duration of 6 seconds. Within this warped space, the laws of trajectory are… adjusted. All projectiles originating from enemy champions inside the Refraction Zone are not merely deflected, but redirected with malicious precision back towards their original casters. However, instead of dealing damage, these returned projectiles restore health to the enemy, healing them for 50% of the projectiles' potential damage. Furthermore, the disoriented enemies within the Refraction Zone become increasingly vulnerable, suffering a 10% increase to all incoming damage during its duration. To fuel this reality-bending feat, Haymitch consumes all of his remaining 'Intoxication.' The radius of the Refraction Zone expands by 10% for every 25 Intoxication consumed, allowing skilled players to maximize its effectiveness through resource management. It's a chaotic gamble, but, as Haymitch would say, always worth a shot.

The 'Septic Barrage' benefits from Vilgax's raw strength, scaling directly with his Attack stat, enhancing both its base damage and the likelihood of applying debuffs. abilities.description: Alfred, with a knowing grimace, deploys a cleverly concealed array of caltrops at a targeted location, creating a zone of momentary chaos. Any foes unfortunate enough to tread within this spiky minefield immediately find their advance stymied. Upon activation, Alfred selects a ground location within a 600-unit range. A 300-unit radius area is then instantly seeded with caltrops, remaining active for 5 seconds. Enemies entering this area are immediately subjected to a 40% movement speed reduction for 2 seconds. Additionally, affected enemies suffer 10 damage per second while within the field, a constant reminder of Alfred's resourceful defenses. Further amplifying Alfred's tactical prowess, allies traversing the caltrop field gain a 20% increase to their armor for 3 seconds, representing a brief window of reinforced resilience as they push forward, making this gambit ideal for both defensive maneuvers and aggressive counter-attacks.

abilities.description: Alfred channels his decades of experience and stern disapproval into a focused beam of revitalizing energy. Upon activation, Alfred swiftly recalibrates a single ally's condition, mending their wounds and bolstering their resolve. This ability projects a narrow, concentrated ray that instantly heals the target for an amount scaling with Alfred's ATK and a percentage of their missing health. The beam also grants the ally a temporary buff, 'Proper Bearing,' increasing their resistance to debuffs and interrupting effects for a short duration. While Corrective Reprimand prioritizes healing, its true strength lies in its ability to swiftly counteract debilitating conditions and ensure that allies maintain unwavering focus in the face of adversity. The buff lasts for a duration determined by upgrade level. Proper application requires foresight and precise timing, making it invaluable for preventing devastating status ailments and maintaining momentum during crucial moments.

abilities.description: Alfred, ever the bastion of calm in a storm, employs his extensive knowledge of first aid and herbal remedies to alleviate the suffering of allies. 'A Soothing Balm' is a passive ability that triggers upon an ally taking damage exceeding a certain threshold (scaling with Alfred's level). Upon activation, Alfred swiftly and efficiently applies a revitalizing balm, momentarily halting the advance of debilitating ailments and bolstering the target's resolve. This balm provides an immediate burst of healing (scaling with Alfred’s healing power and the target's missing health), followed by a lingering regeneration effect that restores health gradually over a brief duration. Furthermore, the soothing properties of the balm grant the afflicted ally a temporary buff to their status resistance, mitigating the impact of future afflictions from foes that dare to impede the party's progress, because certainly Alfred doesn’t approve of poor treatment to good people!

character_v1.playstyle: Alfred is a strategic healer who focuses on positioning, resource management, and proactive support. His abilities emphasize tactical awareness and precise execution, rewarding players who can anticipate enemy movements and protect their team with timely interventions.

A correct response to Vee's inquiry triggers a 'System Restore,' instantly mending the target's digital framework and restoring X% of their missing health. Moreover, the System Restore grants the targeted ally a 'Shield Buffer,' absorbing damage equal to 20% of Vee's total AP and lasting for 4 seconds, bolstering their defenses against incoming threats. abilities.description: Sovereign Bloom — a wind single-target providing supportive utility that reflects the essence of Danny Phantom. The strike is designed with a specific frame data profile: it triggers a singular, heavy-impact blow. abilities.description: Danny Phantom focuses his spectral energy, conjuring a shimmering, translucent, teal-colored Ghost Shield encompassing himself and nearby allies within a 7-unit radius. This protective sphere, sustained by Danny's concentration for up to 6 seconds, absorbs incoming damage equivalent to 99% of Danny's Defense stat plus 77% of his bonus Health, preferentially shielding allies nestled within its ghostly embrace. The shield emanates a soothing aura, mending the wounds of those it shelters, restoring 5% of their maximum health every second. The vibrant intensity of the teal glow mirrors Danny's vitality, radiating brightly at full health and gradually dimming to a faint, ethereal glimmer as his condition deteriorates. Should an enemy attempt to penetrate the Ghost Shield's boundary, they are instantly assailed by a concentrated blast of ectoplasmic energy, inflicting magic damage scaling from 6% of their maximum health and inflicting Ghostly Chills for 1 second, slowing their movement speed by 30% and hindering their attacks. Moreover, allies cloaked within the Ghost Shield's protective aura immediately gain a 15% increase in movement speed, enabling them to swiftly reposition or capitalize on tactical opportunities while safeguarded. When the Ghost Shield ultimately dissipates, whether through expiration or intentional deactivation, it unleashes a final surge of restorative energy, healing allies for 30% of the shield's remaining health, up to a maximum heal of 175, ensuring lasting benefit even in its final moments.

abilities.description: Spectral Tether: Danny channels ectoplasmic energy, forming a translucent, shimmering tether that latches onto a targeted enemy. Upon activation, Danny launches a spectral rope toward a designated foe within medium range. This rope, composed of solidified ghost energy, deals initial damage based on Danny's attack stat, and then applies a secondary effect based on the enemy type and current game phase. Humanoid enemies suffer a brief 'Fear' effect, causing them to flee uncontrollably for a short duration, whilst spectral enemies become 'Suppressed,' reducing their damage output and incoming healing for a slightly longer period. Non-spectral, non-humanoid enemies instead suffer from decreased movement speed. Scaling: Primary damage scales with Attack; the effect duration is affected by Luck and any applicable debuff potency bonuses. Use to disrupt enemy formations, interrupt powerful attacks, or debuff particularly troublesome foes to improve your team's survivability.

abilities.description: Yatta designates a target area, showering it with a cascade of colorful candies over 3 seconds. Allies within the area who pick up the candies gain a 'Sugar Rush,' increasing their movement speed by 10% and attack speed by 7% for 4 seconds. Enemies caught in the area are inflicted with 'Sugar Crash,' reducing their movement speed by 10% and attack speed by 7% for 4 seconds. Each candy picked up grants 1 stack of 'Candy Craze'. The size of the area increases by 5% and the duration of the speed and attack speed buffs/debuffs is extended by 0.25 seconds for every 5 stacks of 'Candy Craze' Yatta possesses, up to a maximum of 50%. abilities.description: Yatta coats an ally in a sugary shell, granting them a shield that absorbs X amount of damage for 4 seconds. The amount of damage absorbed is equal to 8% of Yatta's maximum HP, scaling with 60% of her magic attack. Each candy picked up by the shielded ally while the shield is active grants them 1 stack of 'Candy Craze'. Additionally, upon the shield breaking or expiring, the ally releases a burst of sugary energy, healing themselves for 3% of the damage absorbed by the shield. If Yatta has 50 or more stacks of 'Candy Craze' when casting this ability, the shield also grants immunity to slows only for its duration.

The damage is equal to 65% of Yatta's magic attack, plus an additional 3% for each stack of 'Candy Craze' she possesses, up to a maximum of 50%. Upon hitting the target, the Candy Comet explodes, scattering candies in a small area around the impact zone. Enemies struck by the explosion have their magic defense reduced by 7% for 2.5 seconds. Allies picking up these candies gain 1 stack of 'Candy Craze'. If Yatta has 75 stacks of 'Candy Craze' when using this ability, the Candy Comet slows the target by 30% for 1 second upon impact.
abilities.flavorQuote: Here comes a little something... straight to your face!

After the effect ends, allies are healed for 0.75% of their maximum HP per 'Candy Craze' stack consumed, while enemies take true damage equal to 0.75% of their maximum HP per stack consumed. Upon activation, Sukuna leaves behind a shimmering, residual trace of cursed energy, a momentary distortion that serves as a reminder of his terrifying speed. Sukuna becomes a harbinger of inescapable doom, exploiting Divergent Dismember to close the distance and unleash a flurry of strikes, or to elude the grasp of pursuers, leaving chaos and despair in his wake. Time your movements carefully, for Sukuna's wrath is most potent when his presence is least expected.

This wave does not directly harm enemies but instead bolsters the targeted ally with a restorative shield, its strength scaling principally with Astro's maximum HP and defensive stats, ensuring resilience even against formidable foes. abilities.description: Sam Manson, drawing upon her deep connection to the shadows and her unique aesthetic, conjures a personal haven for a chosen ally. Upon activation, Sam manipulates the ambient gloom, forming a swirling vortex of dark energy around the targeted ally, or around herself if no ally is specifically chosen. This shadowy manifestation coalesces into a protective barrier, a spectral sanctuary manifested as a swirling vortex of darkness, visually reminiscent of a gothic cathedral, emanating a pulsating aura of protective energy. This sanctuary grants the target a substantial shield composed of solidified shadow energy, absorbing incoming damage equal to 40% of Sam's support stat plus 10% of her level. The spectral sanctuary possesses an intriguing reaction to elemental attacks: when struck by Fire, Ice, or Lightning, the structure shimmers, 'consuming' a portion of that element and converting it into a temporary boost for the shielded target. Fire energy is converted into increased ATK, boosting the target's attack damage by 15% for 4 seconds. Ice is converted into increased DEF, enhancing the target's defensive capabilities by 20% for 4 seconds. Lightning is converted into increased Speed, granting the target a 25% boost to their movement speed for 4 seconds. This spectral haven persists for 6 seconds, providing sustained protection while the converted elemental power surges through the recipient. The ability prioritizes shielding allies with the lowest remaining health percentage, ensuring that Sam's aid goes to those who need it most.

abilities.description: Lullaby of Torment unleashes Ember's signature blend of sonic chaos and ghostly influence upon a single, unfortunate target. The target becomes 'Enthralled,' suffering a potent debuff that amplifies their vulnerability to subsequent Dark attacks. While Enthralled, the enemy experiences a cascading series of 'phantom echoes' from Ember's song, dealing minor, but persistent Dark damage over a short duration and slightly reducing their movement speed. The effectiveness of the Enthralled debuff is amplified by Ember's Charisma stat, while the damage scales with both her ATK and Special Attack, making it a devastating opening gambit for a coordinated assault. This move can be followed by allies' hard hitting, slower skills.

abilities.description: Maki meticulously identifies and exploits the vulnerabilities of her opponents, channeling her innate physical prowess and weapon expertise into devastating strikes. This passive ability grants a chance on basic attacks to inflict 'Pressure Point', a stacking debuff that increases the target's vulnerability to critical hits. Each stack of Pressure Point reduces the target's critical resistance by a percentage based on Maki's Attack stat. At maximum stacks, Pressure Point explodes in a burst of true damage, further weakening the target's defenses and potentially staggering them. This effect is amplified when Maki wields a Cursed Tool, granting bonus stacks and increasing the explosion damage. Furthermore, the ability synergizes with other allies who inflict debuffs, providing additional benefits when targeting enemies already afflicted by ailments. Careful observation and precise execution are key to maximizing this ability's effectiveness, turning Maki into a calculating and relentless force on the battlefield. These stacks last for 8 seconds. This ability has a short cooldown, encouraging skillful timing and precise execution. Successfully dodging also slightly reduces the cooldown of her other abilities by 0.5 seconds.

abilities.flavorQuote: I'll do whatever I can to help!

abilities.name: Desperate Measures

Furthermore, any enemy that attacks an ally protected by 'Plaga Barrier' is briefly stunned for 0.75 seconds. After the 'Plaga Barrier' expires, allies receive a burst heal equal to 10% of the damage absorbed by the barrier. This ability has a long cooldown, emphasizing its use in critical moments.
abilities.flavorQuote: We're going to get through this... together!

abilities.description: Leon, ever vigilant, applies his extensive field experience to ensure the survival of himself and his comrades. abilities.flavorQuote: The entire world will be infected. A new genesis is at hand, and I will be the creator!

abilities.name: Dominant Genes
abilities.description: Wesker's enhanced physiology grants him several advantages. He gains 15% increased speed and 10% increased tenacity. Additionally, whenever Wesker applies a stack of 'Viral Load', he gains a shield equal to 3% of his maximum HP for 3 seconds. This shield can stack up to 3 times, providing significant survivability in prolonged engagements. This passive ensures Wesker remains agile and durable while maintaining his control over the battlefield through Viral Load application.
abilities.flavorQuote: Sure, I'm not human anymore, but just look at the power I've gained!

abilities.name: Project Uroboros
abilities.description: Wesker fully embraces the power of Uroboros, transforming briefly. For 10 seconds, Wesker's attack damage is increased by 40%, and his basic attacks apply 2 stacks of Viral Load. He also gains immunity to crowd control effects. Upon activation, all existing stacks of 'Viral Load' on enemies are consumed, dealing magic damage equal to 15% of the enemy's maximum HP per stack consumed. This damage cannot exceed 40% of the enemy's max HP. This Ultimate has a long cooldown of 90 seconds and serves as Wesker's signature burst damage ability.
abilities.flavorQuote: The right to be a god? ... with Uroboros, I have that right.

This implosion deals a significant burst of physical damage, calculated primarily from Rex Splode's ATK stat, supplemented by a percentage of his critical damage modifier for that added punch. The implosive nature of the attack also generates a powerful inward force, forcibly pulling nearby enemies towards the epicenter of the blast. abilities.description: Rex Splode channels his internal energy, focusing it into a single, devastating kinetic charge. Upon activation, Rex enters a brief charging state (approximately 0.75 seconds), during which he glows with an intense, unstable aura. The charge can be canceled before completion but refunds a portion of the ability's cooldown based on charge time. Once fully charged, Rex unleashes a focused blast of kinetic energy directly in front of him, dealing significant AOE damage in a 200-unit cone. Enemies caught within the blast radius are subjected to a physics-based effect, scaling with Rex Splode's power—smaller enemies will be knocked back, while larger, more resilient foes will suffer a brief stagger. The detonation creates a visual spectacle: a short-lived but brilliant flash of light and concussive force that leaves behind a temporary distortion in the surrounding air. This ability scales significantly with attack damage and energy attack; critical hits can trigger a chain reaction of smaller explosions, dealing additional damage over time to enemies afflicted with the initial blast. This is Rex's go-to burst option for both PVE and PVP when fighting large numbers of enemies at a shorter range.

abilities.description: Rex Splode is the master of setting up explosive payoffs. Each basic attack he lands has a 10% chance to inflict the 'Volatile' debuff, marking an enemy for destruction. This volatile state lasts for 5 seconds, during which the affected target becomes increasingly unstable. Rex's attacks now have the potential to prime enemies, setting the stage for chain reactions. Imagine the enemy formation, each member teetering on the brink of detonation because of Rex's volatile touch. Rex excels at controlling the battlefield by increasing his team's opportunity to deal massive damage. At higher levels, the Volatile duration increases to 7 seconds, amplifying the chaos that Rex brings to any engagement. In addition, Rex can increase the chance to inflict Volatile with his basic attack, increasing it to 15%. Furthermore, when an enemy marked as Volatile is finally defeated, they detonate in a final burst, dealing physical damage equal to 10% of their maximum health to any enemies within a localized radius. Rex's explosive control enhances the destructive potential of his team. The increased volatility will decrease the defense of any affected enemy by 5%.

abilities.description: Rex Splode, in a desperate act of self-sacrifice, triggers a catastrophic release of his internal energy. He overloads his molecular structure, converting his entire body into a volatile explosive force. The initial blast inflicts a staggering amount of physical damage scaling exponentially with Rex Splode's level and any accumulated energy boosts. Following this immense burst of power, Rex Splode's physical form collapses, resulting in immediate incapacitation and removal from the battlefield. Any enemies slain by this initial blast are subject to further annihilation. Upon death, these affected foes detonate in a secondary explosion, dealing 50% of the initial damage in a smaller 5-meter radius from their position, ensuring maximum collateral devastation and potentially triggering chain reactions among tightly packed enemy formations.

abilities.description: Rex Splode, always pushing his body to its limits, triggers a surge of power when brought near defeat, turning a desperate situation into a strategic advantage for his team. When Rex Splode's health dips below 30%, his volatile physiology initiates a Critical Mass event. This immediately floods allies within a substantial radius with restorative energy, instantly healing them for 10% of their maximum health, revitalizing their fighting spirit. But the surge doesn't stop there; this energy wave then enhances the resolve of these very same allies, granting them X tenacity for 5 seconds. This temporary boost drastically reduces the duration of incoming stuns, slows, and other debilitating effects, enabling them to withstand enemy assaults with unwavering resilience. As the Critical Mass peaks, Rex Splode himself channels the unleashed power into his own attacks, increasing his attack damage by 20% for the same 5 seconds, turning the tide with explosive counter-offensives. Finally, the ally currently enduring the most grievous wounds receives an additional burst of speed, increasing their movement by 20% for 5 seconds, making a tactical retreat or a swift repositioning a viable option.

character_v1.playstyle: Rex excels at area denial and creating explosive chain reactions. He's a glass cannon who needs to pre-plan his attacks.

abilities.description: Lex Luthor projects a LexCorp corporate restructuring signal into a target area, effectively launching a 'Hostile Takeover' on enemy combat systems. For 5 seconds, all enemies caught within the area of effect are 'Disrupted', suffering a 10% reduction to both their physical attack power and movement speed, crippling their offensive and tactical capabilities. The brilliance of this 'takeover' lies in its scalability: the economic warfare extends beyond mere stat reductions. The benefits of this passive are nullified if an arm is disabled or destroyed.

abilities.name: Octo-Grapple
abilities.description: Doctor Octopus launches one of his advanced mechanical appendages towards a targeted area within a 6-unit range. Upon impact, the tentacle rapidly coils into a constricting snare, affecting a 1-unit radius around the impact point. Any unfortunate soul caught within this metallic trap finds themselves instantly ensnared; their feet are rooted to the ground for a duration of 1 second, augmented by an additional 0.25 seconds for each level the ability has been upgraded. As the tentacle tightens, it inflicts an initial jolt of 10 physical damage, a value that increases by 5 for each level the Doctor upgrades this ability. The mechanical limb remains as a coiled menace for a total of 3 seconds, slowing the movement of anyone unlucky enough to wander within its reach. Enemies inside the area are slowed by 20%, which increases by 5% per level, making escape increasingly difficult as the Doctor enhances his technological grip. After unleashing this metallic torment, Doctor Octopus must wait 12 seconds before the complex mechanisms of the tentacle allow for another Octo-Grapple.

abilities.description: Doctor Octopus, with a glint of strategic calculation in his eyes, extends his metallic appendages to exert a precise influence over the battlefield dynamics. Focusing his intellect, he selects a single target, be it an ally in need of repositioning or a foe ripe for disruption, within a reach of 5 units. Upon locking onto the chosen individual, his tentacles unleash a swift and calculated maneuver: either forcefully retracting the target, dragging them a distance of 3 units directly towards Doctor Octopus, or conversely, propelling them an equal distance of 3 units away from his present location, all in accordance with his meticulous tactical evaluation. When an ally becomes the recipient of this mechanical intervention, they are enveloped in a temporary field of energy, a byproduct of the advanced technology interwoven within the tentacles; this protective shield immediately mitigates the first 20 points of incoming damage, augmented by an additional 10 points for each level Doctor Octopus has mastered, and remains active for a duration of 3 seconds, granting a vital safeguard against imminent threats. Should an enemy be the unfortunate recipient of this manipulation, the tentacles deliver a calculated, sharp impact, inflicting an initial blow of 10 physical damage, heightened by an additional 5 points for each of Doctor Octopus's levels, disrupting their current position and potentially interrupting their immediate plans. The mechanical array requires a recalibration period of 15 seconds before it can be deployed once more, ensuring that Doctor Octopus maintains a calculated and relentless control over the ebb and flow of combat.

abilities.description: The Terminator locks onto a single enemy target, deploying a specialized projectile calibrated to exploit vulnerabilities. The initial impact delivers a physical blow, inflicting 50 damage plus an additional amount equal to 50% of the Terminator's Attack stat. However, if the target is currently subject to the 'Analyzed' status, the Terminator's targeting system instantly recalibrates the projectile. Instead of physical damage, the attack now deals damage of the Analyzed element type. Furthermore, the Adaptive Payload then delivers a precise debuff to the target, weakening their defenses. For a duration of 3 seconds, the target's resistance to the Analyzed element is reduced by 5%, compounding the effectiveness of subsequent elemental attacks against the same target. The T-800's advanced processors constantly adjust and optimize, ensuring maximum tactical advantage against evolving threats.

abilities.name: Cybernetic Resilience
upgrades: Lv10: Increases the initial number of Reinforced Plating stacks and slightly reduces the Emergency Protocol cooldown.
Lv50: Unlocks a secondary effect for Emergency Protocol: Briefly stuns nearby enemies upon activation, giving time to disengage or retaliate.

Lv100: Improves the scaling of health regeneration from Emergency Protocol and adds a team-support interaction: While in Emergency Protocol, the Terminator grants a small damage reduction buff to nearby allies.
abilities.description: The Terminator's advanced cybernetic construction grants him unparalleled resilience. At the start of each encounter, the Terminator gains a stack of 'Reinforced Plating', reducing incoming damage by a percentage that scales with his DEF stat and level. This effect lasts for a duration determined by the Terminator's END stat. When taking damage exceeding 10% of his maximum health in a single hit, one stack of Reinforced Plating is consumed to nullify the damage above the threshold and trigger a short burst of increased movement speed and tenacity (resistance to crowd control effects). Furthermore, upon falling below 25% health, the Terminator enters 'Emergency Protocol', instantly regenerating a percentage of his health based on his LUCK stat and gaining a significant boost to his armor and magic resistance, albeit at the cost of reduced damage output, representing a tactical retreat to self-preservation. This effect has a substantial cooldown. This passive ensures the Terminator can withstand initial bursts of damage and endure prolonged engagements, true to his relentless nature.

abilities.description: Cybernetic Override: Target Acquisition Protocol is a complex suite of automated combat directives, executing a cascading series of calculations to pinpoint optimal tactical solutions under duress. As a passive ability, its impact is interwoven into the Terminator's every action, augmenting both offensive capabilities and situational awareness. Upon activation (triggered by enemy presence within a defined engagement radius), the T-800 initiates a hardware-level diagnostic sweep, prioritizing identified threats based on a multivariate risk assessment. This assessment factors enemy health, attack power, proximity, and elemental affinities, synthesizing this data to highlight the most vulnerable target. For a duration dictated by the Terminator's core processing power, the target is temporarily designated with a 'Priority' status. While a target is Priority, all damage dealt to it from the Terminator gains a substantial multiplicative bonus. Should the initial designated target be defeated, the Target Acquisition Protocol immediately re-calibrates, selecting a new Priority, ensuring a relentless focus on the most critical threat on the battlefield. Furthermore, subsequent damage dealt to Priority targets inflicts a stacking debuff. This debuff not only amplifies incoming damage from the T-800 but also reduces the target's armor and resistance values, thereby compounding the efficiency of his follow-up attacks. If the Terminator suffers Crowd Control, the Override sequence goes into overdrive, automatically breaking the stun while also providing a brief window of invulnerability.

abilities.description: Harley, bouncing on the balls of her feet with a glint in her eye, dramatically winds up her signature mallet. As she unleashes a playful yet perilous swing upon the chosen target, a wave of pure chaotic energy emanates from the mallet, manifesting as a shimmering, cartoonish haze. The initial impact inflicts significant Physical damage, scaling linearly with Harley's Attack stat and non-linearly with her Luck, which greatly increases the raw damage done. However, true to Harley's whimsical nature, there's a 30% chance that the mallet, instead of stopping, will comically rebound off the target, seeking out a nearby ally within a moderate range of the initial target. Upon striking the ally, Harley will then trigger a burst of healing to the ally, healing for an amount that scales with Harley's Attack Power and Luck stat. In addition, the initial target will be afflicted with 'Tee-Hee Trauma', reducing their resistance to further attacks by 5% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to three times, amplifying the vulnerability with each subsequent strike. As a final touch, Harley's sheer exuberance grants the healed ally a temporary boost of 25% to their movement speed for 2 seconds. The ability's cooldown is calibrated to mirror Harley's unpredictable energy, requiring a moderate wait before her next bout of mallet-fueled mayhem.

In addition, Harley gains 5 tenacity for each enemy affected by at least one stack of 'Obsessed.' This signifies her increasing resilience and focus as she feeds off the chaos she creates. Tenacity reduces the duration of stuns, slows, and other forms of crowd control, but the total amount cannot exceed 50 plus Harley's base tenacity stat. For example, facing a team of five, Harley could gain a maximum of 25 tenacity if all enemies are 'Obsessed'.

Upon activation, Harley gains a short burst of increased movement speed for 1.5 seconds, positioning herself advantageously. Then, she executes a devastating three-hit combo. The first strike delivers a powerful blow inflicting significant physical damage, while also inflicting a [Stagger] debuff, interrupting enemy actions for 0.5 seconds. The second hit is a wild, sweeping strike that hits all nearby enemies, dealing reduced damage but applying a [Confusion] debuff, briefly reversing their movement controls for 1 second. Finally, the third hit is a grand slam that deals massive damage to a single target and has a high chance to [Knockdown] for 1.25 seconds. The final slam leaves behind a 'surprise': a small, bouncy mine that detonates after a short delay, dealing area-of-effect damage. This mine explodes immediately if an enemy approaches too closely. Consider the terrain and enemy positioning to maximize the chaos!

If Doc Brown has at least 50 Flux Energy, he can expend it to enhance the grenade, increasing the slow to 50% and the evasion boost to 25%. This enhancement also adds a 1-second 'Time Stasis' effect at the end of the duration, briefly freezing enemies in place. The grenade has a moderate range and a noticeable fuse time, requiring strategic placement to maximize its impact on the battlefield. This ability has a cooldown of 12 seconds.
abilities.flavorQuote: Time travel is possible, but so is a strategic retreat!

abilities.name: Flux Capacitor Overload
abilities.description: Whenever an ally scores a critical hit, or applies a crowd control effect to an enemy, Doc Brown gains 10 Flux Energy. Additionally, if Doc Brown successfully evades an enemy attack, he generates 5 Flux Energy. This passive ensures a steady accumulation of Flux Energy, rewarding both offensive support and self-preservation. Doc Brown's base maximum Flux Energy is 100. At maximum Flux Energy, Doc Brown's next basic attack will release a small burst of temporal energy that slows the target enemy by 20% for 2 seconds and grants Doc Brown a shield absorbing 50 damage for 3 seconds. This shield does not stack.
abilities.flavorQuote: Fluxing about is quite an efficient energy source, wouldn't you agree?

abilities.name: Remote Controlled Distraction

Enemies taunted by the DeLorean are forced to target and chase it for 3 seconds. The DeLorean has low HP and is easily destroyed, but it serves as an excellent distraction, redirecting enemy focus and creating opportunities for allies to reposition or deal damage. The range of the DeLorean is limited, and Doc Brown must maintain line of sight for it to function effectively. This ability has a cooldown of 15 seconds. If the DeLorean reaches the end of its range, it explodes in a small burst of energy dealing 50 (+20% magic atk) damage.
abilities.flavorQuote: All that power, and still just a distraction!

This ability can be used both offensively to set up the echo trap, or defensively to quickly reposition. This ability has a cooldown of 10 seconds.

Allies gain a 30% damage reduction for 5 seconds. Doc Brown must have at least 80 Flux Energy to activate this ability, consuming all accumulated energy upon use. This ability has a long cooldown of 75 seconds. The strategic application of this ability can disrupt enemy formations, protect allies from incoming damage, and create chaotic combat scenarios.

abilities.description: Subzero Snare is an ability embodying Mr. Freeze's chilling precision. Upon activation, Mr. Freeze projects a narrow cone of supercooled mist towards a designated enemy, requiring deft aiming and positioning for maximum efficacy. The mist itself deals frost damage upon contact, but its primary function is to inflict a 'Brittle' status effect. Targets afflicted by 'Brittle' have their armor reduced and are more susceptible to critical hits from Mr. Freeze and allies. This effect remains for a short duration, demanding coordinated strikes to fully capitalize on the vulnerability. Furthermore, if the target is already affected by a slow or freeze status effect, 'Brittle's' duration is significantly extended, creating a potent synergy with other abilities. abilities.description: Cryo-Armor Overlay: An ability exemplifying Mr. Freeze's unwavering dedication to survival through the cold. This passive skill manipulates the battlefield by encasing a targeted ally (or himself) in a layer of rapidly forming cryogenic armor. When activated, the target is immediately granted a substantial shield, visualized as a shimmering, intricate lattice of ice crystals that rapidly coats their form. The shield's strength is dynamically affected, scaling multiplicatively with Mr. Freeze's Defense stat, creating an inverse relationship where greater fortitude enhances the protective barrier. Furthermore, the cryogenic matrix passively reduces the target's incoming damage from fire-based attacks, simulating the chilling effect of absolute zero against incendiary forces. As a bonus effect, when the shield breaks, it releases a burst of frigid energy, inflicting a short-duration slow on nearby enemies, ensuring the protection's legacy persists even in its shattered state. This ability has a short cooldown. Note: Mr. Freeze cannot benefit from this effect if suffering from heat-based status effects.

abilities.description: Man of Steel represents Superman's inherent resilience and regenerative capabilities, allowing him to endure and recover from even the most grievous wounds. This passive ability significantly enhances Superman's survivability, granting him several key benefits. Firstly, it provides a constant, passive health regeneration effect, allowing him to slowly recover lost HP over time. The regeneration rate scales with his Max HP stat, making him increasingly difficult to bring down as he levels up. Secondly, whenever Superman's HP dips below a critical threshold, Man of Steel triggers a burst of rapid regeneration, instantly restoring a significant portion of his health. This burst heal provides a crucial lifeline, allowing him to withstand concentrated bursts of damage and stay in the fight. Finally, for a short duration after the burst regeneration, Superman gains temporary immunity to critical hits, further bolstering his defenses and preventing enemies from capitalizing on his vulnerability. abilities.description: Edelgard, embodying the strength and burden of her imperial authority, invokes the Aegis Imperii, a strike embodying both offense and defense. Additionally, Edelgard's strategic mind and personal resolve grant her increased potency when positioned away from her allies, reflecting her calculated approach to leadership and combat. For each turn that Edelgard is at least three units away from any allied unit, the damage inflicted by Aegis Imperii is amplified by 7%, stacking multiplicatively. This bonus caps at a maximum increase of 35%, showcasing the height of her independent power and tactical acumen. abilities.description: Edelgard's relentless ambition manifests as a dark flame, imbuing her strikes with 'Black Eagle's Ire.' Each basic attack and ability applies this debuff, searing foes with dark energy. 'Black Eagle's Ire' deals Dark damage equal to 3% of Edelgard's Attack stat every second for 5 seconds, relentlessly chipping away at their vitality. The debuff stacks additively, up to a maximum of 3 stacks, amplifying the dark fire's intensity with each application. Subsequent attacks refresh the duration of all existing stacks, ensuring constant pressure. Against adversaries hardened by armor or magic resistance exceeding 50, the damage over time escalates, increasing by 1% of Edelgard's Attack per stack. This strategic adaptation makes Edelgard exceptionally effective against resilient, tank-like opponents. The 'Black Eagle's Ire' not only ensures consistent damage output but also grants a unique tactical advantage: each stack also reduces the target's outgoing damage by 2%, stacking up to 6% at max stacks. This subtle yet impactful reduction weakens the foe's offensive capabilities, further solidifying Edelgard's control over the battlefield, emphasizing her role as both a damage dealer and a utility-focused disruptor.

character_v1.playstyle: Edelgard is a damage dealer who thrives when isolated from her team, reflecting her independent personality. Her abilities provide stacking damage bonuses for solo play, encouraging players to aggressively position her away from allies.

abilities.description: Vox Infernalis—a devastating sonic attack channeled through Alastor's unique brand of hellish broadcasting. This ability is a masterclass in psychological warfare disguised as raw power. Upon activation, Alastor unleashes a cacophony of static, distorted radio signals, and echoes of forgotten broadcasts directly into the minds of his enemies. The initial sonic assault deals a potent burst of reality-bending typeless damage to all foes within a moderate radius, scaling with both Alastor's ATK and his accumulated 'Sinister Ambience' stacks. But the true devastation lies in its secondary effects. Each affected enemy suffers a 'Dissonance' debuff, reducing their magical and physical resistance by a significant percentage. Furthermore, the debuff induces a brief period of uncontrollable fear, disrupting enemy formations and preventing them from using targeted abilities. The ability also grants Alastor and his allies a temporary surge of confidence. The 'Radiant Charisma' buff increases outgoing damage and provides a small boost to status resistance. Activating this ability consumes all 'Sinister Ambience' stacks. Use this ability strategically to initiate major engagements, disrupt enemy defenses, and secure a decisive advantage.

The caster then suffers the very fate they intended for Alastor, feeling the sting of their own malice, for the effect's original duration. This reflection occurs before the status effect is applied to Alastor, preventing its direct impact on him. Furthermore, this passive highlights Alastor's opportunistic nature, granting him an edge in tactical engagements.

Team members bathed in the smoke experience a 10% increase in their evasion, making them nimbler and harder to hit. This duality of impairment and support positions Batman and his squad to seize control of tight battlegrounds, turning disadvantage into overwhelming advantage.

abilities.description: From the shadows, Batman launches his grappling hook, latching onto the furthest visible enemy with pinpoint accuracy. As he hurtles through the air, the momentum builds into a devastating strike. Upon impact with the primary target, Batman delivers a powerful blow, inflicting physical damage equivalent to his full attack power, and stunning them for a crucial 1.5 seconds, disrupting their attack pattern and leaving them vulnerable. The force of the impact doesn't stop there; a shockwave ripples outwards, striking all enemies within a moderate radius. Batman lands prepared, and upon impact, generates a protective shield around himself, absorbing damage equal to 10% of his maximum health. abilities.description: Batman, utilizing his unparalleled mastery of gadgets and tactical awareness, initiates 'Batarang Echo' – a signature passive ability that leverages the versatility of his iconic Batarangs. Instead of a direct, singular strike, this ability unleashes a carefully calibrated array of three aerodynamically advanced Batarangs, each possessing unique utility functionalities. The first Batarang, a sonic emitter, unleashes a focused burst of subsonic waves, disorienting the targeted enemy and inflicting a temporary reduction to their accuracy stat. Following this sonic assault, the second Batarang deploys a micro-grapple line, briefly tethering the enemy to a nearby object (or, in the absence of a fixed point, creating a localized gravitational anomaly), imposing a short-duration root effect. Finally, the third Batarang – the core of the 'Echo' – emits a burst of echolocation pulses. This pulse not only reveals hidden enemies within a moderate radius but also amplifies the damage dealt by Batman's allies to the primary targeted enemy by a percentage based on Batman's support stat for a fleeting, but critical, window of opportunity. The 'Batarang Echo' ability's cooldown is subtly extended to account for its multifaceted utility and supportive capabilities, demanding judicious deployment in the ebb and flow of combat encounters. This passive can be triggered every 20 seconds.

abilities.description: Aang taps into the Avatar State's latent potential, channeling a rapid, transformative burst of elemental energy to reposition himself and debilitate his foes. Activating this ability empowers Aang to briefly become an untargetable conduit of pure elemental force, swiftly dashing forward, leaving behind a wake that reflects his current elemental attunement. When attuned to Air, Aang transforms into a swirling vortex of wind, increasing his evasion chance by 40% for 2 seconds after the dash. While attuned to Water, a cascading wave of icy water emanates from Aang's movement, applying a stacking chilling effect to enemies caught in the wave. Each application reduces enemy movement speed by 10%, stacking up to 3 times, for a maximum slow of 30% for 3 seconds. While attuned to Earth, Aang's dash becomes a localized earthquake, creating a fissure in the ground that deals 50 (+30% Ability Power) physical damage over 2 seconds to enemies standing within the fissure. When attuned to Fire, Aang's dash becomes a blazing inferno, leaving a trail of flames that ignites enemies who cross it, inflicting 30 (+15% Ability Power) fire damage per second for 4 seconds. abilities.description:
Aang channels the elements to create a swirling vortex of protective energy around himself for 5 seconds. This swirling elemental shell absorbs incoming damage, converting a percentage of it into elemental energy that empowers Aang's subsequent attacks. The shell has a base health equal to 20% of Aang's maximum health, decaying by 5% each second after activation. 

While the shell is active:
- If in Air Stance, the shell grants Aang increased movement speed and evasion chance, allowing him to nimbly dodge attacks while mitigating damage. Each successful dodge further empowers the shell, increasing its damage absorption by a small percentage, stacking up to five times.
- If in Water Stance, the shell applies a chilling aura to nearby enemies, slowing their attack and movement speed. Damage absorbed by the shell converts into additional slow potency, up to a maximum threshold.
- If in Earth Stance, the shell gains significant damage reduction and grants Aang armor and magic resist. Damage absorbed is converted into temporary bonus health for Aang upon the shell's expiration.
- If in Fire Stance, the shell ignites nearby enemies, dealing damage over time. Damage absorbed by the shell explodes outwards upon expiration, dealing additional fire damage in a small radius around Aang, scaling with the amount of damage absorbed.
abilities.flavorQuote: Protecting others is the most important task of an Avatar!

abilities.name: Elemental Harmony
abilities.description:
Aang cycles through the four elements (Air, Water, Earth, Fire) every 8 seconds, granting him a different passive bonus based on his current stance. 
Air Stance: +15% movement speed and evasion.
Water Stance: Regenerates 2% of max HP every second.
Earth Stance: +10% armor and magic resist.
Fire Stance: +10% atk and magic atk. Activating an ability while in Fire Stance leaves a temporary burn DoT effect on Aang himself (stacking, but has diminishing returns). Additionally, all of Aang's other abilities are modified based on his current Elemental Stance. This passive also reduces the cooldown of Aang's other abilities by 1 second.
abilities.flavorQuote: The cycle of the Avatar.

abilities.name: Avatar State Unleashed
abilities.description: Aang enters the Avatar State for 12 seconds, greatly amplifying his abilities. While in the Avatar State, Aang gains 30% increased damage, 20% damage reduction, and cycles through his Elemental Harmony stances every 3 seconds instead of 8. Additionally, all of his active abilities have their cooldowns reduced by 50%. At the end of the Avatar State, Aang is stunned for 1 second as he returns to normal. If used strategically, this ultimate can turn the tide of battle, but improper timing can leave Aang vulnerable. The stun duration can be reduced by increasing Aang's Tenacity stat.
abilities.flavorQuote: The power of all the Avatars!

abilities.description: Mark's Viltrumite physiology grants him inherent resilience. He gains a base Defense boost equal to X plus an additional amount equivalent to 0.5 times his Defense stat. As Mark takes damage and his health dwindles, his resolve hardens, granting him damage reduction. For every 10% of his maximum health he loses, he gains 2% damage reduction, mitigating incoming attacks. This effect stacks linearly, up to a maximum damage reduction of 20%. When pushed to the brink, Mark's inner strength surges. Should he fall below 25% of his maximum health, the adrenaline floods his system, allowing him to break through even the most daunting obstacles. In this desperate state, the usual damage reduction cap is lifted, granting him an additional 1% damage reduction for every 5% of maximum health lost beyond the 75% threshold. This effect allows him to effectively mitigate all but the most devastating of blows, demonstrating his unwavering determination to prevail, even when battered and bruised.

abilities.description: Interstellar Intervention is a reality-bending, team-focused Ultimate ability. Upon activation, Mark briefly channels cosmic energies, drawing upon his Viltrumite heritage to manipulate the very fabric of space around his allies. Instead of directly damaging foes, Mark creates miniature, localized distortions in spacetime near his teammates, visually manifesting as shimmering, ethereal fields. These distortions impart several powerful benefits. First, allies within the area gain a significant boost to their damage resistance, reducing incoming damage by a flat percentage. Second, each ally's next damaging ability within the distortion field is empowered, gaining increased range, critical hit chance, or a unique secondary effect tailored to their specific kit. Finally, as the effect ends, the distortions implode, releasing a burst of concentrated energy that heals allies within the area based on a portion of the damage they mitigated during the ability's duration. The heal is distributed evenly among them, incentivizing team coordination and strategic positioning. This power requires careful timing to be effective, rewarding tactical players who can anticipate enemy attacks and position allies strategically.
abilities.flavorQuote: "I'm not just protecting you, I'm bending reality to help you."

upgrades: Lv10: Reduces Viltrumite Grit's cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

abilities.description: Viltrumite Grit embodies Mark's innate resilience and ability to capitalize on incoming attacks. When Mark sustains damage exceeding 20% of his maximum health from a single source, he doesn't just absorb the blow; he channels the impact into a tactical advantage. Instead of a simple rebound, this triggers a surge of Viltrumite power. This surge grants him 'Focused Fury' for the next 4 seconds, during which his next basic attack deals 150% bonus damage and applies a 'Weakened' debuff for 3 seconds. The 'Weakened' debuff reduces the target's damage output by 10%. The Grit further enhances his survivability by granting Mark a temporary shield equal to 10% of his maximum health. This shield lasts for 5 seconds, providing a crucial buffer against follow-up attacks. This ability has an internal cooldown of 12 seconds. Mark also gains 15% movement speed for 3 seconds, allowing him to quickly close the distance or escape danger after absorbing a major hit.

character_v1.playstyle: The kit is geared towards a bruiser role, focusing on high mobility, damage mitigation, and escalating damage output in prolonged engagements, aligning well with Mark's character as a resilient and powerful combatant.

Simultaneously, their defense is subtly compromised, lowered by 15%, a consequence of distractions orchestrated by Gus's meticulous planning. Allies, however, find themselves subtly emboldened within this carefully curated environment, increasing their status effect resistance by 10%, fortifying their resolve against external manipulations. abilities.description: Flux Capacitor Overload is a uniquely unstable ability that embodies the unpredictable nature of time travel and Marty McFly's often-chaotic interactions with it. When triggered, this passive has a chance to activate a brief, but potent, temporal anomaly around Marty. This anomaly manifests in one of three potential ways, chosen entirely at random and determined by a complex (though invisible to the player) probability matrix. First, it might unleash a burst of chroniton energy, dealing moderate AoE damage and slightly slowing nearby enemies as temporal distortions disrupt their movement. Second, it could create a localized time dilation field, briefly speeding up Marty's attack and movement speed while slowing enemies within its radius, offering a tactical advantage. Finally, it has a smaller chance to trigger a minor temporal shift, briefly displacing Marty to a nearby, random location—potentially escaping danger or disrupting enemy formations. The Flux Capacitor Overload is entirely unpredictable by design, requiring players to adapt to its randomized effects, making it both a high-risk, high-reward ability and a perfect representation of the unexpected consequences that follow Marty's every move.
abilities.flavorQuote: Great Scott! I don't know what's gonna happen!

character_v1.playstyle: Marty McFly is a high-mobility utility character, excelling at disrupting enemies and empowering allies with temporary buffs. His gameplay revolves around strategic positioning and calculated risks, but is balanced to inflict self-damage tied to his time manipulation abilities.

abilities.description: The Joker, with a manic grin, hurls a razor-sharp Ace of Spades at his target, dealing physical damage and possibly causing a cascade of chaos. This single target attack delivers a base damage plus a scaling factor derived from Joker's total attack power. Upon impact, there is a 20% chance to inflict 'Jokerized' for 3 seconds. abilities.description: With a flourish and a manic giggle that sends shivers down spines, The Joker hurls a specially doctored playing card – the 'Ha-Ha Harpoon' – at a chosen adversary. This isn't just a card trick; it's a prelude to pandemonium. The card, edged with a neurotoxin concocted in his own twisted lab, slices through the air to deal physical damage equivalent to 90% of The Joker's Attack stat directly to the single, most deserving target. But the real punchline is the cocktail of insanity that follows. Upon impact, a cloud of noxious gas erupts, subjecting the target to one of his patented psychological torments for a duration of 3.5 seconds. The debuff, selected randomly from his repertoire of madness, may inflict 'Giggles Frenzy', forcing the target into uncontrolled fits of laughter, rendering them unable to cast spells and silencing them completely. Alternatively, 'Fear Gas' might cloud their vision, inflicting Blindness and reducing their accuracy by a hefty 50%, causing them to stumble and flail like a blindfolded clown. And for those especially privileged victims, 'Weakness Venom' could cripple their defenses, reducing their armor by a substantial 35%, leaving them exposed and vulnerable to follow-up attacks. The higher The Joker's Attack soars, the sharper the card's edge and the more potent the venom, ensuring that his twisted jokes always land with maximum impact.

This damage bonus caps at 50%. Furthermore, if the target is affected by a 'Madness' debuff, the card explodes on impact, dealing additional AoE damage around the primary target. Consider this Ace up your sleeve as the perfect means to escalate a battle into utter chaos, favoring long-term strategic plays with explosive and psychological payoffs that will drive your enemy to laugh...or cry.

abilities.description: The Joker produces a seemingly innocuous playing card, the 'Ace of Knaves', flipping it towards a single target with deceptively calculated precision. The card, imbued with chaotic energy, accelerates unnaturally, impacting the target with a force far exceeding its initial momentum. Upon impact, the card triggers a bizarre, unpredictable effect. This effect can range from a burst of debilitating laughter that briefly impairs the target's accuracy (applying a 'Confusion' status effect), to a sudden, disorienting visual hallucination causing them to attack their nearest ally (brief 'Taunt'). The 'Ace in the Hole' ability boasts a substantial Critical Hit chance, reflecting the Joker's inherent unpredictability. Its primary damage type is 'Psychic', amplified by the target's current level of 'Insanity' or similar mental debuffs. Furthermore, each successful hit grants The Joker a stack of 'Madness', increasing his evasion chance by a small percentage for a short duration. The ability has a short animation lock, but the potential for chaos it unleashes makes it a vital tool for disrupting enemy formations and exploiting psychological weaknesses. The unpredictability also means there is small chance of the ability backfiring, causing allies to receive small boons.

abilities.description: The Joker, a master of mayhem, approaches a single enemy with a demented grin and a flourish, planting a 'Joke Bomb' at their feet. This unsettling device immediately discharges a burst of chaotic energy, inflicting pure damage equal to 60% of The Joker's total Attack Power. More than just a simple blast, this sets the stage for true pandemonium. A 'Gassed' status effect is then applied to the target, lasting for a full 3 seconds. While 'Gassed', the victim's attack damage is reduced by 10%, and, as if the Joke Bomb isn't enough, at the start of each subsequent turn while the target remains under the influence of Joker's special gas, the gas effect becomes increasingly potent, imposing an additional 5% reduction to their attack damage. At the end of the full duration of 'Gassed', the Joke Bomb detonates in a glorious explosion of green gas, dealing 80% of The Joker's total Attack Power as pure damage. As a true showman, The Joker ensures this bomb is extra potent on critical hits. This ability is his signature 'joke' to weaken high-damage threats.

character_v1.playstyle: Joker's kit is designed around unpredictable burst damage and debuffs, fitting the assassin role by disrupting enemy teams and creating opportunities for quick takedowns. His reliance on randomness requires adaptability.

abilities.description: Energy Barrier: Samus channels reserve power from her suit into a temporary, reactive energy shield. Upon activation, the ability instantly grants a shield to Samus. This shield's strength scales linearly with Samus's total HP, with a small quadratic contribution from her DEF stat, symbolizing her ability to adaptively reinforce her armor plating against incoming threats. Furthermore, *any* damage taken while the shield is active is partially converted (approximately 35% by default) into a temporary buff that increases the effectiveness of Samus's *next* healing ability – whether it's a personal regeneration technique or a team-based healing surge from an ally. Note that 'effectiveness' encompasses both the *amount* healed and the *duration* of any regeneration effects. This creates a tactical decision: strategically absorb heavy hits to empower future healing, maximizing both survivability and support potential. Finally, the energy shield itself has a unique interaction with elemental damage: it is inherently resistant to energy attacks (fire, ice, electricity, etc.), reducing their damage by 20%, representing the insulation properties of Samus's Power Suit; however, it is slightly *weaker* against purely physical, non-energy kinetic damage, taking 5% increased damage from such sources. Manage your defense layers to succeed!

abilities.description: Samus taps into the latent Phazon within her Metroid DNA, unleashing a surge of power. For 10 seconds, she becomes infused with Phazon energy, increasing her attack damage by 40% as crackling energy emanates from her suit.
